                        cs.append({"s": iv["e"], "e": iv["e"], "label": "계획 정지", "on": False})
                    out[r] = cs
                return out
            
            
            def validate_day(sessions_by_room: dict, plans: dict, decisions: list, sim: dict, cmds: dict,
                             scenario: dict, anomalies: dict, settings: dict, guard_events: dict | None = None) -> dict:
                """Two-level check for the operated strategy.
            
                plan check : every session has a planned interval or a justified skip decision
                execution  : >=95 % of planned on-minutes executed (justified vacancy stops excluded),
                             room in comfort band at start, >=90 % of class minutes in band
                """
                lo, hi = settings["comfort_low"], settings["comfort_high"]
                dec_by_session: dict[str, list] = {}
                for dcs in decisions:
                    for sid_ in dcs.get("sessions", [dcs["session"]]):
                        dec_by_session.setdefault(sid_, []).append(dcs)
                ev_by_session: dict[str, list] = {}
                for evs in scenario.values():
                    for ev in evs:
                        ev_by_session.setdefault(ev["session"], []).append(ev)
                rows, issues = [], []
                for r, ss in sessions_by_room.items():
                    comfort = {c["id"]: c for c in sim["rooms"][r]["sessions"]}
                    plan_cmd = [0] * 1440
                    for iv in plans.get(r, []):
                        for m in range(max(iv["s"], 0), min(iv["e"], 1440)):
                            plan_cmd[m] = 1
                    justified = [0] * 1440
                    for a_ in anomalies.get(r, []):
                        if a_["type"] == "forced_off":
                            for m in range(max(a_["s"], 0), min(a_["e"], 1440)):
                                justified[m] = 1
                    for s in ss:
                        a, b = hm_to_min(s["start"]), hm_to_min(s["end"])
                        win = range(max(a - settings["ai_max_lead_min"], 0), min(b, 1440))
                        planned_min = [m for m in win if plan_cmd[m] and not justified[m]]
                        executed = sum(1 for m in planned_min if cmds[r][m] != OFF)
                        exec_ratio = executed / len(planned_min) if planned_min else 1.0
                        dtypes = [x["type"] for x in dec_by_session.get(s["id"], [])]
                        evtypes = [x["type"] for x in ev_by_session.get(s["id"], [])]
                        planned = any(plan_cmd[m] for m in range(a, min(b, 1440))) or any(plan_cmd[m] for m in win)
                        justified_skip = "skip" in dtypes
                        c = comfort.get(s["id"], {})
                        ta0 = c.get("ta_start")
                        comfort_pct = 100 * c["in_band_minutes"] / c["minutes"] if c.get("minutes") else None
                        ready = ta0 is not None and lo - 0.3 <= ta0 <= hi + 0.3
                        status, notes = "ok", []
                        if not planned and not justified_skip:
                            status = "plan_missing"
                            notes.append("계획에 없는 수업")
                        elif "no_show" in evtypes:
                            status = "vacancy"
                            notes.append("재실 없음(무단 휴강 추정) → 10분 후 자동 정지")
                        else:
                            if "early_dismiss" in evtypes:
                                notes.append("조기 종료 감지 → 자동 정지")
                            if exec_ratio < 0.95:
                                status = "exec_gap"
                                notes.append(f"계획 대비 실행 {exec_ratio * 100:.0f}%")
                            elif not justified_skip and not ready and "late_start" not in dtypes:
                                status = "not_ready"
                                notes.append(f"시작 시 실내 {ta0}℃ (쾌적 범위 밖)")
                            elif comfort_pct is not None and comfort_pct < 90 and "early_dismiss" not in evtypes:
                                status = "low_comfort"
                                notes.append(f"수업 중 쾌적 {comfort_pct:.0f}%")
                            elif justified_skip:
                                status = "skip_ok"
                        g_min = sum(min(g["e"], b) - max(g["s"], a) for g in (guard_events or {}).get(r, [])
                                    if g["s"] < b and g["e"] > a)
                        if g_min > 0:
                            notes.append(f"예보 오차로 실내온도 이탈 → 피드백 보정 {g_min}분")
                            if status in ("ok", "skip_ok"):
                                status = "corrected"
                        if "failure" in evtypes:
                            notes.append("On 명령 응답 없음 → 5분 후 재전송으로 복구")
                            if status in ("ok", "exec_gap", "not_ready"):
                                status = "recovered"
                        if "override" in evtypes:
                            notes.append("수업 후 재실자 수동 가동 → 빈 강의실 감지 후 자동 정지")
                            if status == "ok":
                                status = "override"
                        row = {
                            "session": s["id"], "room": r, "title": s["title"], "start": s["start"], "end": s["end"],
                            "kind": s["kind"], "status": status, "notes": notes, "planned": planned or justified_skip,
                            "exec_ratio": round(exec_ratio, 3), "ta_start": ta0, "decisions": dtypes,
                            "comfort_pct": round(comfort_pct, 1) if comfort_pct is not None else None,
                        }
                        rows.append(row)
                        if status not in ("ok", "skip_ok"):
                            issues.append(row)
                matched = sum(1 for x in rows if x["status"] in GOOD_STATUS)
                plan_ok = sum(1 for x in rows if x["planned"])
                return {
                    "sessions": rows,
                    "issues": issues,
                    "total": len(rows),
                    "match_rate": round(100 * matched / len(rows), 1) if rows else None,
                    "plan_coverage": round(100 * plan_ok / len(rows), 1) if rows else None,
                    "auto_actions": sum(1 for x in rows if x["status"] in ("vacancy", "recovered", "override", "corrected")),
                    "anomaly_count": sum(1 for x in rows if x["status"] not in ("ok", "skip_ok")),
                }
            
            
            GOOD_STATUS = ("ok", "skip_ok", "vacancy", "recovered", "override", "corrected")
            
            
            def warm_state(d: date, courses: list[dict], events: list[dict], weather_by_date: dict, settings: dict) -> dict:
                """Shared start-of-day room state: 2 warm-up days operated by the rule plan on actual weather."""
                days = [d - timedelta(days=2), d - timedelta(days=1)]
                w0 = weather_by_date.get(days[0].isoformat()) or weather_by_date[d.isoformat()]
                state = default_init(w0)
                for wd in days:
                    w = weather_by_date.get(wd.isoformat()) or w0
                    ss = sessions_for_date(wd, courses, events)
                    by_room = {r: [s for s in ss if s["room"] == r] for r in ROOMS}
                    # warm-up uses the default rule timing so that editing rule parameters does not shift
                    # the shared start-of-day state of the other strategies
                    from .config import DEFAULT_SETTINGS
                    warm_rules = {**settings, **{k: DEFAULT_SETTINGS[k] for k in ("pre_on_min", "early_off_min", "gap_merge_min")}}
                    plan = plan_rule(by_room, ROOMS, warm_rules)
                    sim = simulate_day(ROOMS, ODUS, plan, by_room, minute_series(w["actual"]["t"]),
                                       minute_series(w["actual"]["rh"]), minute_series(w["actual"]["ghi"]),
                                       state, settings, detail=False, clo=clo_for_month(wd.month),
                                       t_adj=adjacent_temp(sum(w["actual"]["t"]) / 24.0))
                    state = sim["end_state"]
                return state
            
            
            def compute_day(
                d: date,
                courses: list[dict],
                events: list[dict],
                weather_by_date: dict,
                settings: dict,
                detail: bool = True,
                strategies: tuple = tuple(STRATEGIES),
            ) -> dict:
                rooms, odus = ROOMS, ODUS
                weather_day = weather_by_date[d.isoformat()]
                init = warm_state(d, courses, events, weather_by_date, settings)
                init_states = {st: init for st in strategies}
                sessions = sessions_for_date(d, courses, events)
                by_room = {r: [s for s in sessions if s["room"] == r] for r in rooms}
                wa, wf = weather_day["actual"], weather_day["forecast"]
                to_a, rh_a, ghi_a = minute_series(wa["t"]), minute_series(wa["rh"]), minute_series(wa["ghi"])
                wf_min = {"to": minute_series(wf["t"]), "rh": minute_series(wf["rh"]), "ghi": minute_series(wf["ghi"])}
                clo = clo_for_month(d.month)
                scenario = field_scenario(d, by_room, settings)
                occ_actual = actual_occupancy(by_room, scenario)
            
                plans, decisions = {}, []
                if "fixed" in strategies:
                    plans["fixed"] = plan_fixed(by_room, rooms, is_workday(d), settings)
                if "manual" in strategies:
                    plans["manual"] = plan_manual(by_room, rooms, settings)
                if "rule" in strategies:
                    plans["rule"] = plan_rule(by_room, rooms, settings)
                if "ai" in strategies:
                    plans["ai"], decisions = plan_ai(by_room, rooms, wf_min, init_states["ai"], settings)
            
                out = {"date": d.isoformat(), "weekday": d.weekday(), "workday": is_workday(d), "holiday": HOLIDAYS.get(d),
                       "sessions": sessions, "weather": weather_day, "strategies": {}, "decisions": decisions,
                       "init": {r: [round(v[0], 2), round(v[1], 2)] for r, v in init.items()}, "scenario": scenario,
                       "comfort_band": [settings["comfort_low"], settings["comfort_high"]]}
                season = season_of(d)
                rates = settings["tariff"][season]
                if not isinstance(rates, dict):
                    rates = {"light": rates, "mid": rates, "peak": rates}
                for st, plan in plans.items():
                    anomalies, extra_causes = ({}, {})
                    if st == "ai":
                        anomalies, extra_causes = ai_field_controls(plan, scenario, settings, by_room,
                                                                    vacancy=settings.get("ai_use_vacancy", True))
                    sim = simulate_day(rooms, odus, plan, by_room, to_a, rh_a, ghi_a, init_states[st], settings,
                                       anomalies=anomalies, clo=clo, detail=detail, occupancy=occ_actual,
                                       guard=(st == "ai"), t_adj=adjacent_temp(sum(wa["t"]) / 24.0))
                    guard_events = sim.pop("guard_events", {})
                    sim.pop("end_state")
                    cmds = sim.pop("_cmds")
                    sim["plan"] = plan
                    sim["cost_krw"] = round(sum(k * rates[tou_band(season, h)] for h, k in enumerate(sim["kwh_by_hour"])))
                    sim["co2_kg"] = round(sim["kwh"] * settings["co2_kg_per_kwh"], 2)
                    if st == "ai":
                        out["validation"] = validate_day(by_room, plan, decisions, sim, cmds, scenario, anomalies, settings,
                                                         guard_events)
                        causes = plan_causes(plan)
                        for r, cs in extra_causes.items():
                            causes[r] = cs + causes.get(r, [])
                        for r, evs in guard_events.items():
                            gc = []
                            for g in evs:
                                gc.append({"s": g["s"], "e": g["s"], "label": f"실내 {g['ta']}℃ 쾌적 범위 이탈 감지 → 자동 보정 가동", "on": True})
                            causes[r] = gc + causes.get(r, [])
                        sim["guard_events"] = guard_events
                        out["history"] = history_from_cmds(d.isoformat(), rooms, cmds, causes, sim["odus"])
                    out["strategies"][st] = sim
                return out
            
            
            def default_init(weather_day: dict) -> dict:
                t = sum(weather_day["actual"]["t"]) / 24.0
                base = 0.5 * t + 0.5 * 20.0
                return {r: (base, base) for r in ROOMS}
            
            
            def warmup_dates(start: date, days: int = 7) -> list[date]:
                return [start - timedelta(days=k) for k in range(days, 0, -1)]
            
            
            def cold_starts(sim: dict, lo: float, hi: float) -> int:
                """Occupied classes that began outside the comfort band (too cold or too hot at the start)."""
                n = 0
                for room in sim["rooms"].values():
                    for c in room["sessions"]:
                        if c.get("vacant") or c.get("ta_start") is None:
                            continue
                        if not (lo - 0.3 <= c["ta_start"] <= hi + 0.3):
                            n += 1
                return n
            
            
            def summarize_day(day: dict) -> dict:
                """Compact per-day summary for calendar / energy charts."""
                out = {"date": day["date"], "weekday": day["weekday"], "workday": day["workday"], "holiday": day["holiday"],
                       "sessions": len(day["sessions"]), "events": sum(1 for s in day["sessions"] if s["kind"] == "event"),
                       "t_mean": round(sum(day["weather"]["actual"]["t"]) / 24.0, 1),
                       "t_min": min(day["weather"]["actual"]["t"]), "t_max": max(day["weather"]["actual"]["t"]),
                       "strategies": {}}
                lo, hi = day.get("comfort_band", [19.5, 26.5])
                for st, sim in day["strategies"].items():
                    out["strategies"][st] = {
                        "cold_starts": cold_starts(sim, lo, hi),
                        "kwh": sim["kwh"], "cost_krw": sim["cost_krw"], "co2_kg": sim["co2_kg"], "peak_kw": sim["peak_kw"],
                        "comfort_pct": sim["comfort_pct"], "on_minutes": sum(x["on_minutes"] for x in sim["rooms"].values()),
                        "odu_on_minutes": sum(x["on_minutes"] for x in sim["odus"].values()),
                        "discomfort_dm": round(sum(c["discomfort_dm"] for x in sim["rooms"].values() for c in x["sessions"]), 1),
                    }
                if "validation" in day:
                    v = day["validation"]
                    out["match_rate"] = v["match_rate"]
                    out["plan_coverage"] = v["plan_coverage"]
                    out["anomalies"] = v["anomaly_count"]
                    out["auto_actions"] = v["auto_actions"]
                    out["needs_review"] = v["anomaly_count"] - v["auto_actions"]
                dec = {}
                for x in day.get("decisions", []):
                    dec[x["type"]] = dec.get(x["type"], 0) + 1
                out["decisions"] = dec
                return out
            --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

        📄 model.py
            --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
            """Physics: 2R2C room thermal model, VRF heat-pump performance and PMV comfort.
            
            Room model (per room, 1-minute explicit Euler):
              Ca dTa/dt = Gam (Tm - Ta) + Gao (To - Ta) + Qint + Qsol + Qhvac
              Cm dTm/dt = Gam (Ta - Tm) + Gmo (To - Tm)
            Ta: indoor air node, Tm: structure/surface node (also used as mean radiant temp).
            """
            from __future__ import annotations
            
            import math
            
            DT = 60.0  # seconds per step
            
            PERSON_W = 75.0  # sensible heat per seated person
            LIGHT_W_M2 = 10.0
            PC_W = 100.0
            SHGC = 0.4
            VERT_FACTOR = 0.5  # vertical facade irradiance as a share of global horizontal
            IDU_FAN_W = 60.0
            ODU_BASE_W = 300.0
            VENT_M3H_PP = 25.0  # outdoor air per person (classroom)
            ERV_EFF = 0.6  # energy recovery ventilator sensible effectiveness
            
            
            class RoomPhys:
                __slots__ = ("id", "ca", "cm", "gam", "gao", "gmo", "gadj", "win", "cap_heat", "cap_cool",
                             "n_idu", "area", "pcs", "odu")
            
                def __init__(self, room: dict):
                    s = room["area"] / 99.0
                    self.id = room["id"]
                    self.ca = 1.5e6 * s
                    self.cm = 20.0e6 * s
                    self.gam = 1050.0 * s
                    self.gao = 80.0 * s
                    self.gmo = 60.0 * s
                    self.gadj = 80.0 * s  # partitions / slabs to neighbouring rooms and corridors
                    self.win = 10.0 * s
                    self.cap_heat = sum(i["heat_kw"] for i in room["idus"]) * 1000.0
                    self.cap_cool = sum(i["cool_kw"] for i in room["idus"]) * 1000.0
                    self.n_idu = len(room["idus"])
                    self.area = room["area"]
                    self.pcs = room["pcs"]
                    self.odu = room["odu"]
            
                def internal_gain(self, people: float) -> float:
                    if people <= 0:
                        return 0.0
                    return people * PERSON_W + LIGHT_W_M2 * self.area + self.pcs * PC_W
            
                def solar_gain(self, ghi: float) -> float:
                    return self.win * SHGC * VERT_FACTOR * max(ghi, 0.0)
            
                @staticmethod
                def vent_g(people: float, economizer: bool) -> float:
                    """Outdoor-air conductance (W/K). ERV (60 % recovery) at 25 m3/h/person while
                    occupied; economizer (FAN mode) bypasses recovery and doubles the flow."""
                    if people <= 0:
                        return 0.0
                    g = people * VENT_M3H_PP * 1.2 * 1005.0 / 3600.0
                    return g * 2.0 if economizer else g * (1.0 - ERV_EFF)
            
            
            def thermostat_q(rp: RoomPhys, ta: float, passive: float, sp_heat: float, sp_cool: float,
                             cap_frac: float = 1.0) -> float:
                """Ideal capacity-limited thermostat: heat/cool just enough to stay inside [sp_heat, sp_cool].
                cap_frac limits IDU output (soft start)."""
                ta_free = ta + DT * passive / rp.ca
                if ta_free < sp_heat:
                    q = rp.ca * (sp_heat - ta) / DT - passive
                    return min(max(q, 0.0), rp.cap_heat * cap_frac)
                if ta_free > sp_cool:
                    q = rp.ca * (sp_cool - ta) / DT - passive
                    return max(min(q, 0.0), -rp.cap_cool * cap_frac)
                return 0.0
            
            
            def cop_cool(to: float) -> float:
                return 3.8 * min(max(1.0 + 0.03 * (35.0 - to), 0.8), 1.6)
            
            
            def cop_heat(to: float) -> float:
                return 3.4 * min(max(1.0 + 0.025 * (to - 7.0), 0.55), 1.3)
            
            
            def plr_factor(plr: float) -> float:
                """Electric input per unit heat vs. full load, shaped after the EnergyPlus
                VariableRefrigerantFlow_5Zone example curves: ~1.2x more efficient at 50-60 %
                part load than at full load; below 25 % the compressor cycles and efficiency drops."""
                p = min(max(plr, 0.02), 1.2)
                if p >= 0.25:
                    return 1.037 * p * p - 1.2296 * p + 1.1926
                return 0.95 * (0.25 / p) ** 0.35
            
            
            def electric_w(q: float, to: float, plr: float) -> float:
                if q > 0:
                    return q / cop_heat(to) * plr_factor(plr)
                if q < 0:
                    return -q / cop_cool(to) * plr_factor(plr)
                return 0.0
            
            
            def psat_kpa(t: float) -> float:
                return 0.61094 * math.exp(17.625 * t / (t + 243.04))
            
            
            def indoor_rh(to: float, rh_out: float, ta: float) -> float:
                pv = psat_kpa(to) * rh_out / 100.0
                return min(max(100.0 * pv / psat_kpa(ta), 15.0), 90.0)
            
            
            def pmv(ta: float, tr: float, rh: float, clo: float, met: float = 1.1, vel: float = 0.1) -> float:
                """ISO 7730 PMV (Fanger)."""
                pa = rh * 10.0 * math.exp(16.6536 - 4030.183 / (ta + 235.0))
                icl = 0.155 * clo
                m = met * 58.15
                w = 0.0
                mw = m - w
                fcl = 1.0 + 1.29 * icl if icl <= 0.078 else 1.05 + 0.645 * icl
                hcf = 12.1 * math.sqrt(vel)
                taa = ta + 273.0
                tra = tr + 273.0
                tcla = taa + (35.5 - ta) / (3.5 * icl + 0.1)
                p1 = icl * fcl
                p2 = p1 * 3.96
                p3 = p1 * 100.0
                p4 = p1 * taa
                p5 = 308.7 - 0.028 * mw + p2 * (tra / 100.0) ** 4
                xn = tcla / 100.0
                xf = tcla / 50.0
                hc = hcf
                n = 0
                while abs(xn - xf) > 0.00015 and n < 150:
                    xf = (xf + xn) / 2.0
                    hcn = 2.38 * abs(100.0 * xf - taa) ** 0.25
                    hc = max(hcf, hcn)
                    xn = (p5 + p4 * hc - p2 * xf ** 4) / (100.0 + p3 * hc)
                    n += 1
                tcl = 100.0 * xn - 273.0
                hl1 = 3.05 * 0.001 * (5733.0 - 6.99 * mw - pa)
                hl2 = 0.42 * (mw - 58.15) if mw > 58.15 else 0.0
                hl3 = 1.7 * 0.00001 * m * (5867.0 - pa)
                hl4 = 0.0014 * m * (34.0 - ta)
                hl5 = 3.96 * fcl * (xn ** 4 - (tra / 100.0) ** 4)
                hl6 = fcl * hc * (tcl - ta)
                ts = 0.303 * math.exp(-0.036 * m) + 0.028
                return ts * (mw - hl1 - hl2 - hl3 - hl4 - hl5 - hl6)
            
            
            def clo_for_month(month: int) -> float:
                return {6: 0.5, 7: 0.5, 8: 0.5, 9: 0.55, 10: 0.75, 11: 0.95, 12: 1.0}.get(month, 0.9)
            
            
            def adjacent_temp(to_daily_mean: float) -> float:
                """Temperature of neighbouring spaces (corridors, other rooms) seen by the structure node."""
                return min(max(0.5 * to_daily_mean + 10.0, 17.0), 26.0)
            --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

        📄 simulate.py
            --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
            """Execution simulator: runs room plans on IDU/ODU models and records history.
            
            Plans are per-room lists of intervals {"s": min, "e": min, "kind": "cond"|"fan", ...}
            with minutes from 00:00. The simulator applies field anomalies (occupant override,
            command failure), integrates the thermal model every minute, couples rooms through
            their ODU part-load ratio and returns time series, energy and device history.
            """
            from __future__ import annotations
            
            from .model import (DT, IDU_FAN_W, ODU_BASE_W, RoomPhys, electric_w, indoor_rh, pmv,
                                thermostat_q)
            from .timetable import hm_to_min, min_to_hm
            
            OFF, FAN, COND = 0, 1, 2
            
            
            def occupancy_array(sessions: list[dict]) -> list[float]:
                occ = [0.0] * 1440
                for s in sessions:
                    a, b = hm_to_min(s["start"]), min(hm_to_min(s["end"]), 1440)
                    for m in range(a, b):
                        occ[m] += s["expected_people"]
                return occ
            
            
            def plan_to_cmd(intervals: list[dict]) -> list[int]:
                cmd = [OFF] * 1440
                for iv in intervals:
                    v = COND if iv.get("kind", "cond") == "cond" else FAN
                    for m in range(max(0, iv["s"]), min(1440, iv["e"])):
                        if v > cmd[m]:
                            cmd[m] = v
                return cmd
            
            
            def plan_to_cap(intervals: list[dict]) -> list[float]:
                """Per-minute IDU output limit (fraction of rated capacity); soft-start segments use < 1."""
                cap = [1.0] * 1440
                for iv in intervals:
                    f = float(iv.get("cap", 1.0))
                    if f < 1.0:
                        for m in range(max(0, iv["s"]), min(1440, iv["e"])):
                            cap[m] = min(cap[m], f)
                return cap
            
            
            def cmd_to_intervals(cmd: list[int]) -> list[dict]:
                out = []
                cur, start = OFF, 0
                for m in range(1441):
                    v = cmd[m] if m < 1440 else OFF
                    if v != cur:
                        if cur != OFF:
                            out.append({"s": start, "e": m, "kind": "cond" if cur == COND else "fan"})
                        cur, start = v, m
                return out
            
            
            def simulate_day(
                rooms: dict[str, dict],
                odus: dict[str, dict],
                plans: dict[str, list[dict]],
                sessions_by_room: dict[str, list[dict]],
                to_min: list[float],
                rh_min: list[float],
                ghi_min: list[float],
                init: dict[str, tuple[float, float]],
                settings: dict,
                anomalies: dict[str, list[dict]] | None = None,
                clo: float = 0.9,
                detail: bool = True,
                occupancy: dict[str, list[float]] | None = None,
                guard: bool = False,
                t_adj: float = 18.0,
            ) -> dict:
                """guard=True adds closed-loop correction: while people are present and the unit is
                not conditioning, leaving the comfort band starts conditioning until the room empties."""
                sp_h, sp_c = settings["sp_heat"], settings["sp_cool"]
                lo, hi = settings["comfort_low"], settings["comfort_high"]
                ids = sorted(rooms)
                phys = {r: RoomPhys(rooms[r]) for r in ids}
                cmds = {r: plan_to_cmd(plans.get(r, [])) for r in ids}
                caps = {r: plan_to_cap(plans.get(r, [])) for r in ids}
                anomalies = anomalies or {}
                for r, lst in anomalies.items():
                    for a in lst:
                        for m in range(max(0, a["s"]), min(1440, a["e"])):
                            cmds[r][m] = COND if a["type"] == "override" else OFF
                occ = {r: (occupancy or {}).get(r) or occupancy_array(sessions_by_room.get(r, [])) for r in ids}
            
                ta = {r: init[r][0] for r in ids}
                tm = {r: init[r][1] for r in ids}
                odu_rooms: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
                for r in ids:
                    odu_rooms.setdefault(phys[r].odu, []).append(r)
            
                guard_on = {r: False for r in ids}
                guard_events: dict[str, list[dict]] = {r: [] for r in ids}
                ta_series = {r: [] for r in ids}
                tm_series = {r: [] for r in ids}
                p_room_5 = {r: [] for r in ids}
                p_odu_5 = {o: [] for o in odu_rooms}
                e_room = {r: 0.0 for r in ids}
                e_odu = {o: 0.0 for o in odu_rooms}
                q_room_heat = {r: 0.0 for r in ids}
                q_room_cool = {r: 0.0 for r in ids}
                kwh_by_hour = [0.0] * 24
                acc_room = {r: 0.0 for r in ids}
                acc_odu = {o: 0.0 for o in odu_rooms}
                odu_on = {o: [False] * 1440 for o in odu_rooms}
                total_w = [0.0] * 1440
            
                for m in range(1440):
                    to = to_min[m]
                    ghi = ghi_min[m]
                    q = {}
                    passive_of = {}
                    for r in ids:
                        rp = phys[r]
                        a, b = ta[r], tm[r]
                        c = cmds[r][m]
                        people = occ[r][m]
                        if guard:
                            if people <= 0:
                                guard_on[r] = False
                            elif c != COND and (guard_on[r] or a < lo or a > hi):
                                if not guard_on[r]:
                                    guard_events[r].append({"s": m, "e": m, "ta": round(a, 2)})
                                guard_on[r] = True
                                c = COND
                                cmds[r][m] = COND
                                guard_events[r][-1]["e"] = m + 1
                        passive = (rp.gam * (b - a) + (rp.gao + rp.vent_g(people, c == FAN)) * (to - a)
                                   + rp.internal_gain(people) + rp.solar_gain(ghi))
                        passive_of[r] = passive
                        q[r] = thermostat_q(rp, a, passive, sp_h, sp_c, caps[r][m]) if c == COND else 0.0
                    # outdoor-unit capacity: connected indoor units cannot draw more than the ODU delivers
                    for o, rlist in odu_rooms.items():
                        cap_w = odus[o]["cap_kw"] * 1000.0
                        req = sum(abs(q[r]) for r in rlist)
                        if req > cap_w > 0:
                            f = cap_w / req
                            for r in rlist:
                                q[r] *= f
                    for r in ids:
                        rp = phys[r]
                        a, b, qq = ta[r], tm[r], q[r]
                        ta[r] = a + DT * (passive_of[r] + qq) / rp.ca
                        tm[r] = b + DT * (rp.gam * (a - b) + rp.gmo * (to - b) + rp.gadj * (t_adj - b)) / rp.cm
                        if qq > 0:
                            q_room_heat[r] += qq * DT / 3.6e6
                        elif qq < 0:
                            q_room_cool[r] += -qq * DT / 3.6e6
                    tot = 0.0
                    for o, rlist in odu_rooms.items():
                        cap = odus[o]["cap_kw"] * 1000.0
                        load = sum(abs(q[r]) for r in rlist)
                        plr = load / cap if cap else 0.0
                        any_on = False
                        p_o = 0.0
                        on_rooms = []
                        for r in rlist:
                            if cmds[r][m] != OFF:
                                any_on = True
                                on_rooms.append(r)
                        base = ODU_BASE_W if any_on else 0.0
                        for r in rlist:
                            pr = electric_w(q[r], to, plr)
                            if cmds[r][m] != OFF:
                                pr += IDU_FAN_W * phys[r].n_idu + base / len(on_rooms)
                            acc_room[r] += pr
                            e_room[r] += pr * DT / 3.6e6
                            p_o += pr
                        odu_on[o][m] = any_on
                        acc_odu[o] += p_o
                        e_odu[o] += p_o * DT / 3.6e6
                        tot += p_o
                    total_w[m] = tot
                    kwh_by_hour[m // 60] += tot * DT / 3.6e6
                    if m % 5 == 4:
                        for r in ids:
                            ta_series[r].append(round(ta[r], 2))
                            tm_series[r].append(round(tm[r], 2))
                            p_room_5[r].append(round(acc_room[r] / 5.0))
                            acc_room[r] = 0.0
                        for o in odu_rooms:
                            p_odu_5[o].append(round(acc_odu[o] / 5.0))
                            acc_odu[o] = 0.0
            
                # peak demand as max 15-min average (kW)
                peak = 0.0
                for m in range(0, 1440, 15):
                    peak = max(peak, sum(total_w[m:m + 15]) / 15.0 / 1000.0)
            
                rooms_out = {}
                for r in ids:
                    comfort = session_comfort(sessions_by_room.get(r, []), ta_series[r], tm_series[r], rh_min, to_min, lo, hi, clo, occ[r])
                    on_min = sum(1 for v in cmds[r] if v != OFF)
                    rooms_out[r] = {
                        "kwh": round(e_room[r], 3),
                        "heat_kwh_th": round(q_room_heat[r], 2),
                        "cool_kwh_th": round(q_room_cool[r], 2),
                        "on_minutes": on_min,
                        "actual": cmd_to_intervals(cmds[r]),
                        "sessions": comfort,
                    }
                    if detail:
                        rooms_out[r]["ta"] = ta_series[r]
                        rooms_out[r]["p"] = p_room_5[r]
                odus_out = {}
                for o in odu_rooms:
                    odus_out[o] = {
                        "kwh": round(e_odu[o], 3),
                        "on_minutes": sum(odu_on[o]),
                        "actual": cmd_to_intervals([COND if v else OFF for v in odu_on[o]]),
                    }
                    if detail:
                        odus_out[o]["p"] = p_odu_5[o]
            
                occ_minutes = sum(len(s["sessions"]) and sum(x["minutes"] for x in s["sessions"]) for s in rooms_out.values())
                in_band = sum(sum(x["in_band_minutes"] for x in s["sessions"]) for s in rooms_out.values())
                return {
                    "rooms": rooms_out,
                    "odus": odus_out,
                    "kwh": round(sum(e_room.values()), 3),
                    "kwh_by_hour": [round(v, 3) for v in kwh_by_hour],
                    "peak_kw": round(peak, 2),
                    "comfort_pct": round(100.0 * in_band / occ_minutes, 1) if occ_minutes else None,
                    "occupied_minutes": occ_minutes,
                    "end_state": {r: (ta[r], tm[r]) for r in ids},
                    "guard_events": {r: v for r, v in guard_events.items() if v},
                    "_cmds": cmds,
                }
            
            
            def session_comfort(sessions, ta5, tm5, rh_min, to_min, lo, hi, clo, occ=None) -> list[dict]:
                """Comfort while people are actually present (unannounced no-shows / early dismissal excluded)."""
                out = []
                for s in sessions:
                    a, b = hm_to_min(s["start"]), hm_to_min(s["end"])
                    idx = [k for k in range(a // 5, min(b // 5, len(ta5))) if occ is None or occ[min(k * 5 + 2, 1439)] > 0]
                    # include the temperature people walk into (the sample just before the start)
                    if idx and idx[0] == a // 5 and a // 5 - 1 >= 0:
                        idx = [a // 5 - 1] + idx
                    if not idx:
                        out.append({"id": s["id"], "start": s["start"], "end": s["end"], "minutes": 0, "in_band_minutes": 0,
                                    "ta_start": ta5[max(a // 5 - 1, 0)], "ta_min": None, "ta_max": None,
                                    "discomfort_dm": 0.0, "pmv": None, "vacant": True})
                        continue
                    temps = [ta5[k] for k in idx]
                    inb = sum(1 for t in temps if lo <= t <= hi)
                    dm = sum(max(lo - t, 0.0) + max(t - hi, 0.0) for t in temps) * 5.0
                    # PMV every 15 minutes during the session
                    pv = []
                    for k in idx[::3]:
                        m = min(k * 5 + 4, 1439)
                        rh_in = indoor_rh(to_min[m], rh_min[m], ta5[k])
                        pv.append(pmv(ta5[k], tm5[k], rh_in, clo))
                    start_k = max(a // 5 - 1, 0)
                    out.append(
                        {
                            "id": s["id"],
                            "start": s["start"],
                            "end": s["end"],
                            "minutes": len(temps) * 5,
                            "in_band_minutes": inb * 5,
                            "ta_start": ta5[start_k] if start_k < len(ta5) else None,
                            "ta_min": min(temps),
                            "ta_max": max(temps),
                            "discomfort_dm": round(dm, 1),
                            "pmv": round(sum(pv) / len(pv), 2) if pv else None,
                        }
                    )
                return out
            
            
            def history_from_cmds(date_iso: str, rooms: dict, cmds: dict[str, list[int]], causes: dict[str, list[dict]], odus_actual: dict) -> list[dict]:
                """On/Off state transitions per device (IDU per room, ODU) with cause labels."""
                rows = []
                for r, cmd in cmds.items():
                    prev = OFF
                    for m in range(1441):
                        v = cmd[m] if m < 1440 else OFF
                        if v != prev:
                            cause = _cause_at(causes.get(r, []), m, v)
                            state = {OFF: "OFF", FAN: "FAN", COND: "ON"}[v]
                            for idu in rooms[r]["idus"]:
                                rows.append({"date": date_iso, "t": min_to_hm(min(m, 1439) if m < 1440 else 1440), "minute": m,
                                             "device": idu["id"], "room": r, "state": state, "cause": cause})
                            prev = v
                for o, d in odus_actual.items():
                    for iv in d["actual"]:
                        rows.append({"date": date_iso, "t": min_to_hm(iv["s"]), "minute": iv["s"], "device": o, "room": None, "state": "ON", "cause": "연결 실내기 가동"})
                        rows.append({"date": date_iso, "t": min_to_hm(iv["e"]), "minute": iv["e"], "device": o, "room": None, "state": "OFF", "cause": "연결 실내기 모두 정지"})
                rows.sort(key=lambda x: (x["minute"], x["device"]))
                return rows
            
            
            def _cause_at(causes: list[dict], m: int, v: int) -> str:
                for c in causes:
                    if c["s"] <= m <= c["e"] and (c.get("on") is None or c["on"] == (v != OFF)):
                        return c["label"]
                return "스케줄" if v != OFF else "스케줄 종료"
            --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

        📄 strategies.py
            --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
            """Operating strategies -> per-room plans (intervals in minutes from 00:00).
            
            fixed  : building-wide fixed hours on weekdays (baseline A)
            manual : on at first lecture, off 30 min after last lecture (baseline B)
            rule   : requirement 5 rules (pre-on N min, early-off M min, bridge gaps <= G min)
            ai     : predictive optimisation with the room thermal model and the weather forecast
                     (optimal start, delayed start, skip, economizer, coasting stop, gap bridging)
            """
            from __future__ import annotations
            
            from .model import DT, RoomPhys, adjacent_temp, cop_cool, cop_heat, thermostat_q
            from .simulate import COND, FAN, OFF, occupancy_array
            from .timetable import hm_to_min, min_to_hm
            
            
            def _sessions_minutes(sessions):
                return sorted((hm_to_min(s["start"]), hm_to_min(s["end"]), s) for s in sessions)
            
            
            def plan_fixed(sessions_by_room: dict, rooms: dict, is_workday: bool, settings: dict) -> dict:
                if not is_workday:
                    return {r: [] for r in rooms}
                a, b = hm_to_min(settings["fixed_on"]), hm_to_min(settings["fixed_off"])
                return {r: [{"s": a, "e": b, "kind": "cond", "reason": "고정 운전 시간"}] for r in rooms}
            
            
            def plan_manual(sessions_by_room: dict, rooms: dict, settings: dict) -> dict:
                out = {}
                for r in rooms:
                    ss = _sessions_minutes(sessions_by_room.get(r, []))
                    if not ss:
                        out[r] = []
                        continue
                    a = ss[0][0]
                    b = min(max(e for _, e, _ in ss) + settings["manual_off_delay_min"], 1440)
                    out[r] = [{"s": a, "e": b, "kind": "cond", "reason": "첫 수업 시작에 수동 가동, 마지막 수업 후 늦게 정지"}]
                return out
            
            
            def plan_rule(sessions_by_room: dict, rooms: dict, settings: dict) -> dict:
                pre, early, gap = settings["pre_on_min"], settings["early_off_min"], settings["gap_merge_min"]
                out = {}
                for r in rooms:
                    ss = _sessions_minutes(sessions_by_room.get(r, []))
                    ivs: list[dict] = []
                    for s, e, sess in ss:
                        if ivs and s - ivs[-1]["_end"] <= gap:
                            ivs[-1]["e"] = max(e - early, ivs[-1]["e"])
                            ivs[-1]["_end"] = max(e, ivs[-1]["_end"])
                            ivs[-1]["sessions"].append(sess["id"])
                            ivs[-1]["reason"] = f"연속 강의(공백 {gap}분 이내) 유지"
                            continue
                        ivs.append({"s": max(s - pre, 0), "e": max(e - early, s), "_end": e, "kind": "cond",
                                    "reason": f"시작 {pre}분 전 가동, 종료 {early}분 전 정지", "sessions": [sess["id"]]})
                    for iv in ivs:
                        iv.pop("_end", None)
                    out[r] = ivs
                return out
            
            
            # ---------------------------------------------------------------- predictive (AI)
            
            class _Ctx:
                __slots__ = ("rp", "to", "ghi", "occ", "sp_h", "sp_c", "t_adj", "cap_frac", "cap_until")
            
                def __init__(self, rp, to, ghi, occ, sp_h, sp_c, t_adj):
                    self.rp, self.to, self.ghi, self.occ, self.sp_h, self.sp_c = rp, to, ghi, occ, sp_h, sp_c
                    self.t_adj = t_adj
                    self.cap_frac, self.cap_until = 1.0, -1  # soft-start output limit before cap_until
            
            
            def _forward(ctx: _Ctx, ta: float, tm: float, m0: int, m1: int, mode_at, lo=None, hi=None):
                """Simulate one room from m0 to m1. mode_at(m) -> OFF/FAN/COND.
                Returns (ta, tm, electric_wh, violated, ta_series_at_end)."""
                rp = ctx.rp
                e_wh = 0.0
                violated = False
                for m in range(m0, min(m1, 1440)):
                    to = ctx.to[m]
                    people = ctx.occ[m]
                    c = mode_at(m)
                    passive = (rp.gam * (tm - ta) + (rp.gao + rp.vent_g(people, c == FAN)) * (to - ta)
                               + rp.internal_gain(people) + rp.solar_gain(ctx.ghi[m]))
                    q = thermostat_q(rp, ta, passive, ctx.sp_h, ctx.sp_c,
                                     ctx.cap_frac if m < ctx.cap_until else 1.0) if c == COND else 0.0
                    if q > 0:
                        e_wh += q / cop_heat(to) / 60.0
                    elif q < 0:
                        e_wh += -q / cop_cool(to) / 60.0
                    if c != OFF:
                        e_wh += 60.0 * rp.n_idu / 60.0
                    ta_new = ta + DT * (passive + q) / rp.ca
                    tm = tm + DT * (rp.gam * (ta - tm) + rp.gmo * (to - tm) + rp.gadj * (ctx.t_adj - tm)) / rp.cm
                    ta = ta_new
                    if lo is not None and people > 0 and not (lo <= ta <= hi):
                        violated = True
                return ta, tm, e_wh, violated
            
            
            def _const(v):
                return lambda m: v
            
            
            def _switch(t_on: int, v_before: int, v_after: int):
                return lambda m: v_after if m >= t_on else v_before
            
            
            def _first_exit(ctx, ta, tm, m0, s, e, lo, hi):
                """Free-floating from m0; first minute in [s,e) where Ta leaves [lo,hi] (None if never)."""
                rp = ctx.rp
                for m in range(m0, min(e, 1440)):
                    to = ctx.to[m]
                    people = ctx.occ[m]
                    passive = (rp.gam * (tm - ta) + (rp.gao + rp.vent_g(people, False)) * (to - ta)
                               + rp.internal_gain(people) + rp.solar_gain(ctx.ghi[m]))
                    ta_new = ta + DT * passive / rp.ca
                    tm = tm + DT * (rp.gam * (ta - tm) + rp.gmo * (to - tm) + rp.gadj * (ctx.t_adj - tm)) / rp.cm
                    ta = ta_new
                    if m >= s and not (lo <= ta <= hi):
                        return m, ta
                return None, ta
            
            
            def plan_ai_room(room: dict, sessions: list[dict], to_f, rh_f, ghi_f, init: tuple[float, float], settings: dict,
                             odu_share: float = 1.0):
                rp = RoomPhys(room)
                occ = occupancy_array(sessions)
                ctx = _Ctx(rp, to_f, ghi_f, occ, settings["sp_heat"], settings["sp_cool"], adjacent_temp(sum(to_f) / len(to_f)))
                margin = settings.get("ai_margin_k", 0.4)
                lo, hi = settings["comfort_low"] + margin, settings["comfort_high"] - margin
                max_lead = settings["ai_max_lead_min"]
                max_early = settings["ai_max_early_off_min"]
                gap_max = settings["ai_gap_eval_max_min"]
                rule_pre, rule_early = settings["pre_on_min"], settings["early_off_min"]
            
                # merge back-to-back sessions into blocks
                blocks: list[dict] = []
                for s, e, sess in _sessions_minutes(sessions):
                    if blocks and s <= blocks[-1]["e"]:
                        blocks[-1]["e"] = max(blocks[-1]["e"], e)
                        blocks[-1]["sessions"].append(sess)
                    else:
                        blocks.append({"s": s, "e": e, "sessions": [sess]})
            
                intervals: list[dict] = []
                decisions: list[dict] = []
                ta, tm = init
                cursor = 0
                carry_on = False  # unit already running at block start (bridged gap)
            
                def sid(blk):
                    return blk["sessions"][0]["id"]
            
                def add_dec(blk, **kw):
                    decisions.append({"session": sid(blk), "sessions": [x["id"] for x in blk["sessions"]],
                                      "room": room["id"], "title": blk["sessions"][0]["title"],
                                      "start": min_to_hm(blk["s"]), "end": min_to_hm(blk["e"]), **kw})
            
                for i, blk in enumerate(blocks):
                    s, e = blk["s"], blk["e"]
                    label = blk["sessions"][0]["title"]
                    humid = any(rh_f[m] >= settings["dehum_rh"] and to_f[m] >= settings["dehum_temp"] for m in range(s, min(e, 1440), 10))
                    use_weather = settings.get("ai_use_weather", True)  # ablation switch for savings attribution
            
                    if carry_on:
                        on_t, mode = s, COND
                    else:
                        td = max(cursor, s - max_lead)
                        ta, tm, _, _ = _forward(ctx, ta, tm, cursor, td, _const(OFF))
                        cursor = td
                        exit_m, ta_exit = _first_exit(ctx, ta, tm, td, s, e, lo, hi)
                        if use_weather and exit_m is None and not humid:
                            add_dec(blk, **{"type": "skip", "detail": "냉난방 없이도 수업 내내 쾌적 범위 유지 예측 → 가동 생략",
                                              "saved_min": (e - rule_early) - (s - rule_pre)})
                            ta, tm, _, _ = _forward(ctx, ta, tm, td, e, _const(OFF))
                            cursor = e
                            continue
                        # economizer: room overheats while outdoor air is cool and dry
                        if use_weather and exit_m is not None and ta_exit > hi and not humid and min(to_f[s:e] or [99]) < hi - 4:
                            ta2, tm2, _, viol = _forward(ctx, ta, tm, td, e, _switch(s, OFF, FAN), lo, hi)
                            if not viol:
                                intervals.append({"s": s, "e": e, "kind": "fan", "reason": "외기 냉방(송풍·환기) — 압축기 미가동",
                                                  "sessions": [x["id"] for x in blk["sessions"]]})
                                add_dec(blk, **{"type": "economizer", "detail": f"외기 {min(to_f[s:e]):.1f}℃로 실내 과열을 송풍·환기로 해소",
                                                  "saved_min": (e - rule_early) - (s - rule_pre)})
                                ta, tm, cursor = ta2, tm2, e
                                continue
                        if use_weather and exit_m is not None and exit_m > s + 10 and not humid:
                            on_t = exit_m - 5
                            add_dec(blk, **{"type": "late_start", "detail": f"수업 시작 후 {on_t - s}분까지 쾌적 유지 예측 → {min_to_hm(on_t)} 지연 기동",
                                              "saved_min": on_t - (s - rule_pre)})
                        else:
                            # optimal start: minimal lead so that Ta is in setpoint band at lecture start
                            band_lo, band_hi = settings["sp_heat"] - 0.15, settings["sp_cool"] + 0.15
            
                            def ok(lead):
                                t_a, _, _, _ = _forward(ctx, ta, tm, td, s, _switch(s - lead, OFF, COND))
                                return band_lo <= t_a <= band_hi
            
                            def search():
                                lo_l, hi_l = 0, max(0, s - td)
                                if ok(0):
                                    return 0, True
                                if not ok(hi_l):
                                    return hi_l, False
                                while hi_l - lo_l > 1:
                                    mid = (lo_l + hi_l) // 2
                                    if ok(mid):
                                        hi_l = mid
                                    else:
                                        lo_l = mid
                                return hi_l, True
            
                            # Pre-conditioning output: the room cannot count on more than its share of the
                            # outdoor unit (rooms on one ODU usually pre-heat together). Try a soft start
                            # (efficient part-load range) and the ODU share; keep the feasible option with
                            # the lower predicted electricity.
                            share = odu_share
                            options = []
                            for frac in sorted({min(settings.get("ai_softstart_frac", 0.6), share), share}):
                                ctx.cap_frac, ctx.cap_until = frac, s
                                ld, feas = search()
                                _, _, e_wh, _ = _forward(ctx, ta, tm, td, s, _switch(s - ld, OFF, COND))
                                options.append((not feas, e_wh, ld, frac))
                            options.sort()
                            infeasible, _, lead, frac = options[0]
                            feasible = not infeasible
                            ctx.cap_frac, ctx.cap_until = (frac, s) if frac < 1.0 else (1.0, -1)
                            if lead > 0:
                                lead = min(lead + settings.get("ai_lead_buffer_min", 3), max(0, s - td))
                            on_t = s - lead
                            why = "제습 필요(고습)" if humid else ("난방" if ta < band_lo else "냉방")
                            how = f"출력 {round(ctx.cap_frac * 100)}%로 " if ctx.cap_frac < 1.0 and lead > 0 else ""
                            add_dec(blk, **{"type": "optimal_start", "detail": f"예측 실내 {ta:.1f}℃ → {why} {how}{lead}분 선행 가동이면 시작 시 설정온도 도달",
                                              "lead_min": lead, "saved_min": rule_pre - lead, "soft": bool(how)})
                        mode = COND
                        ta, tm, _, _ = _forward(ctx, ta, tm, td, on_t, _const(OFF))
                        cursor = on_t
            
                    # run conditioning until the coasting window
                    t_check = max(cursor, e - max_early)
                    ta, tm, _, _ = _forward(ctx, ta, tm, cursor, t_check, _const(mode))
                    cursor = t_check
            
                    nxt = blocks[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(blocks) else None
                    gap = (nxt["s"] - e) if nxt else None
            
                    # coasting stop: earliest off time that keeps comfort to the end of the block
                    t_off = e
                    sa, sm = ta, tm
                    for cand in range(t_check, e):
                        _, _, _, viol = _forward(ctx, sa, sm, cand, e, _const(OFF), lo, hi)
                        if not viol:
                            t_off = cand
                            break
                        sa, sm, _, _ = _forward(ctx, sa, sm, cand, cand + 1, _const(mode))
                    ta_off, tm_off = sa, sm
            
                    # reduced-output pre-conditioning segment of this block (if any); defined before the
                    # bridge decision because both paths emit it
                    soft_seg = None
                    if ctx.cap_frac < 1.0 and ctx.cap_until > on_t:
                        soft_seg = {"s": on_t, "e": min(ctx.cap_until, e), "kind": "cond", "cap": ctx.cap_frac,
                                    "reason": f"예열 (실내기 출력 {round(ctx.cap_frac * 100)}%, 실외기 용량 분담)", "sessions": []}
                    ctx.cap_frac, ctx.cap_until = 1.0, -1
            
                    bridge = False
                    if nxt is not None and gap is not None and 0 < gap <= gap_max and mode == COND:
                        # option A: keep running through the gap
                        ta_a, tm_a, e_a, _ = _forward(ctx, ta_off, tm_off, t_off, nxt["s"], _const(COND))
                        # option B: stop at t_off, restart with a quick lead estimate
                        best_b = None
                        for lead in (0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 45, 60):
                            if nxt["s"] - lead < t_off:
                                break
                            ta_b, tm_b, e_b, _ = _forward(ctx, ta_off, tm_off, t_off, nxt["s"], _switch(nxt["s"] - lead, OFF, COND))
                            if settings["sp_heat"] - 0.15 <= ta_b <= settings["sp_cool"] + 0.15:
                                best_b = e_b
                                break
                        if best_b is None or e_a < best_b:
                            bridge = True
                            add_dec(blk, **{"type": "bridge", "detail": f"공백 {gap}분: 계속 가동({e_a:.0f}Wh)이 재기동({(best_b or 0):.0f}Wh)보다 효율적",
                                              "saved_min": 0})
                    if bridge:
                        if soft_seg:
                            intervals.append(soft_seg)
                            on_t = soft_seg["e"]
                        # extend through the gap; next block starts with carry_on
                        ta, tm, _, _ = _forward(ctx, ta, tm, t_check, e, _const(mode))
                        cursor = e
                        intervals.append({"s": on_t, "e": e, "kind": "cond", "reason": "예측 최적화 (공백 유지)",
                                          "sessions": [x["id"] for x in blk["sessions"]], "_bridge": True})
                        ta, tm, _, _ = _forward(ctx, ta, tm, e, nxt["s"], _const(COND))
                        intervals.append({"s": e, "e": nxt["s"], "kind": "cond", "reason": "공백 유지 (재기동보다 효율적)", "sessions": []})
                        cursor = nxt["s"]
                        carry_on = True
                        continue
            
                    if e - t_off > rule_early:  # only count stops earlier than the rule would make anyway
                        add_dec(blk, **{"type": "early_stop", "detail": f"건물 열관성으로 종료 {e - t_off}분 전 정지해도 쾌적 유지",
                                          "saved_min": (e - t_off) - rule_early})
                    if soft_seg:
                        soft_seg["e"] = min(soft_seg["e"], t_off)
                        intervals.append(soft_seg)
                    intervals.append({"s": soft_seg["e"] if soft_seg else on_t, "e": t_off, "kind": "cond",
                                      "reason": "예측 최적화 (최적 기동·관성 정지)",
                                      "sessions": [x["id"] for x in blk["sessions"]]})
                    ta, tm = ta_off, tm_off
                    cursor = t_off
                    carry_on = False
            
                # merge adjacent cond intervals
                merged: list[dict] = []
                for iv in sorted(intervals, key=lambda x: x["s"]):
                    iv.pop("_bridge", None)
                    if (merged and iv["kind"] == merged[-1]["kind"] and iv.get("cap", 1.0) == merged[-1].get("cap", 1.0)
                            and iv["s"] <= merged[-1]["e"]):
                        merged[-1]["e"] = max(merged[-1]["e"], iv["e"])
                        merged[-1]["sessions"] = merged[-1].get("sessions", []) + iv.get("sessions", [])
                    else:
                        merged.append(iv)
                return merged, decisions
            
            
            def _odu_share(rooms: dict, r: str) -> float:
                """Fraction of rated IDU output a room can rely on when every room on its ODU runs at once."""
                from .config import ODUS
            
                odu = rooms[r]["odu"]
                connected = sum(sum(i["heat_kw"] for i in v["idus"]) for v in rooms.values() if v["odu"] == odu)
                return min(1.0, ODUS[odu]["cap_kw"] / connected) if connected else 1.0
            
            
            def plan_ai(sessions_by_room: dict, rooms: dict, weather_f: dict, init: dict, settings: dict):
                plans, decisions = {}, []
                for r in rooms:
                    ss = sessions_by_room.get(r, [])
                    if not ss:
                        plans[r] = []
                        continue
                    p, d = plan_ai_room(rooms[r], ss, weather_f["to"], weather_f["rh"], weather_f["ghi"], init[r], settings,
                                        odu_share=_odu_share(rooms, r))
                    plans[r] = p
                    decisions.extend(d)
                return plans, decisions
            --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

        📄 timetable.py
            --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
            """Timetable ingestion and expansion into dated sessions.
            
            Pipeline:
              raw grid CSV/Excel (30-min slots x weekday columns)  -> course blocks (weekly recurring)
              course blocks + semester calendar + holidays + events -> dated sessions
            """
            from __future__ import annotations
            
            import csv
            import hashlib
            import io
            import re
            from datetime import date, timedelta
            
            from .config import ATTENDANCE_BY_GRADE, HOLIDAYS, ROOMS, SEMESTER
            
            WEEKDAYS = ["월", "화", "수", "목", "금", "토", "일"]
            _CELL_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>.*)\((?P<code>[A-Z]{2}\d{6,8})\)-(?P<section>\w+)$")
            
            
            def hm_to_min(hm: str) -> int:
                h, m = hm.strip().split(":")[:2]
                return int(h) * 60 + int(m)
            
            
            def min_to_hm(m: int) -> str:
                m = int(round(m))
                return f"{m // 60:02d}:{m % 60:02d}"
            
            
            def parse_cell(cell: str) -> dict:
                """`자료구조(CB1501019)-062,조환규,컴퓨터공학전공,2학년` -> fields."""
                parts = [p.strip() for p in cell.split(",")]
                head = parts[0]
                m = _CELL_RE.match(head)
                if m:
                    name, code, section = m.group("name"), m.group("code"), m.group("section")
                else:
                    name, code, section = head, "", ""
                prof = parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else ""
                dept = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else ""
                grade = parts[3] if len(parts) > 3 else ""
                return {
                    "class_name": name.strip(),
                    "course_code": code,
                    "section": section,
                    "professor": prof,
                    "dept": dept,
                    "grade": grade,
                }
            
            
            def estimate_people(room: str, grade: str) -> int:
                cap = ROOMS.get(room, {}).get("capacity", 50)
                ratio = ATTENDANCE_BY_GRADE.get(grade, 0.75)
                return max(1, int(round(cap * ratio)))
            
            
            def _course_id(room: str, weekday: int, start: str, code: str, section: str, name: str) -> str:
                raw = f"{room}|{weekday}|{start}|{code}|{section}|{name}"
                return "C" + hashlib.sha1(raw.encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
            
            
            def grid_rows_to_courses(rows: list[dict], source: str) -> list[dict]:
                """Merge consecutive identical 30-min slots into weekly course blocks."""
                slots: dict[tuple[str, str, int], list[tuple[int, int, str]]] = {}
                building_of: dict[str, str] = {}
                for r in rows:
                    room = str(r.get("강의실번호", "")).strip()
                    if not room:
                        continue
                    building_of[room] = str(r.get("건물", "")).strip()
                    s, e = hm_to_min(str(r["시작시간"])), hm_to_min(str(r["종료시간"]))
                    for wd, label in enumerate(WEEKDAYS):
                        if label not in r:
                            continue
                        cell = str(r.get(label) or "").strip()
                        slots.setdefault((building_of[room], room, wd), []).append((s, e, cell))
            
                courses: list[dict] = []
                for (bld, room, wd), lst in slots.items():
                    lst.sort()
                    cur: list | None = None
                    blocks = []
                    for s, e, cell in lst:
                        if cell and cur and cur[2] == cell and cur[1] == s:
                            cur[1] = e
                        else:
                            if cur and cur[2]:
                                blocks.append(tuple(cur))
                            cur = [s, e, cell]
                    if cur and cur[2]:
                        blocks.append(tuple(cur))
                    for s, e, cell in blocks:
                        f = parse_cell(cell)
                        start, end = min_to_hm(s), min_to_hm(e)
                        courses.append(
                            {
                                "id": _course_id(room, wd, start, f["course_code"], f["section"], f["class_name"]),
                                "building": bld,
                                "room": room,
                                "weekday": wd,
                                "start": start,
                                "end": end,
                                **f,
                                "expected_people": estimate_people(room, f["grade"]),
                                "people_estimated": True,
                                "source": source,
                            }
                        )
                courses.sort(key=lambda c: (c["room"], c["weekday"], c["start"]))
                return courses
            
            
            def parse_grid_csv(text: str, source: str = "csv") -> list[dict]:
                text = text.lstrip("﻿")
                rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text)))
                rows = [{(k or "").lstrip("﻿").strip(): v for k, v in r.items()} for r in rows]
                return grid_rows_to_courses(rows, source)
            
            
            def parse_grid_xlsx(data: bytes, source: str = "excel") -> list[dict]:
                import openpyxl
            
                wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(io.BytesIO(data), read_only=True, data_only=True)
                ws = wb.active
                it = ws.iter_rows(values_only=True)
                header = [str(h or "").strip() for h in next(it)]
                rows = []
                for vals in it:
                    r = {}
                    for h, v in zip(header, vals):
                        if hasattr(v, "strftime"):
                            v = v.strftime("%H:%M")
                        r[h] = "" if v is None else str(v)
                    rows.append(r)
                if {"시작시간", "종료시간", "강의실번호"} <= set(header):
                    return grid_rows_to_courses(rows, source)
                return normalize_records(rows, source)
            
            
            _FIELD_ALIASES = {
                "building": ["building", "건물"],
                "room": ["room", "강의실", "강의실번호"],
                "weekday": ["weekday", "요일"],
                "date": ["date", "날짜", "일자"],
                "start": ["start", "start_time", "시작", "시작시간"],
                "end": ["end", "end_time", "종료", "종료시간"],
                "class_name": ["class_name", "과목", "과목명", "강의명", "title"],
                "professor": ["professor", "교수", "담당교수"],
                "expected_people": ["expected_people", "인원", "수강인원", "예상인원"],
                "grade": ["grade", "학년"],
            }
            
            
            def _pick(rec: dict, key: str):
                for a in _FIELD_ALIASES[key]:
                    if a in rec and rec[a] not in (None, ""):
                        return rec[a]
                return None
            
            
            def normalize_records(records: list[dict], source: str) -> list[dict]:
                """Normalise long-format records (API / DB / LLM extraction) into course blocks.
            
                Records with a weekday become weekly courses; records with a date are returned
                with `date` set so the caller can register them as one-off events.
                """
                out = []
                for rec in records:
                    room = str(_pick(rec, "room") or "").strip()
                    room = re.sub(r"[^0-9A-Za-z-]", "", room.replace("호", ""))
                    start, end = _pick(rec, "start"), _pick(rec, "end")
                    if not room or not start or not end:
                        continue
                    wd_raw = _pick(rec, "weekday")
                    wd = None
                    if wd_raw is not None:
                        s = str(wd_raw).strip()
                        if s and s[0] in WEEKDAYS:
                            wd = WEEKDAYS.index(s[0])
                        elif s.isdigit():
                            wd = int(s)
                    d = _pick(rec, "date")
                    grade = str(_pick(rec, "grade") or "")
                    people = _pick(rec, "expected_people")
                    est = people in (None, "")
                    name = str(_pick(rec, "class_name") or "수업")
                    start_s = min_to_hm(hm_to_min(str(start)))
                    end_s = min_to_hm(hm_to_min(str(end)))
                    item = {
                        "building": str(_pick(rec, "building") or "IT관"),
                        "room": room,
                        "weekday": wd,
                        "date": str(d) if d else None,
                        "start": start_s,
                        "end": end_s,
                        "class_name": name,
                        "course_code": str(rec.get("course_code") or ""),
                        "section": str(rec.get("section") or ""),
                        "professor": str(_pick(rec, "professor") or ""),
                        "dept": str(rec.get("dept") or ""),
                        "grade": grade,
                        "expected_people": int(float(people)) if not est else estimate_people(room, grade),
                        "people_estimated": est,
                        "source": source,
                    }
                    item["id"] = _course_id(room, wd if wd is not None else -1, start_s, item["course_code"], item["section"], name + (item["date"] or ""))
                    out.append(item)
                return out
            
            
            # ---------------------------------------------------------------- sessions
            
            def semester_dates(start: date | None = None, end: date | None = None) -> list[date]:
                s = start or SEMESTER["start"]
                e = end or SEMESTER["end"]
                out, d = [], s
                while d <= e:
                    out.append(d)
                    d += timedelta(days=1)
                return out
            
            
            def sessions_for_date(d: date, courses: list[dict], events: list[dict], holidays: dict | None = None) -> list[dict]:
                """Dated sessions for one day after applying holidays and events.
            
                Event types: add | cancel | move | closure.
                """
                holidays = HOLIDAYS if holidays is None else holidays
                iso = d.isoformat()
                sessions: list[dict] = []
                in_semester = SEMESTER["start"] <= d <= SEMESTER["end"]
                day_events = [e for e in events if e.get("date") == iso]
                closure = any(e["type"] == "closure" for e in day_events)
            
                if in_semester and d not in holidays and not closure:
                    wd = d.weekday()
                    for c in courses:
                        if c.get("weekday") != wd:
                            continue
                        sessions.append(
                            {
                                "id": f"{iso}:{c['id']}",
                                "date": iso,
                                "room": c["room"],
                                "start": c["start"],
                                "end": c["end"],
                                "title": c["class_name"],
                                "professor": c.get("professor", ""),
                                "kind": "lecture",
                                "course_id": c["id"],
                                "expected_people": c["expected_people"],
                                "people_estimated": c.get("people_estimated", False),
                            }
                        )
            
                for e in day_events:
                    t = e["type"]
                    if t == "cancel":
                        sessions = [
                            s
                            for s in sessions
                            if not (
                                (e.get("course_id") and s.get("course_id") == e["course_id"])
                                or (
                                    not e.get("course_id")
                                    and s["room"] == e.get("room")
                                    and _overlaps(s, e)
                                )
                            )
                        ]
                    elif t == "move":
                        for s in sessions:
                            if s.get("course_id") == e.get("course_id"):
                                s["room"] = e.get("new_room") or s["room"]
                                s["start"] = e.get("new_start") or s["start"]
                                s["end"] = e.get("new_end") or s["end"]
                                s["moved_by"] = e["id"]
                    elif t == "add":
                        sessions.append(
                            {
                                "id": f"{iso}:{e['id']}",
                                "date": iso,
                                "room": e["room"],
                                "start": e["start"],
                                "end": e["end"],
                                "title": e.get("title") or "이벤트",
                                "professor": e.get("host", ""),
                                "kind": "event",
                                "event_id": e["id"],
                                "expected_people": int(e.get("expected_people") or estimate_people(e["room"], "")),
                                "people_estimated": not e.get("expected_people"),
                            }
                        )
                sessions.sort(key=lambda s: (s["room"], s["start"]))
                return sessions
            
            
            def _overlaps(s: dict, e: dict) -> bool:
                if not e.get("start") or not e.get("end"):
                    return True
                return hm_to_min(s["start"]) < hm_to_min(e["end"]) and hm_to_min(e["start"]) < hm_to_min(s["end"])
            --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

        📄 weather.py
            --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
            """Weather acquisition: KMA (기상청 단기예보, 공공데이터포털) + Open-Meteo.
            
            Per date we keep two hourly series (24 values each):
              actual   - what happened (Open-Meteo archive/best-match, KMA 초단기실황 for the latest hour)
              forecast - what the planner saw (KMA 단기예보 snapshot if stored, else Open-Meteo forecast;
                         for dates beyond every forecast horizon: same date last year = climatology)
            """
            from __future__ import annotations
            
            import json
            import math
            import urllib.parse
            import urllib.request
            from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone
            
            KST = timezone(timedelta(hours=9))
            KMA_BASE = "https://apis.data.go.kr/1360000/VilageFcstInfoService_2.0"
            
            
            def now_kst() -> datetime:
                return datetime.now(KST)
            
            
            def kma_grid(lat: float, lon: float) -> tuple[int, int]:
                """Lambert conformal conic conversion used by KMA (DFS grid, 5 km)."""
                re_, grid, slat1, slat2, olon, olat, xo, yo = 6371.00877, 5.0, 30.0, 60.0, 126.0, 38.0, 43, 136
                d = math.pi / 180
                re = re_ / grid
                s1, s2, ol, oa = slat1 * d, slat2 * d, olon * d, olat * d
                sn = math.log(math.cos(s1) / math.cos(s2)) / math.log(
                    math.tan(math.pi * 0.25 + s2 * 0.5) / math.tan(math.pi * 0.25 + s1 * 0.5)
                )
                sf = math.tan(math.pi * 0.25 + s1 * 0.5) ** sn * math.cos(s1) / sn
                ro = re * sf / math.tan(math.pi * 0.25 + oa * 0.5) ** sn
                ra = re * sf / math.tan(math.pi * 0.25 + lat * d * 0.5) ** sn
                th = lon * d - ol
                if th > math.pi:
                    th -= 2 * math.pi
                if th < -math.pi:
                    th += 2 * math.pi
                th *= sn
                return int(ra * math.sin(th) + xo + 0.5), int(ro - ra * math.cos(th) + yo + 0.5)
            
            
            def _get_json(url: str, timeout: float = 20.0) -> dict:
                req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "hvac-ai/1.0"})
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
                    return json.loads(r.read().decode("utf-8"))
            
            
            # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Open-Meteo
            
            def _om_hourly(url: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
                js = _get_json(url)
                h = js["hourly"]
                out = {}
                for i, t in enumerate(h["time"]):
                    out[t[:13]] = {
                        "t": h["temperature_2m"][i],
                        "rh": h["relative_humidity_2m"][i],
                        "ghi": h["shortwave_radiation"][i],
                    }
                return out
            
            
            def open_meteo_archive(lat: float, lon: float, start: date, end: date) -> dict[str, dict]:
                q = urllib.parse.urlencode(
                    {
                        "latitude": lat,
                        "longitude": lon,
                        "start_date": start.isoformat(),
                        "end_date": end.isoformat(),
                        "hourly": "temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,shortwave_radiation",
                        "timezone": "Asia/Seoul",
                    }
                )
                return _om_hourly(f"https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive?{q}")
            
            
            def open_meteo_forecast(lat: float, lon: float, past_days: int = 7, forecast_days: int = 16) -> dict[str, dict]:
                q = urllib.parse.urlencode(
                    {
                        "latitude": lat,
                        "longitude": lon,
                        "hourly": "temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,shortwave_radiation",
                        "past_days": past_days,
                        "forecast_days": forecast_days,
                        "timezone": "Asia/Seoul",
                    }
                )
                return _om_hourly(f"https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?{q}")
            
            
            def open_meteo_previous_day1(lat: float, lon: float, start: date, end: date) -> dict[str, dict]:
                """Forecast issued the day before (planner's view for past dates)."""
                q = urllib.parse.urlencode(
                    {
                        "latitude": lat,
                        "longitude": lon,
                        "start_date": start.isoformat(),
                        "end_date": end.isoformat(),
                        "hourly": "temperature_2m_previous_day1,relative_humidity_2m_previous_day1,shortwave_radiation_previous_day1",
                        "timezone": "Asia/Seoul",
                    }
                )
                js = _get_json(f"https://previous-runs-api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?{q}")
                h = js["hourly"]
                out = {}
                for i, t in enumerate(h["time"]):
                    out[t[:13]] = {
                        "t": h["temperature_2m_previous_day1"][i],
                        "rh": h["relative_humidity_2m_previous_day1"][i],
                        "ghi": h["shortwave_radiation_previous_day1"][i],
                    }
