                interface Msg {
                  id: number
                  role: 'user' | 'assistant'
                  content: string
                  status?: 'running' | 'done' | 'error'
                  steps?: ChatStep[]
                  result?: ChatResult
                  error?: string
                  startedAt?: number
                  elapsed?: number
                }
                
                const SUGGESTIONS = [
                  '이번 주 에너지 낭비가 가장 큰 강의실과 이유는?',
                  '선행 가동을 5분으로 줄이면 어떻게 돼? 시뮬레이션해줘',
                  '다음 주 수요일 405호 18~21시 특강 일정 등록해줘',
                  '금요일 강의실 재배치로 얼마나 절감돼?',
                  '오늘 정합성 이슈가 있었어? 원인과 조치를 알려줘',
                  '난방 설정온도를 19.5℃로 낮추면 쾌적도는 괜찮을까?',
                ]
                
                const STORE_KEY = 'thermoplan.copilot.v1'
                let idSeq = Date.now()
                
                function stepInput(s: ChatStep): string {
                  const i = s.input || {}
                  const parts: string[] = []
                  if (typeof i.date === 'string') parts.push(i.date)
                  if (typeof i.room === 'string') parts.push(`${i.room}호`)
                  if (typeof i.start_date === 'string') parts.push(`${i.start_date}${i.days ? `부터 ${i.days}일` : i.end_date ? `~${i.end_date}` : ''}`)
                  if (i.overrides && typeof i.overrides === 'object')
                    parts.push(
                      Object.entries(i.overrides as Record<string, unknown>)
                        .map(([k, v]) => `${SETTING_LABEL[k] ?? k} ${v}`)
                        .join(', '),
                    )
                  if (typeof i.weekday === 'number') parts.push(`${WEEKDAY[i.weekday]}요일`)
                  if (typeof i.title === 'string') parts.push(i.title)
                  if (typeof i.text === 'string') parts.push(`“${i.text}”`)
                  return parts.join(', ')
                }
                
                export default function Copilot() {
                  const { open, setOpen, pending, consumePending } = useCopilot()
                  const { meta } = useMeta()
                  const [msgs, setMsgs] = useState<Msg[]>(() => {
                    try {
                      const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(STORE_KEY)
                      return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as Msg[]).filter((m) => m.status !== 'running') : []
                    } catch {
                      return []
                    }
                  })
                  const [input, setInput] = useState('')
                  const [, setTick] = useState(0)
                  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
                  const busy = msgs.some((m) => m.status === 'running')
                
                  useEffect(() => {
                    try {
                      sessionStorage.setItem(STORE_KEY, JSON.stringify(msgs.slice(-40)))
                    } catch {
                      /* quota */
                    }
                  }, [msgs])
                
                  useEffect(() => {
                    listRef.current?.scrollTo({ top: listRef.current.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' })
                  }, [msgs, open])
                
                  useEffect(() => {
                    if (!busy) return
                    const t = window.setInterval(() => setTick((x) => x + 1), 1000)
                    return () => window.clearInterval(t)
                  }, [busy])
                
                  const send = async (text: string) => {
                    const q = text.trim()
                    if (!q || busy) return
                    const user: Msg = { id: ++idSeq, role: 'user', content: q }
                    const asst: Msg = { id: ++idSeq, role: 'assistant', content: '', status: 'running', steps: [], startedAt: Date.now() }
                    const history = [...msgs.filter((m) => m.status !== 'error'), user]
                      .filter((m) => m.content)
                      .map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }))
                    setMsgs((x) => [...x, user, asst])
                    setInput('')
                    const patch = (p: Partial<Msg>) => setMsgs((x) => x.map((m) => (m.id === asst.id ? { ...m, ...p } : m)))
                    try {
                      const { job } = await apiSend<{ job: string }>('POST', '/api/chat', { messages: history })
                      const final = await pollJob<ChatResult>(
                        job,
                        (j: Job<ChatResult>) => {
                          if (j.progress?.steps) patch({ steps: j.progress.steps })
                        },
                        { intervalMs: 1500, timeoutMs: 180_000 },
                      )
                      if (final.status === 'error' || !final.result) {
                        patch({ status: 'error', error: final.error || '답변을 만들지 못했습니다. 질문을 조금 더 구체적으로 바꿔 다시 보내 보세요.', elapsed: Date.now() - asst.startedAt! })
                      } else {
                        patch({
                          status: 'done',
                          content: final.result.answer ?? '',
                          result: final.result,
                          steps: final.result.steps ?? [],
                          elapsed: Date.now() - asst.startedAt!,
                        })
                      }
                    } catch (e) {
                      patch({ status: 'error', error: (e as Error).message, elapsed: Date.now() - asst.startedAt! })
                    }
                  }
                
                  // prompts sent from other screens
                  useEffect(() => {
                    if (open && pending && !busy) {
                      const p = consumePending()
                      if (p) send(p)
                    }
                    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
                  }, [open, pending])
                
                  if (!open) return null
                
                  return (
                    <aside
                      className="slide-in fixed top-0 right-0 bottom-0 z-40 flex w-[440px] max-w-[100vw] flex-col border-l border-line bg-surface shadow-[var(--shadow-cover)] 2xl:shadow-none"
                      aria-label="AI 코파일럿"
                    >
                      <header className="flex h-16 shrink-0 items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-line px-5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <span className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] bg-ink text-[#7fd6a8]" aria-hidden>
                            <Sparkles size={16} />
                          </span>
                          <div className="text-[16px] font-[650] text-ink">AI 코파일럿</div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          {msgs.length > 0 && (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => !busy && setMsgs([])}
                              disabled={busy}
                              className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-[10px] px-2.5 text-[13px] font-medium text-ink-3 transition-colors hover:bg-hover hover:text-ink disabled:opacity-40"
                              title="대화를 지우고 새로 시작"
                            >
                              <RotateCcw size={15} aria-hidden /> 새 대화
                            </button>
                          )}
                          <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(false)} className="inline-flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-[10px] text-ink-3 transition-colors hover:bg-hover hover:text-ink" aria-label="코파일럿 닫기">
                            <X size={19} />
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </header>
                
                      <div ref={listRef} className="thin-scroll flex-1 space-y-6 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain px-5 py-5" aria-live="polite">
                        {msgs.length === 0 && (
                          <div className="pt-1">
                            <p className="text-[15px] leading-relaxed text-ink">무엇을 도와드릴까요?</p>
                            <p className="mt-1.5 text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">
                              운영 데이터와 시뮬레이터를 직접 조회해 답합니다. 규칙 변경과 일정 등록은 담당자가 확인을 눌러야 적용됩니다.
                            </p>
                            <ul className="mt-5 divide-y divide-line overflow-hidden rounded-[14px] border border-line">
                              {SUGGESTIONS.map((s) => (
                                <li key={s}>
                                  <button type="button" onClick={() => send(s)} className="w-full px-4 py-3 text-left text-[14px] text-ink transition-colors hover:bg-well">
                                    {s}
                                  </button>
                                </li>
                              ))}
                            </ul>
                            {meta && (
                              <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                                기준 시각 {fmtDateK(meta.now.date)}, 모델 {meta.models.sonnet?.replace('global.anthropic.', '')}
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {msgs.map((m) => (m.role === 'user' ? <UserBubble key={m.id} text={m.content} /> : <AssistantMsg key={m.id} m={m} onRetry={() => {
                          const idx = msgs.findIndex((x) => x.id === m.id)
                          const q = msgs[idx - 1]?.content
                          if (q) {
                            setMsgs((x) => x.filter((y) => y.id !== m.id && y.id !== msgs[idx - 1].id))
                            setTimeout(() => send(q), 0)
                          }
                        }} />))}
                      </div>
                
                      <div className="border-t border-line bg-surface px-4 pt-3 pb-4">
                        {msgs.length > 0 && !busy && (
                          <div className="thin-scroll mb-2.5 flex gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
                            {SUGGESTIONS.slice(0, 3).map((s) => (
                              <button
                                key={s}
                                type="button"
                                onClick={() => send(s)}
                                className="shrink-0 rounded-[8px] bg-well px-2.5 py-1 text-[13px] whitespace-nowrap text-ink-2 transition-colors hover:bg-hover hover:text-ink"
                              >
                                {s}
                              </button>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <form
                          className="flex items-end gap-2"
                          onSubmit={(e) => {
                            e.preventDefault()
                            send(input)
                          }}
                        >
                          <textarea
                            value={input}
                            onChange={(e) => setInput(e.target.value)}
                            onKeyDown={(e) => {
                              if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
                                e.preventDefault()
                                send(input)
                              }
                            }}
                            rows={2}
                            name="copilot-input"
                            aria-label="코파일럿에게 질문"
                            placeholder="질문이나 요청을 입력하세요… (Enter 보내기, Shift+Enter 줄바꿈)"
                            className="thin-scroll max-h-32 min-h-[48px] flex-1 resize-none rounded-[12px] border border-line-strong px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[14px] transition-[border-color,box-shadow] placeholder:text-ink-4 focus:border-focus focus:shadow-[0_0_0_3px_rgb(47_111_222/0.16)] focus-visible:outline-none"
                          />
                          <button
                            type="submit"
                            disabled={busy || !input.trim()}
                            className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-[12px] bg-ink text-white transition-colors hover:bg-[#25344e] disabled:opacity-40"
                            aria-label="보내기"
                          >
                            {busy ? <Spinner className="text-white" /> : <Send size={18} aria-hidden />}
                          </button>
                        </form>
                      </div>
                    </aside>
                  )
                }
                
                /** The backend appends its own "AI 연결이 불안정해서…" blockquote to cached answers; we show a quieter line instead. */
                function stripCacheNote(text: string) {
                  return text.replace(/\n*>\s*지금은 AI 연결이 불안정해서[^\n]*\s*$/, '')
                }
                
                function UserBubble({ text }: { text: string }) {
                  return (
                    <div className="flex justify-end">
                      <div className="max-w-[85%] rounded-[16px] rounded-br-[6px] bg-ink px-4 py-2.5 text-[14px] leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap text-white">{text}</div>
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                /** "시뮬레이션 2회 실행" / "데이터 3회 조회": the tool steps in one line. */
                function stepSummary(steps: ChatStep[]): string {
                  const sims = steps.filter((x) => x.tool === 'simulate_policy' || x.tool === 'propose_policy').length
                  const rest = steps.length - sims
                  const parts: string[] = []
                  if (sims) parts.push(`시뮬레이션 ${sims}회 실행`)
                  if (rest) parts.push(`데이터 ${rest}회 조회`)
                  return parts.join(', ')
                }
                
                function StepsLine({ steps, running, open, onToggle, secs }: { steps: ChatStep[]; running: boolean; open: boolean; onToggle: () => void; secs: number }) {
                  const last = steps[steps.length - 1]
                  return (
                    <div className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2 text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                      <span className="flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-[8px] bg-ink text-[#7fd6a8]" aria-hidden>
                        <Sparkles size={12} />
                      </span>
                      <span className="shrink-0 font-medium text-ink-2">코파일럿</span>
                      {running ? (
                        <span className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-1.5" role="status">
                          <Spinner size={13} />
                          <span className="truncate">{last ? `${TOOL_LABEL[last.tool] ?? last.tool} 중…` : '질문을 이해하는 중…'}</span>
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        steps.length > 0 && <span className="truncate">{stepSummary(steps)}</span>
                      )}
                      {steps.length > 0 && (
                        <button type="button" onClick={onToggle} aria-expanded={open} className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-0.5 rounded-[6px] px-1 font-medium text-ink-2 transition-colors hover:text-ink">
                          자세히
                          <ChevronDown size={13} className={cx('transition-transform duration-200', open && 'rotate-180')} aria-hidden />
                        </button>
                      )}
                      <span className="tnum ml-auto shrink-0">{running ? `${secs}초째` : `${secs}초`}</span>
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function StepsDetail({ steps, running }: { steps: ChatStep[]; running: boolean }) {
                  return (
                    <ol className="reveal space-y-1.5 rounded-[12px] bg-well px-3.5 py-3">
                      {steps.map((s, i) => (
                        <li key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2 text-[13px]">
                          {s.ok === false ? (
                            <XCircle size={14} className="mt-[2px] shrink-0 text-crit" aria-hidden />
                          ) : s.ok ? (
                            <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="mt-[2px] shrink-0 text-good" aria-hidden />
                          ) : (
                            <Spinner size={14} className="mt-[2px] shrink-0" />
                          )}
                          <span>
                            <span className="font-medium text-ink">{TOOL_LABEL[s.tool] ?? s.tool}</span>
                            {stepInput(s) && <span className="text-ink-3"> {stepInput(s)}</span>}
                          </span>
                        </li>
                      ))}
                      {running && (
                        <li className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                          <Spinner size={14} /> {steps.length ? '결과를 해석하는 중…' : '질문을 이해하고 필요한 데이터를 고르는 중…'}
                        </li>
                      )}
                    </ol>
                  )
                }
                
                function AssistantMsg({ m, onRetry }: { m: Msg; onRetry: () => void }) {
                  const running = m.status === 'running'
                  const [showSteps, setShowSteps] = useState(false)
                  const secs = Math.round(((m.elapsed ?? (m.startedAt ? Date.now() - m.startedAt : 0)) as number) / 1000)
                  const r = m.result
                  return (
                    <div className="space-y-2.5">
                      <StepsLine steps={m.steps ?? []} running={running} open={showSteps} onToggle={() => setShowSteps((v) => !v)} secs={secs} />
                      {showSteps && <StepsDetail steps={m.steps ?? []} running={running} />}
                      {m.status === 'error' && (
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-[12px] bg-crit-bg px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] text-crit-ink" role="alert">
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <AlertTriangle size={15} aria-hidden /> {m.error}
                          </span>
                          <Button size="sm" onClick={onRetry}>
                            다시 시도
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {r?.from_cache && (
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-1.5 rounded-[10px] bg-well px-3 py-2 text-[13px] text-ink-2">
                          <History size={13} className="mt-[3px] shrink-0 text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
                          AI 연결이 불안정해 {r.cached_at ? fmtTs(r.cached_at) : '이전'}에 같은 질문으로 받은 답을 보여 줍니다. 수치가 지금과 다를 수 있습니다.
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {m.content && (
                        <div className="md pl-8 text-[14px] text-ink">
                          <ReactMarkdown
                            remarkPlugins={[[remarkGfm, { singleTilde: false }]]}
                            components={{
                              table: ({ children }) => (
                                <div className="table-wrap">
                                  <table>{children}</table>
                                </div>
                              ),
                              a: ({ children, href }) => (
                                <a href={href} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="font-medium text-info-ink underline">
                                  {children}
                                </a>
                              ),
                            }}
                          >
                            {r?.from_cache ? stripCacheNote(m.content) : m.content}
                          </ReactMarkdown>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {r?.simulations && r.simulations.length > 0 && <SimGroup sims={r.simulations} />}
                      {r?.proposals?.map((p, i) => <ProposalCard key={i} p={p} />)}
                      {r?.event_drafts?.map((d, i) => <DraftCard key={i} d={d} />)}
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function SimGroup({ sims }: { sims: WhatIf[] }) {
                  const [all, setAll] = useState(false)
                  const shown = all ? sims : sims.slice(0, 2)
                  return (
                    <div className="space-y-1.5 pl-8">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-0.5 text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                        <span>시뮬레이션 결과 {sims.length}건</span>
                        {sims.length > 2 && (
                          <button type="button" className="font-semibold text-ink hover:underline" onClick={() => setAll((v) => !v)}>
                            {all ? '접기' : `모두 보기 (+${sims.length - 2})`}
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {shown.map((s, i) => (
                        <SimCard key={i} wi={s} />
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function SimCard({ wi }: { wi: WhatIf }) {
                  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false)
                  return (
                    <div className="rounded-[12px] border border-line bg-surface">
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)} aria-expanded={open} className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-3.5 py-2.5 text-left text-[13.5px]">
                        <FlaskConical size={14} className="text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
                        <span className="shrink-0 font-medium whitespace-nowrap text-ink">시뮬레이션</span>
                        <span className="truncate text-ink-3">
                          {Object.entries(wi.overrides)
                            .map(([k, v]) => `${SETTING_LABEL[k] ?? k} ${v}`)
                            .join(', ')}{' '}
                          ({wi.dates[0]?.slice(5)}~{wi.dates[wi.dates.length - 1]?.slice(5)})
                        </span>
                        <ChevronDown size={14} className={cx('ml-auto shrink-0 text-ink-3 transition-transform duration-200', open && 'rotate-180')} aria-hidden />
                      </button>
                      {open && (
                        <div className="reveal border-t border-line px-3.5 pb-2.5">
                          <WhatIfTable wi={wi} compact />
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function ProposalCard({ p }: { p: Proposal }) {
                  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState(false)
                  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
                  const [done, setDone] = useState(false)
                  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
                  const { meta, reload } = useMeta()
                  const apply = async () => {
                    setBusy(true)
                    setErr(null)
                    try {
                      await apiSend('PUT', '/api/settings', p.overrides)
                      invalidateAll()
                      reload()
                      setDone(true)
                      toast('제안한 운영 규칙을 적용했습니다. 운전 계획을 다시 계산합니다.')
                    } catch (e) {
                      // e.g. 400: setpoint too close to the comfort band; shown on the card, not in a toast
                      setErr((e as Error).message)
                    } finally {
                      setBusy(false)
                      setConfirm(false)
                    }
                  }
                  return (
                    <div className={cx('ml-8 rounded-[14px] border bg-surface p-4', done ? 'border-[#bfe3cf]' : 'border-line')}>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] font-semibold text-info-ink">
                        <SlidersHorizontal size={13} aria-hidden /> 운영 규칙 변경 제안
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1 text-[15px] font-semibold text-ink">{p.title}</div>
                      <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                        {Object.entries(p.overrides).map(([k, v]) => (
                          <Badge key={k} tone="info">
                            {SETTING_LABEL[k] ?? k}: {meta ? `${String(meta.settings[k])} → ` : ''}
                            {String(v)}
                          </Badge>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-2.5 rounded-[10px] bg-well px-3 py-2 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
                        <b className="font-semibold text-ink">예상 효과</b> {p.expected_effect}
                      </div>
                      <Disclosure variant="inline" className="mt-2" title="근거 보기">
                        <p className="text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">{p.rationale}</p>
                      </Disclosure>
                      {err && (
                        <div className="mt-2 flex items-start gap-1.5 rounded-[10px] bg-crit-bg px-3 py-2 text-[13.5px] text-crit-ink" role="alert">
                          <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-[3px] shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                          <span>
                            적용하지 못했습니다. {err}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div className="mt-2.5 flex justify-end">
                        {done ? (
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[13.5px] font-medium text-good-ink">
                            <CheckCircle2 size={15} aria-hidden /> 적용됨
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <Button variant="primary" size="sm" onClick={() => setConfirm(true)}>
                            적용
                          </Button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <Modal
                        open={confirm}
                        onClose={() => setConfirm(false)}
                        title="운영 규칙 적용"
                        footer={
                          <>
                            <Button onClick={() => setConfirm(false)}>취소</Button>
                            <Button variant="primary" onClick={apply} disabled={busy}>
                              {busy ? <Spinner className="text-white" /> : <CheckCircle2 size={14} />} 적용
                            </Button>
                          </>
                        }
                      >
                        <p className="text-[14px] text-ink-2">
                          <b className="text-ink">{p.title}</b>: 아래 값으로 운영 규칙을 바꾸고 운전 계획을 다시 계산합니다. 변경 기록에 남으며 운영 규칙 화면에서 되돌릴 수 있습니다.
                        </p>
                        <ul className="mt-2 space-y-1">
                          {Object.entries(p.overrides).map(([k, v]) => (
                            <li key={k} className="flex justify-between rounded-[10px] bg-well px-3 py-2 text-[14px]">
                              <span>{SETTING_LABEL[k] ?? k}</span>
                              <span className="tnum font-medium">
                                {meta ? String(meta.settings[k]) : '?'} → {String(v)}
                              </span>
                            </li>
                          ))}
                        </ul>
                      </Modal>
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function DraftCard({ d }: { d: EventDraft }) {
                  const [draft, setDraft] = useState<EventDraft>({ ...d, clarification: undefined })
                  const [edit, setEdit] = useState(false)
                  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
                  const [res, setRes] = useState<EventResult | null>(null)
                  // the editable form runs its own check; the summary view checks here
                  const checked = useEventCheck(edit || res ? null : draft, d.check)
                  const register = async () => {
                    setBusy(true)
                    try {
                      const r = await apiSend<EventResult>('POST', '/api/events', eventBody(draft))
                      setRes(r)
                      invalidateAll()
                      toast('일정을 등록하고 운전 계획을 다시 계산했습니다.')
                    } catch (e) {
                      toast((e as Error).message, 'crit')
                    } finally {
                      setBusy(false)
                    }
                  }
                  const wd = draft.date ? WEEKDAY[weekdayOf(draft.date)] : ''
                  return (
                    <div className="ml-8 rounded-[14px] border border-line bg-surface p-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] font-semibold text-event-ink">
                        <CalendarPlus size={13} aria-hidden /> 일정 초안: {EVENT_TYPE[draft.type] ?? draft.type}
                      </div>
                      {d.from_cache && !res && (
                        <div className="mt-1.5 text-[13px] text-ink-3">AI 연결이 불안정해 {d.cached_at ? fmtTs(d.cached_at) : '앞서'} 해석한 결과입니다.</div>
                      )}
                      {d.clarification && !res && (
                        <div className="mt-2 flex items-start gap-1.5 rounded-[10px] bg-warn-bg px-3 py-2 text-[13.5px] text-warn-ink">
                          <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-[3px] shrink-0" aria-hidden /> {d.clarification}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {res ? (
                        <div className="mt-2">
                          <BeforeAfter r={res} />
                        </div>
                      ) : edit ? (
                        <div className="mt-2">
                          <EventForm draft={draft} onChange={setDraft} saving={busy} onSave={register} onCancel={() => setEdit(false)} compact />
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <>
                          <dl className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-[64px_1fr] gap-y-1.5 text-[14px]">
                            <dt className="text-ink-3">날짜</dt>
                            <dd className="font-medium text-ink">
                              {draft.date} ({wd})
                            </dd>
                            {draft.room && (
                              <>

                                  {draft.room}호{draft.new_room ? ` → ${draft.new_room}호` : ''}
                                </dd>
                              </>
                            )}
                            {draft.start && (
                              <>
                                <dt className="text-ink-3">시간</dt>
                                <dd className="font-medium text-ink">
                                  {draft.start}–{draft.end}
                                </dd>
                              </>
                            )}
                            {draft.title && (
                              <>
                                <dt className="text-ink-3">내용</dt>
                                <dd className="font-medium text-ink">{draft.title}</dd>
                              </>
                            )}
                            {draft.expected_people != null && (
                              <>
                                <dt className="text-ink-3">인원</dt>
                                <dd className="font-medium text-ink">{draft.expected_people}명</dd>
                              </>
                            )}
                          </dl>
                          <div className="mt-3">
                            <EventCheckPanel
                              compact
                              draft={draft}
                              result={checked}
                              onPickRoom={(r) => setDraft((x) => ({ ...x, ...(x.type === 'move' ? { new_room: r } : { room: r }), check: undefined }))}
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-3 flex justify-end gap-1.5">
                            <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => setEdit(true)}>
                              <Pencil size={13} aria-hidden /> 수정
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant={checked.check && !checked.check.ok ? 'danger' : 'primary'}
                              onClick={register}
                              disabled={busy || checked.checking}
                            >
                              {busy ? <Spinner size={14} className="text-white" /> : <CheckCircle2 size={14} aria-hidden />} {checked.check && !checked.check.ok ? '문제를 알고 등록' : '등록'}
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        </>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                }

                import ReactEChartsCore from 'echarts-for-react/lib/core'
                import * as echarts from 'echarts/core'
                import { BarChart, LineChart, ScatterChart } from 'echarts/charts'
                import { GridComponent, TooltipComponent, MarkAreaComponent, MarkLineComponent, AxisPointerComponent } from 'echarts/components'
                import { CanvasRenderer } from 'echarts/renderers'
                import type { EChartsOption } from 'echarts'
                import { CHART } from '../lib/constants'
                
                // only what the screens draw: lines, bars, one scatter; legends are HTML (see ChartCard)
                echarts.use([BarChart, LineChart, ScatterChart, GridComponent, TooltipComponent, MarkAreaComponent, MarkLineComponent, AxisPointerComponent, CanvasRenderer])
                
                export type { EChartsOption }
                
                export const FONT = '"Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif'
                
                /** Shared chrome: recessive hairline grid, muted axis text, white tooltip with value-first rows. */
                export const baseTooltip = {
                  backgroundColor: '#ffffff',
                  borderColor: '#e1e6ec',
                  borderWidth: 1,
                  padding: [10, 13],
                  textStyle: { color: CHART.ink, fontSize: 13, fontFamily: FONT },
                  extraCssText: 'box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(20,32,51,0.12); border-radius: 12px;',
                }
                
                export const axisCommon = {
                  axisLine: { lineStyle: { color: CHART.axis } },
                  axisTick: { show: false },
                  axisLabel: { color: CHART.muted, fontSize: 12, fontFamily: FONT },
                  splitLine: { lineStyle: { color: CHART.grid, width: 1 } },
                }
                
                /** tooltip row with a short line key (series color) — value leads, label follows */
                export function ttRow(color: string, label: string, value: string, kind: 'line' | 'rect' = 'line') {
                  const key =
                    kind === 'line'
                      ? `<span style="display:inline-block;width:12px;height:3px;border-radius:2px;background:${color};margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle"></span>`
                      : `<span style="display:inline-block;width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;background:${color};margin-right:6px;vertical-align:middle"></span>`
                  return `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;line-height:1.7">
                    <span style="color:#4a5668">${key}${escapeHtml(label)}</span><b style="color:#142033;font-weight:650;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${value}</b></div>`
                }
                
                export function ttTitle(t: string) {
                  return `<div style="font-weight:650;color:#142033;margin-bottom:5px;font-size:13.5px">${escapeHtml(t)}</div>`
                }
                
                export function escapeHtml(s: string) {
                  return s.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (c) => ({ '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;', "'": '&#39;' })[c] as string)
                }
                
                function reducedMotion() {
                  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
                }
                
                export default function EChart({
                  option,
                  height = 280,
                  onEvents,
                  className,
                  notMerge = true,
                }: {
                  option: EChartsOption
                  height?: number
                  onEvents?: Record<string, (params: unknown) => void>
                  className?: string
                  notMerge?: boolean
                }) {
                  return (
                    <ReactEChartsCore
                      echarts={echarts}
                      option={{ animation: !reducedMotion(), animationDuration: 300, textStyle: { fontFamily: FONT }, ...option }}
                      notMerge={notMerge}
                      lazyUpdate
                      style={{ height, width: '100%' }}
                      className={className}
                      onEvents={onEvents}
                      opts={{ renderer: 'canvas' }}
                    />
                  )
                }

            📄 ErrorBoundary.tsx
                --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
                import { Component, type ErrorInfo, type ReactNode } from 'react'
                import { AlertTriangle, RotateCw } from 'lucide-react'
                
                /** 을/를 by the last syllable's final consonant */
                function objectParticle(word: string) {
                  const c = word.charCodeAt(word.length - 1)
                  if (c < 0xac00 || c > 0xd7a3) return '를'
                  return (c - 0xac00) % 28 ? '을' : '를'
                }
                
                /**
                 * Keeps one bad payload from blanking the app: the failing area shows what happened and how to recover,
                 * the rest of the screen (sidebar, top bar, copilot) keeps working.
                 */
                export default class ErrorBoundary extends Component<{ children: ReactNode; area: string; compact?: boolean; wrapClassName?: string }, { error: Error | null }> {
                  state: { error: Error | null } = { error: null }
                
                  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error) {
                    return { error }
                  }
                
                  componentDidCatch(error: Error, info: ErrorInfo) {
                    console.error(`[${this.props.area}]`, error, info.componentStack)
                  }
                
                  render() {
                    const { error } = this.state
                    if (!error) return this.props.children
                    return (
                      <div className={this.props.wrapClassName ?? (this.props.compact ? 'p-4' : 'py-10')} role="alert">
                        <div className="mx-auto max-w-[560px] rounded-[16px] border border-[#efc6c6] bg-surface p-6">
                          <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                            <span className="flex h-9 w-9 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-crit-bg text-crit" aria-hidden>
                              <AlertTriangle size={17} />
                            </span>
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <div className="text-[17px] font-[650] text-ink">
                                {this.props.area}
                                {objectParticle(this.props.area)} 표시하지 못했습니다
                              </div>
                              <p className="mt-1.5 text-[14px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">
                                서버에서 받은 데이터 중 화면이 예상하지 못한 값이 있습니다. 다시 시도해도 같으면 다른 화면으로 이동했다가 돌아오거나 새로고침하세요.
                              </p>
                              <p className="mt-3 rounded-[10px] bg-well px-3 py-2 text-[13px] break-all text-ink-3">{error.message || String(error)}</p>
                              <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] bg-ink px-4 text-[14px] font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-[#25344e]"
                                  onClick={() => this.setState({ error: null })}
                                >
                                  <RotateCw size={14} aria-hidden /> 다시 시도
                                </button>
                                <button
                                  type="button"
                                  className="inline-flex h-10 items-center rounded-[10px] border border-line-strong bg-surface px-4 text-[14px] font-medium text-ink transition-colors hover:bg-hover"
                                  onClick={() => window.location.reload()}
                                >
                                  새로고침
                                </button>
                              </div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )
                  }
                }

            📄 EventCheck.tsx
                --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
                import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
                import { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Fan, Info, Users } from 'lucide-react'
                import { apiSend } from '../lib/api'
                import { hm, cx } from '../lib/format'
                import type { EventCheck, EventDraft } from '../lib/types'
                import { Badge, Button, Disclosure, Spinner } from './ui'
                import type { EventCheck as Check } from '../lib/types'
                
                /** The fields /api/events/check needs, or null while the draft is still incomplete. */
                export function checkBody(d: EventDraft): Record<string, unknown> | null {
                  if (!d.date) return null
                  if (d.type === 'add' && (!d.room || !d.start || !d.end || hm(d.end) <= hm(d.start))) return null
                  if (d.type === 'cancel' && !d.course_id) return null
                  if (d.type === 'move' && (!d.course_id || !d.new_room)) return null
                  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {}
                  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(d)) if (!CLIENT_ONLY.includes(k) && v !== null && v !== undefined && v !== '') out[k] = v
                  return out
                }
                
                const CLIENT_ONLY = ['check', 'clarification', 'from_cache', 'cached_at']
                
                /** Payloads are guarded: missing lists become empty, a missing verdict is treated as not ok. */
                export function normCheck(c: unknown): EventCheck | null {
                  if (!c || typeof c !== 'object') return null
                  const x = c as Partial<EventCheck>
                  return {
                    ok: x.ok === true,
                    conflicts: Array.isArray(x.conflicts) ? x.conflicts : [],
                    capacity_ok: x.capacity_ok !== false,
                    capacity: x.capacity && typeof x.capacity === 'object' ? x.capacity : null,
                    alternatives: Array.isArray(x.alternatives) ? x.alternatives : [],
                    note: typeof x.note === 'string' ? x.note : null,
                    alternatives_note: typeof x.alternatives_note === 'string' ? x.alternatives_note : null,
                    target: Array.isArray(x.target) ? x.target : [],
                  }
                }
                
                /** Draft without client-only fields, ready for POST /api/events. */
                export function eventBody(d: EventDraft): Record<string, unknown> {
                  const body: Record<string, unknown> = { ...d }
                  for (const k of CLIENT_ONLY) delete body[k]
                  return body
                }
                
                /**
                 * Re-checks conflicts, capacity and alternative rooms 600 ms after the draft stops changing.
                 * `initial` (the check returned with a parsed draft) is used as-is while the draft is unchanged.
                 */
                export function useEventCheck(draft: EventDraft | null, initialRaw?: EventCheck | null) {
                  const body = draft ? checkBody(draft) : null
                  const key = body ? JSON.stringify(body) : ''
                  // parse responses may omit `target` for cancel/move; re-check those so the target class is shown
                  const needsTarget = draft?.type === 'cancel' || draft?.type === 'move'
                  const initial = initialRaw && !(needsTarget && !Array.isArray(initialRaw.target)) ? initialRaw : null
                  const [state, setState] = useState<{ key: string; check: EventCheck | null; error: string | null }>(() => ({
                    key: initial && body ? key : '',
                    check: normCheck(initial),
                    error: null,
                  }))
                  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
                  const seq = useRef(0)
                
                  useEffect(() => {
                    if (!key || state.key === key) return
                    const id = ++seq.current
                    setBusy(true)
                    const t = window.setTimeout(async () => {
                      try {
                        const r = await apiSend<unknown>('POST', '/api/events/check', JSON.parse(key))
                        if (seq.current === id) setState({ key, check: normCheck(r), error: null })
                      } catch (e) {
                        if (seq.current === id) setState({ key, check: null, error: (e as Error).message })
                      } finally {
                        if (seq.current === id) setBusy(false)
                      }
                    }, 600)
                    return () => window.clearTimeout(t)
                    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
                  }, [key])
                
                  const current = !!key && state.key === key
                  return {
                    complete: !!key,
                    checking: !!key && (busy || !current),
                    check: current ? state.check : null,
                    error: current ? state.error : null,
                  }
                }
                
                const VERDICT: Record<string, string> = {
                  add: '겹치는 일정 없음',
                  cancel: '휴강할 강의를 확인했습니다. 등록하면 그 시간에는 냉난방을 켜지 않습니다.',
                  move: '옮길 강의실이 그 시간에 비어 있습니다',
                  closure: '휴관으로 등록하면 그날 냉난방을 켜지 않습니다',
                }
                
                /** Conflicts, capacity and free rooms ranked by extra energy; "이 강의실로 변경" rewrites the draft. */
                export function EventCheckPanel({
                  draft,
                  result,
                  onPickRoom,
                  compact = false,
                }: {
                  draft: EventDraft
                  result: ReturnType<typeof useEventCheck>
                  onPickRoom: (room: string) => void
                  compact?: boolean
                }) {
                  const { complete, checking, check, error } = result
                  if (!complete)
                    return (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-[12px] bg-well px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">
                        <Info size={14} aria-hidden /> 날짜{draft.type === 'add' ? ', 강의실, 시간' : draft.type === 'closure' ? '' : ', 대상 강의'}를 채우면 겹치는 일정과 정원을 확인합니다.
                      </div>
                    )
                  if (checking && !check)
                    return (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-[12px] bg-well px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2" role="status">
                        <Spinner size={14} /> 겹치는 일정과 정원을 확인하는 중…
                      </div>
                    )
                  if (error)
                    return (
                      <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-[12px] bg-crit-bg px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] text-crit-ink" role="alert">
                        <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-[3px] shrink-0" aria-hidden /> 겹치는 일정을 확인하지 못했습니다. {error}
                      </div>
                    )
                  if (!check) return null
                
                  const cap = check.capacity
                  const requested = check.alternatives.find((a) => a.requested)
                  const others = check.alternatives.filter((a) => !a.requested)
                  const cheaper = requested ? others.filter((a) => a.extra_kwh < requested.extra_kwh - 0.05) : others
                  const target = draft.type === 'move' ? draft.new_room : draft.room
                  const problems = check.conflicts.length > 0 || !check.capacity_ok
                  const showAlts = problems ? others : check.ok ? cheaper : []
                
                  return (
                    <div className={cx('space-y-3 transition-opacity duration-200', checking && 'opacity-60')} aria-live="polite">
                      {/* verdict: conflicts/capacity, or another reason (note), or all clear */}
                      {problems ? (
                        <div className="space-y-1.5 rounded-[12px] bg-crit-bg px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] text-crit-ink" role="alert">
                          {check.conflicts.map((c, i) => (
                            <div key={i} className="flex items-start gap-2">
                              <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-[3px] shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                              <span>
                                <b className="font-semibold">{c.room}호</b>에 같은 시간 {c.kind === 'event' ? '일정' : '강의'}이 있습니다:{' '}
                                <span className="tnum">
                                  {c.title} {c.start}–{c.end}
                                </span>
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                          {!check.capacity_ok && cap && (
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-2">
                              <Users size={14} className="mt-[3px] shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                              <span className="tnum">
                                예상 {cap.expected_people}명이 {cap.room}호 정원 {cap.capacity}명을 넘습니다.
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                          {check.note && <div className="pl-[22px]">{check.note}</div>}
                        </div>
                      ) : !check.ok ? (
                        <div className="flex items-start gap-2 rounded-[12px] bg-crit-bg px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] text-crit-ink" role="alert">
                          <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-[3px] shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                          <span>{check.note || '이 일정은 확인되지 않았습니다. 날짜와 대상 강의를 다시 확인하세요.'}</span>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="space-y-1 rounded-[12px] bg-good-bg px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px] text-good-ink">
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1">
                            <CheckCircle2 size={14} className="shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                            <span className="font-semibold">{VERDICT[draft.type] ?? '겹치는 일정 없음'}</span>
                            {cap && cap.expected_people != null && (
                              <span className="tnum">
                                정원 안 ({cap.expected_people}/{cap.capacity}명)
                              </span>
                            )}
                            {requested && <span className="tnum text-ink-2">이 강의실을 쓰면 AI 운전 전력 +{requested.extra_kwh.toFixed(2)} kWh</span>}
                          </div>
                          {check.note && <div className="pl-[22px] text-ink-2">{check.note}</div>}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {(check.target ?? []).length > 0 && (
                        <div className="tnum flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-2 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
                          <span className="font-semibold text-ink">{draft.type === 'move' ? '옮길 강의' : '취소 대상'}</span>
                          {(check.target ?? []).map((t, i) => (
                            <span key={i}>
                              {t.room}호 {t.start}–{t.end} {t.title}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      )}
                
                      {/* alternatives: with a problem the best free room is shown with its action, the rest one click away */}
                      {showAlts.length > 0 &&
                        (problems ? (
                          <div>
                            <div className="mb-1.5 text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink-2">
                              그 시간에 비어 있고 정원이 맞는 강의실 <span className="font-normal text-ink-3">추가 전력이 적은 순</span>
                            </div>
                            <AltList alts={showAlts.slice(0, 1)} target={target} onPickRoom={onPickRoom} />
                            {showAlts.length > 1 && (
                              <Disclosure variant="inline" className="mt-1.5" title={`다른 빈 강의실 ${(compact ? showAlts.slice(1, 3) : showAlts.slice(1)).length}곳 보기`}>
                                <AltList alts={compact ? showAlts.slice(1, 3) : showAlts.slice(1)} target={target} onPickRoom={onPickRoom} />
                                {check.alternatives_note && !compact && <p className="mt-1.5 text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink-3">{check.alternatives_note}</p>}
                              </Disclosure>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <Disclosure variant="inline" title={`전기를 더 적게 쓰는 빈 강의실 ${(compact ? showAlts.slice(0, 3) : showAlts).length}곳 보기`}>
                            <AltList alts={compact ? showAlts.slice(0, 3) : showAlts} target={target} onPickRoom={onPickRoom} />
                            {check.alternatives_note && !compact && <p className="mt-1.5 text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink-3">{check.alternatives_note}</p>}
                          </Disclosure>
                        ))}
                      {checking && (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] text-ink-3" role="status">
                          <Spinner size={13} /> 바뀐 내용으로 다시 확인하는 중…
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function AltList({ alts, target, onPickRoom }: { alts: Check['alternatives']; target: string | undefined | null; onPickRoom: (room: string) => void }) {
                  return (
                    <ul className="divide-y divide-line overflow-hidden rounded-[12px] border border-line">
                      {alts.map((a) => (
                        <li key={a.room} className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-surface px-3.5 py-2.5 text-[13.5px]">
                          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                            <div className="text-ink">
                              <b className="font-semibold">{a.room}호</b>{' '}
                              <span className="text-ink-3">
                                {a.type}, {a.capacity}석
                              </span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2 gap-y-1">
                              <span className="tnum text-ink-2">
                                추가 전력 {a.extra_kwh >= 0 ? '+' : '−'}
                                {Math.abs(a.extra_kwh).toFixed(2)} kWh
                              </span>
                              {a.odu_already_on && (
                                <Badge tone="ai" title={`${a.odu}가 그 시간에 이미 가동 중이라 함께 쓰면 효율적입니다`}>
                                  <Fan size={12} aria-hidden /> {a.odu.replace('ODU-', '실외기 ')} 이미 가동
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          {a.room === target ? (
                            <Badge tone="outline">선택됨</Badge>
                          ) : (
                            <Button size="sm" onClick={() => onPickRoom(a.room)}>
                              이 강의실로 변경
                            </Button>
                          )}
                        </li>
                      ))}
                    </ul>
                  )
                }
