                function WaterfallSection({ A, attr, broken }: { A: AttributionScope | undefined; attr: ReturnType<typeof useAttribution>; broken: boolean }) {
                  const [asTable, setAsTable] = useState(false)
                  const [detail, setDetail] = useState(false)
                  return (
                    <div>
                      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-[17px] font-[650] tracking-[-0.01em] text-ink">
                          AI 절감은 어디서 오는가
                          {attr.stale && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] font-normal text-ink-3" title="이전 결과를 보여 주면서 최신 입력으로 다시 계산하고 있습니다">
                              <Spinner size={13} /> 갱신 중
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </h2>
                        {A && <TableToggle asTable={asTable} onToggle={() => setAsTable((v) => !v)} />}
                      </div>
                      {A && attr.data ? (
                        asTable ? (
                          <DataTable spec={waterfallTable(A)} />
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-5 gap-y-1.5 text-[13px] text-ink-2">
                              <WaterfallLegend />
                            </div>
                            <div className={cx('transition-opacity duration-200', attr.stale && 'opacity-70')}>
                              <Waterfall A={A} note={attr.data.note ?? ''} detail={detail} />
                            </div>
                            <Disclosure variant="inline" className="mt-4" title={detail ? '단계별 쾌적 지표 접기' : '단계별 쾌적 지표와 계산 방법 보기'} open={detail} onOpenChange={setDetail}>
                              <p className="max-w-[90ch] text-[13.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-2">{splitNote(attr.data.note ?? '').method} 막대 위 숫자는 앞 단계 대비 전력 변화입니다.</p>
                            </Disclosure>
                          </>
                        )
                      ) : attr.error || broken ? (
                        <ErrorBox title="기능별 절감 분석을 불러오지 못했습니다" error={attr.error ?? '서버 응답에 필요한 값이 빠져 있습니다. 잠시 뒤 다시 시도하세요.'} onRetry={attr.reload} />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="space-y-3" role="status">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[14px] text-ink-2">
                            <Spinner size={15} /> 학기 전체를 기능별로 다시 시뮬레이션하는 중입니다. 처음 한 번은 1분 정도 걸리고, 10초마다 확인합니다.
                          </div>
                          <Skeleton className="h-[300px]" />
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                /** Strategies as columns: one comparison table instead of four identical cards. */
                function StrategyTable({ T, cold }: { T: Record<StrategyKey, TotalsRow>; cold: Record<StrategyKey, number> }) {
                  const order: StrategyKey[] = ['ai', 'rule', 'manual', 'fixed']
                  const maxKwh = Math.max(...order.map((k) => T[k].kwh))
                  const minOf = (f: (k: StrategyKey) => number) => Math.min(...order.map(f))
                  const rows: { label: string; cell: (k: StrategyKey) => React.ReactNode; best?: (k: StrategyKey) => boolean }[] = [
                    {
                      label: '전력량',
                      cell: (k) => (
                        <div>
                          <div>
                            <b className="text-[16px] font-[650] text-ink">{fmtNum(T[k].kwh)}</b> <span className="text-ink-3">kWh</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="mt-2 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#eceff3]" aria-hidden>
                            <div className="h-1.5 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${(T[k].kwh / maxKwh) * 100}%`, background: STRATEGY[k].color }} />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      ),
                    },
                    { label: '고정 스케줄 대비', cell: (k) => (k === 'fixed' ? <span className="text-ink-3">비교 기준</span> : <span className="font-semibold text-good-ink">−{pctSaving(T.fixed.kwh, T[k].kwh)?.toFixed(1)}%</span>) },
                    { label: '전기요금', cell: (k) => `${fmtNum(T[k].cost_krw)}원`, best: (k) => T[k].cost_krw === minOf((x) => T[x].cost_krw) },
                    { label: '탄소 배출', cell: (k) => `${(T[k].co2_kg / 1000).toFixed(2)} tCO₂`, best: (k) => T[k].co2_kg === minOf((x) => T[x].co2_kg) },
                    { label: '최대 전력', cell: (k) => `${T[k].peak_kw.toFixed(1)} kW`, best: (k) => T[k].peak_kw === minOf((x) => T[x].peak_kw) },
                    { label: '강의 중 쾌적 유지율', cell: (k) => fmtPct(T[k].comfort_pct, 2) },
                    { label: COLD_START.label, cell: (k) => `${fmtNum(cold[k])}회`, best: (k) => cold[k] === Math.min(...order.map((x) => cold[x])) },
                    { label: '불쾌 누적', cell: (k) => `${fmtNum(T[k].discomfort_dm, 0)} ℃·분`, best: (k) => T[k].discomfort_dm === minOf((x) => T[x].discomfort_dm) },
                  ]
                  return (
                    <div>
                      <p className="mb-4 text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">같은 시간표와 날씨로 네 가지 방식을 시뮬레이션했습니다. 굵은 값이 그 항목에서 가장 좋은 방식입니다.</p>
                      <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-[12px] border border-line">
                        <table className="tnum w-full min-w-[760px] table-fixed text-[14px]">
                          <colgroup>
                            <col className="w-[180px]" />
                            {order.map((k) => (
                              <col key={k} />
                            ))}
                          </colgroup>
                          <thead>
                            <tr>
                              <th className="border-b border-line px-5 py-3 text-left">
                                <span className="sr-only">항목</span>
                              </th>
                              {order.map((k) => (
                                <th key={k} className={cx('border-b border-line px-4 py-3 text-left align-bottom font-semibold', k === 'ai' && 'bg-[#f3faf6]')}>
                                  <StrategyName k={k} />
                                </th>
                              ))}
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                            {rows.map((r) => (
                              <tr key={r.label} className="border-b border-line last:border-b-0">
                                <th className="px-5 py-3 text-left text-[13.5px] font-medium text-ink-2">{r.label}</th>
                                {order.map((k) => (
                                  <td key={k} className={cx('px-4 py-3 text-ink', k === 'ai' && 'bg-[#f3faf6]', r.best?.(k) && 'font-semibold')}>
                                    {r.cell(k)}
                                  </td>
                                ))}
                              </tr>
                            ))}
                            <tr>
                              <th className="px-5 py-3 text-left align-top text-[13.5px] font-medium text-ink-2">운전 방식</th>
                              {order.map((k) => (
                                <td key={k} className={cx('px-4 py-3 align-top text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink-3', k === 'ai' && 'bg-[#f3faf6]')}>
                                  {STRATEGY[k].desc}
                                </td>
                              ))}
                            </tr>
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function DailyChart({ S }: { S: Summary }) {
                  const days = S.days.filter((d) => d.sessions > 0)
                  const todayIdx = days.findIndex((d) => d.date > S.today)
                  const option = useMemo<EChartsOption>(() => {
                    const cats = days.map((d) => d.date)
                    const futureStart = todayIdx >= 0 ? cats[todayIdx] : null
                    return {
                      grid: [
                        { left: 48, right: 20, top: 16, height: 230 },
                        { left: 48, right: 20, top: 290, height: 80 },
                      ],
                      axisPointer: { link: [{ xAxisIndex: 'all' }], lineStyle: { color: CHART.muted } },
                      tooltip: {
                        ...baseTooltip,
                        trigger: 'axis',
                        formatter: (ps: unknown) => {
                          const arr = ps as { seriesName: string; value: number; color: string; dataIndex: number }[]
                          if (!arr.length) return ''
                          const d = days[arr[0].dataIndex]
                          let h = ttTitle(`${fmtDateShort(d.date)} (${'월화수목금토일'[d.weekday]})${d.date > S.today ? ', 예상' : ''}`)
                          for (const k of ['ai', 'rule', 'manual', 'fixed'] as StrategyKey[]) h += ttRow(STRATEGY[k].color, STRATEGY[k].label, `${fmtKwh(d.strategies[k].kwh)} kWh`)
                          h += ttRow(CHART.outdoor, '외기 평균', `${d.t_mean.toFixed(1)}℃ (${d.t_min.toFixed(0)}~${d.t_max.toFixed(0)})`)
                          return h
                        },
                      },
                      xAxis: [
                        { type: 'category', data: cats, gridIndex: 0, ...axisCommon, axisLabel: { show: false }, axisTick: { show: false } },
                        {
                          type: 'category',
                          data: cats,
                          gridIndex: 1,
                          ...axisCommon,
                          axisLabel: { ...axisCommon.axisLabel, formatter: (v: string) => fmtDateShort(v), interval: 'auto' },
                        },
                      ],
                      yAxis: [
                        { type: 'value', gridIndex: 0, name: 'kWh/일', ...axisCommon, nameTextStyle: { color: CHART.muted, fontSize: 12, align: 'left' }, axisLine: { show: false } },
                        {
                          type: 'value',
                          gridIndex: 1,
                          name: '외기 ℃',
                          ...axisCommon,
                          nameTextStyle: { color: CHART.muted, fontSize: 12, align: 'left' },
                          axisLine: { show: false },
                          splitNumber: 2,
                        },
                      ],
                      series: [
                        ...(['fixed', 'manual', 'rule', 'ai'] as StrategyKey[]).map((k) => ({
                          name: STRATEGY[k].label,
                          type: 'line' as const,
                          xAxisIndex: 0,
                          yAxisIndex: 0,
                          showSymbol: false,
                          lineStyle: { width: 2, color: STRATEGY[k].color },
                          itemStyle: { color: STRATEGY[k].color },
                          data: days.map((d) => d.strategies[k].kwh),
                          z: k === 'ai' ? 6 : 3,
                          ...(k === 'fixed' && futureStart
                            ? {
                                markArea: {
                                  silent: true,
                                  itemStyle: { color: 'rgba(20,32,51,0.035)' },
                                  label: { show: true, position: 'insideTop' as const, color: CHART.muted, fontSize: 12, formatter: '예보·평년 기반 예상' },
                                  data: [[{ xAxis: futureStart }, { xAxis: cats[cats.length - 1] }]] as never,
                                },
                              }
                            : {}),
                        })),
                        {
                          name: '최저~최고',
                          type: 'line',
                          xAxisIndex: 1,
                          yAxisIndex: 1,
                          stack: 'tband',
                          showSymbol: false,
                          lineStyle: { opacity: 0 },
                          data: days.map((d) => d.t_min),
                          tooltip: { show: false },
                        },
                        {
                          name: '기온 범위',
                          type: 'line',
                          xAxisIndex: 1,
                          yAxisIndex: 1,
                          stack: 'tband',
                          showSymbol: false,
                          lineStyle: { opacity: 0 },
                          areaStyle: { color: 'rgba(138,148,163,0.22)' },
                          data: days.map((d) => +(d.t_max - d.t_min).toFixed(1)),
                          tooltip: { show: false },
                        },
                        {
                          name: '외기 평균',
                          type: 'line',
                          xAxisIndex: 1,
                          yAxisIndex: 1,
                          showSymbol: false,
                          lineStyle: { width: 1.5, color: CHART.outdoor },
                          itemStyle: { color: CHART.outdoor },
                          data: days.map((d) => d.t_mean),
                        },
                      ] as never,
                    }
                  }, [days, todayIdx, S.today])
                
                  return (
                    <ChartCard
                      bare
                      sub="강의일만 표시합니다. 냉방철(9월)과 난방철(11~12월) 사이 간절기에는 AI가 외기 냉방과 가동 생략으로 전력을 크게 줄입니다."
                      legend={
                        <>
                          {(['ai', 'rule', 'manual', 'fixed'] as StrategyKey[]).map((k) => (
                            <LegendItem key={k} color={STRATEGY[k].color} label={STRATEGY[k].label} kind="line" />
                          ))}
                          <LegendItem color={CHART.outdoor} label="외기 평균, 띠는 최저~최고 (아래 칸)" kind="line" />
                        </>
                      }
                      table={{
                        columns: ['날짜', 'AI', '규칙', '수동', '고정', '외기 평균℃'],
                        rows: days.map((d) => [
                          `${d.date}${d.date > S.today ? ' (예상)' : ''}`,
                          d.strategies.ai.kwh.toFixed(1),
                          d.strategies.rule.kwh.toFixed(1),
                          d.strategies.manual.kwh.toFixed(1),
                          d.strategies.fixed.kwh.toFixed(1),
                          d.t_mean.toFixed(1),
                        ]),
                      }}
                    >
                      <EChart option={option} height={392} />
                    </ChartCard>
                  )
                }
                
                function CumulativeChart({ S }: { S: Summary }) {
                  const option = useMemo<EChartsOption>(() => {
                    let a = 0
                    let b = 0
                    const vsFixed: number[] = []
                    const vsRule: number[] = []
                    for (const d of S.days) {
                      a += d.strategies.fixed.kwh - d.strategies.ai.kwh
                      b += d.strategies.rule.kwh - d.strategies.ai.kwh
                      vsFixed.push(+a.toFixed(1))
                      vsRule.push(+b.toFixed(1))
                    }
                    const cats = S.days.map((d) => d.date)
                    return {
                      grid: { left: 52, right: 64, top: 28, bottom: 28 },
                      tooltip: {
                        ...baseTooltip,
                        trigger: 'axis',
                        formatter: (ps: unknown) => {
                          const arr = ps as { seriesName: string; value: number; color: string; axisValue: string }[]
                          let h = ttTitle(`${arr[0].axisValue}까지 누적${arr[0].axisValue > S.today ? ' (예상)' : ''}`)
                          for (const p of arr) h += ttRow(p.color, p.seriesName, `${fmtNum(p.value)} kWh`)
                          return h
                        },
                      },
                      xAxis: { type: 'category', data: cats, ...axisCommon, axisLabel: { ...axisCommon.axisLabel, formatter: (v: string) => fmtDateShort(v) } },
                      yAxis: {
                        type: 'value',
                        name: '누적 절감 kWh',
                        min: (v: { min: number }) => Math.floor(Math.min(0, v.min) / 100) * 100,
                        ...axisCommon,
                        nameTextStyle: { color: CHART.muted, fontSize: 12, align: 'left' },
                        axisLine: { show: false },
                      },
                      series: [
                        {
                          name: '고정 스케줄 대비',
                          type: 'line',
                          showSymbol: false,
                          lineStyle: { width: 2, color: STRATEGY.fixed.color },
                          itemStyle: { color: STRATEGY.fixed.color },
                          areaStyle: { color: 'rgba(86,90,96,0.06)' },
                          data: vsFixed,
                          endLabel: { show: true, formatter: (p: { value: number }) => `${fmtNum(p.value)}`, color: CHART.ink, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600 },
                          markLine: {
                            silent: true,
                            symbol: 'none',
                            lineStyle: { color: CHART.ink, width: 1, type: 'solid' },
                            label: { formatter: '오늘', color: CHART.ink2, fontSize: 12, position: 'end', rotate: 0 },
                            data: [{ xAxis: S.today }],
                          },
                        },
                        {
                          name: '규칙 기반 대비',
                          type: 'line',
                          showSymbol: false,
                          lineStyle: { width: 2, color: STRATEGY.rule.color },
                          itemStyle: { color: STRATEGY.rule.color },
                          data: vsRule,
                          endLabel: { show: true, formatter: (p: { value: number }) => `${fmtNum(p.value)}`, color: CHART.ink, fontSize: 12, fontWeight: 600 },
                        },
                      ] as never,
                    }
                  }, [S])
                  const last = S.days.length - 1
                  return (
                    <ChartCard
                      bare
                      sub="AI 예측 제어가 각 방식보다 덜 쓴 전력을 쌓아 올린 값입니다. 오늘 이후는 예상입니다."
                      legend={
                        <>
                          <LegendItem color={STRATEGY.fixed.color} label="고정 스케줄 대비" kind="line" />
                          <LegendItem color={STRATEGY.rule.color} label="규칙 기반 대비" kind="line" />
                        </>
                      }
                      table={{
                        columns: ['기준', '오늘까지 누적 kWh', '학기 말 예상 kWh'],
                        rows: [
                          ['고정 스케줄 대비', +(S.totals.to_date.fixed.kwh - S.totals.to_date.ai.kwh).toFixed(1), +(S.totals.all.fixed.kwh - S.totals.all.ai.kwh).toFixed(1)],
                          ['규칙 기반 대비', +(S.totals.to_date.rule.kwh - S.totals.to_date.ai.kwh).toFixed(1), +(S.totals.all.rule.kwh - S.totals.all.ai.kwh).toFixed(1)],
                        ],
                      }}
                      footer={
                        <div className="mt-2 text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                          {S.days[last] && `학기 말(${fmtDateShort(S.days[last].date)})까지 고정 대비 ${fmtNum(S.totals.all.fixed.kwh - S.totals.all.ai.kwh)} kWh, 규칙 대비 ${fmtNum(S.totals.all.rule.kwh - S.totals.all.ai.kwh)} kWh 절감 예상`}
                        </div>
                      }
                    >
                      <EChart option={option} height={260} />
                    </ChartCard>
                  )
                }
                
                type Pt = { key: string; name: string; short: string; kwh: number; comfort: number; cold: number | null; dm: number; color: string; symbol: string; pos: string }
                
                const RULE_VARIANTS: { v: AttributionVariant; name: string; short: string; symbol: string; pos: string }[] = [
                  { v: 'rule', name: '규칙 기반(10분 전)', short: '규칙 10분 전', symbol: 'circle', pos: 'top' },
                  { v: 'rule_vacancy', name: '규칙 기반 + 재실 감지', short: '+재실 감지', symbol: 'triangle', pos: 'bottom' },
                  { v: 'rule30', name: '규칙 기반(30분 전)', short: '규칙 30분 전', symbol: 'diamond', pos: 'right' },
                ]
                
                function ScatterChart({ T, A, scope }: { T: Record<StrategyKey, TotalsRow>; A: AttributionScope | undefined; scope: Scope }) {
                  // with the attribution run: fixed, three rule variants and AI (same comfort metric everywhere); otherwise the four strategies
                  const pts = useMemo<Pt[]>(() => {
                    if (A) {
                      const V = A.variants
                      return [
                        ...(V.fixed ? [{ key: 'fixed', name: '고정 스케줄', short: '고정', kwh: V.fixed.kwh, comfort: V.fixed.comfort_pct ?? 0, cold: V.fixed.cold_starts, dm: V.fixed.discomfort_dm, color: STRATEGY.fixed.color, symbol: 'circle', pos: 'left' }] : []),
                        ...RULE_VARIANTS.filter((r) => V[r.v]).map((r) => ({
                          key: r.v,
                          name: r.name,
                          short: r.short,
                          kwh: V[r.v].kwh,
                          comfort: V[r.v].comfort_pct ?? 0,
                          cold: V[r.v].cold_starts,
                          dm: V[r.v].discomfort_dm,
                          color: STRATEGY.rule.color,
                          symbol: r.symbol,
                          pos: r.pos,
                        })),
                        { key: 'ai', name: 'AI 예측 제어', short: 'AI', kwh: V.ai.kwh, comfort: V.ai.comfort_pct ?? 0, cold: V.ai.cold_starts, dm: V.ai.discomfort_dm, color: STRATEGY.ai.color, symbol: 'circle', pos: 'top' },
                      ]
                    }
                    return STRATEGY_KEYS.map((k) => ({
                      key: k,
                      name: STRATEGY[k].label,
                      short: STRATEGY[k].short,
                      kwh: T[k].kwh,
                      comfort: T[k].comfort_pct ?? 0,
                      cold: null,
                      dm: T[k].discomfort_dm,
                      color: STRATEGY[k].color,
                      symbol: 'circle',
                      pos: k === 'fixed' ? 'left' : k === 'rule' ? 'right' : 'top',
                    }))
                  }, [A, T])
                  const option = useMemo<EChartsOption>(() => {
                    const minC = Math.min(...pts.map((p) => p.comfort))
                    const ai = pts.find((p) => p.key === 'ai')
                    return {
                      grid: { left: 44, right: 24, top: 28, bottom: 44 },
                      tooltip: {
                        ...baseTooltip,
                        trigger: 'item',
                        formatter: (p: unknown) => {
                          const q = (p as { data: { p: Pt } }).data.p
                          return (
                            ttTitle(q.name) +
                            ttRow(q.color, '전력량', `${fmtNum(q.kwh, 1)} kWh`, 'rect') +
                            ttRow(q.color, '쾌적 유지율', fmtPct(q.comfort, 2), 'rect') +
                            (q.cold != null ? ttRow(q.color, COLD_START.label, `${fmtNum(q.cold)}회`, 'rect') : '') +
                            ttRow(q.color, '불쾌 누적', `${fmtNum(q.dm)} ℃·분`, 'rect')
                          )
                        },
                      },
                      xAxis: { type: 'value', name: '전력량 (kWh), 적을수록 좋음', nameLocation: 'middle', nameGap: 28, min: 0, ...axisCommon, nameTextStyle: { color: CHART.muted, fontSize: 12 } },
                      yAxis: {
                        type: 'value',
                        name: '강의 중 쾌적 유지율 (%), 높을수록 좋음',
                        min: Math.floor(minC - 0.4),
                        max: 100.4,
                        ...axisCommon,
                        nameTextStyle: { color: CHART.muted, fontSize: 12, align: 'left' },
                        axisLabel: { ...axisCommon.axisLabel, formatter: (v: number) => (v > 100 ? '' : `${v}`) },
                      },
                      series: [
                        {
                          type: 'scatter',
                          symbolSize: (_: unknown, p: { data: { p: Pt } }) => (p.data.p.symbol === 'circle' ? 14 : 16),
                          itemStyle: { borderColor: '#ffffff', borderWidth: 2 },
                          data: pts.map((q) => ({
                            p: q,
                            value: [q.kwh, q.comfort],
                            symbol: q.symbol,
                            itemStyle: { color: q.color },
                            label: { show: true, formatter: q.short, position: q.pos, color: CHART.ink, fontSize: 13, fontWeight: q.key === 'ai' ? 650 : 400, distance: 9 },
                          })),
                          markArea: ai
                            ? {
                                silent: true,
                                itemStyle: { color: 'rgba(20,166,115,0.07)' },
                                label: { show: true, position: 'insideBottomLeft', color: CHART.ink2, fontSize: 12, formatter: '적게 쓰고 쾌적한 영역' },
                                data: [[{ xAxis: 0, yAxis: 99.5 }, { xAxis: ai.kwh * 1.12, yAxis: 100.4 }]] as never,
                              }
                            : undefined,
                        },
                      ] as never,
                    }
                  }, [pts])
                  return (
                    <ChartCard
                      bare
                      sub={`${scope === 'all' ? '학기 전체(예상)' : '오늘까지'} 기준입니다. 왼쪽 위로 갈수록 적게 쓰고 쾌적한 운전이며, 규칙 기반은 켜는 시점과 재실 감지를 바꾼 경우도 함께 놓았습니다.`}
                      legend={
                        <>
                          <LegendItem color={STRATEGY.fixed.color} label="고정 스케줄" kind="dot" />
                          {RULE_VARIANTS.map((r) => (
                            <span key={r.v} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap">
                              <svg width="11" height="11" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden>
                                {r.symbol === 'circle' && <circle cx="6" cy="6" r="5" fill={STRATEGY.rule.color} />}
                                {r.symbol === 'diamond' && <path d="M6 0.5 11.5 6 6 11.5 0.5 6z" fill={STRATEGY.rule.color} />}
                                {r.symbol === 'triangle' && <path d="M6 1 11.5 11H0.5z" fill={STRATEGY.rule.color} />}
                              </svg>
                              {r.name}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                          <LegendItem color={STRATEGY.ai.color} label="AI 예측 제어" kind="dot" />
                        </>
                      }
                      table={{
                        columns: ['운전 방식', '전력량 kWh', '쾌적 유지율 %', `${COLD_START.label}(회)`, '불쾌 누적 ℃·분'],
                        rows: pts.map((q) => [q.name, q.kwh, q.comfort, q.cold, q.dm]),
                      }}
                    >
                      <EChart option={option} height={300} />
                    </ChartCard>
                  )
                }
                
                function DecisionChart({ S }: { S: Summary }) {
                  const entries = Object.entries(S.decisions).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])
                  const total = entries.reduce((a, [, v]) => a + v, 0)
                  const max = Math.max(1, ...entries.map(([, v]) => v))
                  return (
                    <ChartCard
                      bare
                      sub={`학기 전체 ${fmtNum(total)}회입니다. 강의마다 열모델로 판단합니다.`}
                      table={{ columns: ['판단', '횟수'], rows: entries.map(([k, v]) => [DECISION[k]?.label ?? k, v]) }}
                    >
                      <ul className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-10 gap-y-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
                        {entries.map(([k, v]) => (
                          <li key={k}>
                            <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-center justify-between text-[14px]">
                              <span className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-ink">
                                <span className="flex h-5 w-5 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-ink text-white" aria-hidden>
                                  <DecisionIcon type={k} size={10} />
                                </span>
                                {DECISION[k]?.label ?? k}
                              </span>
                              <span className="tnum font-semibold text-ink">{fmtNum(v)}회</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-[#eceff3]" title={`${DECISION[k]?.label}: ${v}회`}>
                              <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-s-ai" style={{ width: `${(v / max) * 100}%` }} />
                            </div>
                            <div className="mt-1.5 text-[13px] text-ink-3">{DECISION[k]?.desc}</div>
                          </li>
                        ))}
                      </ul>
                    </ChartCard>
                  )
                }
                
                function ConsolidationReport() {
                  const c = useApi<Consolidation>('/api/consolidation', { maxAgeMs: 10 * 60_000 })
                  // stale: the previous result is shown while the backend recomputes; check again shortly
                  const stale = !!c.data?.stale
                  const { reload: reloadC } = c
                  useEffect(() => {
                    if (!stale) return
                    const t = window.setTimeout(reloadC, 10_000)
                    return () => window.clearTimeout(t)
                  }, [stale, reloadC, c.data])
                  const { ask } = useCopilot()
                  const { meta } = useMeta()
                  const withMoves = (Array.isArray(c.data?.weekdays) ? c.data.weekdays : []).filter((w) => Array.isArray(w.moves) && w.moves.length > 0)
                  return (
                    <div>
                      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <p className="max-w-[72ch] text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">같은 유형이고 정원이 맞으며 그 시간에 비어 있는 강의실로 옮겨, 같은 실외기에 강의를 모읍니다.</p>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                          {stale && (
                            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px] text-ink-3" title="이전 결과를 보여 주면서 최신 시간표로 다시 계산하고 있습니다">
                              <Spinner size={13} /> 갱신 중
                            </span>
                          )}
                          <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => ask('금요일 강의실 재배치로 얼마나 절감돼? 이유와 함께 설명해줘')}>
                            <Sparkles size={14} aria-hidden /> 코파일럿에게 설명 듣기
                          </Button>
                          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => window.print()}>
                            <Printer size={14} aria-hidden /> 인쇄
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {c.error ? (
                        <ErrorBox error={c.error} onRetry={c.reload} />
                      ) : !c.data ? (
                        <Loading label="요일별 재배치안을 학기 전체로 다시 시뮬레이션하는 중… (5초 정도 걸립니다)" />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="space-y-4">
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-8 gap-y-3 rounded-[12px] bg-well px-5 py-4">
                            <Figure label="학기 예상 추가 절감" value={fmtNum(c.data.semester_kwh_saving, 1)} unit="kWh" size="sm" />
                            <div className="hidden h-10 w-px bg-line-strong sm:block" />
                            <div className="text-[14px] text-ink-2">
                              <div>
                                권고 이동 <b className="font-semibold text-ink">{withMoves.reduce((a, w) => a + w.moves.length, 0)}건</b>, 대상 요일{' '}
                                <b className="font-semibold text-ink">{withMoves.map((w) => w.weekday_label).join('·') || '없음'}</b>
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-[13px] text-ink-3">쾌적 유지율은 그대로이고, AI 운전 기준으로 다시 시뮬레이션한 값입니다.</div>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          {withMoves.length === 0 && <div className="text-[14px] text-ink-2">현재 시간표에서는 옮겨서 아낄 수 있는 강의가 없습니다.</div>}
                          {withMoves.map((w) => (
                            <div key={w.weekday} className="overflow-hidden rounded-[12px] border border-line">
                              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-line bg-well px-4 py-3">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink">
                                  매주 {w.weekday_label}요일
                                  <span className="font-normal text-ink-3">학기 중 {w.dates}회</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="tnum flex items-center gap-3 text-[13px] text-ink-2">
                                  <span>
                                    {fmtNum(w.kwh_before, 1)} → <b className="text-ink">{fmtNum(w.kwh_after, 1)} kWh</b>
                                  </span>
                                  <Badge tone="good">
                                    −{fmtNum(w.kwh_saving, 1)} kWh ({fmtPct(w.saving_pct)})
                                  </Badge>
                                  {w.odu_minutes_before != null && w.odu_minutes_after != null && (
                                    <span className="text-ink-3">
                                      실외기 가동 {fmtNum(w.odu_minutes_before / 60, 1)}h → {fmtNum(w.odu_minutes_after / 60, 1)}h
                                    </span>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              <table className="tnum w-full text-[14px]">
                                <thead className="text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                                  <tr>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-2 text-left font-medium">강의</th>
                                    <th className="px-2 py-2 text-left font-medium">시간</th>
                                    <th className="px-2 py-2 text-left font-medium">이동</th>
                                    <th className="px-2 py-2 text-left font-medium">실외기</th>
                                    <th className="px-4 py-2 text-right font-medium">인원/정원</th>
                                  </tr>
                                </thead>
                                <tbody>
                                  {w.moves.map((m) => (
                                    <tr key={m.course_id + m.start} className="border-t border-line">
                                      <td className="px-4 py-2">
                                        <div className="font-medium text-ink">{m.title}</div>
                                        <div className="text-[13px] text-ink-3">{m.professor}</div>
                                      </td>
                                      <td className="px-2 py-2 text-ink-2">
                                        {m.start}–{m.end}
                                      </td>
                                      <td className="px-2 py-2">
                                        <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 font-semibold text-ink">
                                          {m.from_room}호 <MoveRight size={13} className="text-ink-3" /> {m.to_room}호
                                        </span>
                                        <div className="text-[13px] text-ink-3">{meta?.rooms[m.to_room]?.type_label}</div>
                                      </td>
                                      <td className="px-2 py-2 text-[13px] whitespace-nowrap text-ink-2">
                                        {m.from_odu.replace('ODU-', '')} <MoveRight size={11} className="inline text-ink-3" aria-label="에서" /> {m.to_odu.replace('ODU-', '')}
                                      </td>
                                      <td className="px-4 py-2 text-right text-ink-2">
                                        {m.expected_people}/{m.capacity}명
                                      </td>
                                    </tr>
                                  ))}
                                </tbody>
                              </table>
                            </div>
                          ))}
                          <p className="text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-3">{c.data.note}</p>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                }

                // ---------------------------------------------------------------- the one-sentence summary (computed, no LLM)
                
                const MODE_VERB: Record<string, string> = { heat: '난방하며', cool: '냉방하며', air: '송풍(외기 냉방)으로 식히며' }
                
                /** "지금 강의실 2곳을 난방하며 수업 중인 2곳은 모두 쾌적하고, 다음 AI 조치는 13:11 405호 최적 기동입니다." */
                function summarize(state: BuildingState, meta: Meta, day: Day | undefined, minute: number, ref: 'now' | 'replay' | 'scrub'): string {
                  const lo = meta.settings.comfort_low
                  const hi = meta.settings.comfort_high
                  const running = state.rooms.filter((r) => r.mode !== 'off')
                  const occupied = state.rooms.filter((r) => r.session)
                  const outBand = occupied.filter((r) => Number.isFinite(r.ta) && (r.ta < lo || r.ta > hi))
                  const modes = [...new Set(running.map((r) => r.mode))]
                  const prefix = ref === 'now' ? '지금 ' : ref === 'replay' ? `${fmtMin(minute)} 현재 ` : `${fmtMin(minute)}에는 `
                  const rooms = (rs: { room: string }[]) => rs.map((r) => `${r.room}호`).join(', ')
                
                  let a = ''
                  if (running.length) {
                    a = `강의실 ${running.length}곳을 ${modes.length === 1 ? MODE_VERB[modes[0]] : '가동하며'} `
                    if (!occupied.length) a += '수업 전 미리 맞추고 있고'
                    else if (!outBand.length) a += occupied.length === 1 ? `수업 중인 ${occupied[0].room}호는 쾌적하고` : `수업 중인 ${occupied.length}곳은 모두 쾌적하고`
                    else a += `수업 중인 ${rooms(outBand)}가 아직 쾌적 범위 밖이고`
                  } else if (occupied.length) {
                    a = outBand.length
                      ? `수업 중인 ${rooms(outBand)}가 쾌적 범위 밖이고`
                      : occupied.length === 1
                        ? `수업 중인 ${occupied[0].room}호가 가동 없이도 쾌적하고`
                        : `수업 중인 ${occupied.length}곳이 가동 없이도 쾌적하고`
                  } else {
                    a = '모든 강의실이 정지해 있고'
                  }
                
                  let b = '이후 예정된 AI 조치는 없습니다.'
                  if (day) {
                    const plan = day.strategies.ai?.plan ?? {}
                    const next = day.decisions
                      .map((d) => ({ d, m: decisionMinute(d, plan[d.room]) }))
                      .filter((x) => x.m > minute)
                      .sort((x, y) => x.m - y.m)[0]
                    if (next) b = `다음 AI 조치는 ${fmtMin(next.m)} ${next.d.room}호 ${decisionLabel(next.d.type)}입니다.`
                    else if (!day.sessions.some((s) => hm(s.end) > minute)) b = '오늘 남은 강의는 없습니다.'
                  } else {
                    b = ''
                  }
                  return `${prefix}${a}${b ? `, ${b}` : '.'}`
                }
                
                /** What the drawer shows under "지금": this room's state and its outdoor unit at the shown minute. */
                function roomNow(state: BuildingState, meta: Meta, room: string, minute: number, label: string) {
                  const r = state.rooms.find((x) => x.room === room)
                  if (!r) return undefined
                  const oduId = meta.rooms[room]?.odu
                  const odu = oduId ? state.odus[oduId] : undefined
                  return { ...r, minute, label, odu: odu && oduId ? { id: oduId, ...odu } : undefined }
                }
                
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------- key figures (basis on click)
                
                function KeyFigures({ L, at }: { L: Live; at: boolean }) {
                  const ds = L.date_summary
                  const so = L.kwh_so_far
                  const ai = so.ai
                  const svFixed = pctSaving(so.fixed, ai)
                  // compare whole days (cold starts are per day), not the so-far totals
                  const dayDiff = ds.strategies.ai.kwh - ds.strategies.rule.kwh
                  const coldRule = ds.strategies.rule.cold_starts
                  const coldAi = ds.strategies.ai.cold_starts
                  const when = at ? '이 시각까지' : '지금까지'
                  const row = (k: StrategyKey, v: string, strong = false) => (
                    <div key={k} className={cx('flex items-center justify-between gap-4 py-1', strong && 'font-semibold text-ink')}>
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="inline-block h-2 w-2 rounded-full" style={{ background: STRATEGY[k].color }} aria-hidden />
                        {STRATEGY[k].label}
                      </span>
                      <span className="tnum">{v}</span>
                    </div>
                  )
                  return (
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-10 gap-y-5">
                      <Figure
                        label={`${when} AI 전력`}
                        value={fmtKwh(ai)}
                        unit="kWh"
                        accent={STRATEGY.ai.color}
                        info={
                          <>
                            <p className="mb-2 text-[13.5px]">
                              {when} 쓴 전력을 같은 시간표·날씨의 다른 운전 방식과 비교합니다. 하루 전체 AI 예상은 <b className="tnum font-semibold text-ink">{fmtKwh(ds.strategies.ai.kwh)} kWh</b>입니다.
                            </p>
                            {(['ai', 'rule', 'manual', 'fixed'] as StrategyKey[]).map((k) => row(k, `${fmtKwh(so[k])} kWh`, k === 'ai'))}
                          </>
                        }
                      />
                      <Figure
                        label="고정 스케줄 대비"
                        value={svFixed != null ? `−${svFixed.toFixed(1)}` : '–'}
                        unit="%"
                        info={
                          <div className="space-y-2.5 text-[13.5px]">
                            <p>
                              고정 스케줄(평일 08:30–22:30)이었다면 {when} <b className="tnum font-semibold text-ink">{fmtKwh(so.fixed)} kWh</b>를 썼습니다. AI는 {fmtKwh(so.fixed - ai)} kWh 덜 썼습니다.
                            </p>
                            <div className="rounded-[10px] bg-well px-3 py-2.5">
                              <div className="font-semibold text-ink">규칙 기반(10분 전 가동)과 하루 비교</div>
                              <div className="tnum mt-1">
                                {ds.sessions > 0 && coldRule != null && coldAi != null
                                  ? `AI가 하루 ${fmtKwh(Math.abs(dayDiff))} kWh ${dayDiff > 0 ? '더 쓰지만' : '덜 쓰고'}, ${COLD_START.label}${josa(COLD_START.label, '은', '는')} 규칙 ${coldRule}/${ds.sessions}건, AI ${coldAi}/${ds.sessions}건입니다.`
                                  : `AI가 하루 ${fmtKwh(Math.abs(dayDiff))} kWh ${dayDiff > 0 ? '더' : '덜'} 씁니다.`}
                              </div>
                              {dayDiff > 0 && coldAi != null && coldRule != null && coldAi < coldRule && <div className="mt-1 text-ink-3">더 쓴 전력은 수업 전에 미리 데운 몫입니다.</div>}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        }
                      />
                      <Figure
                        label="강의 중 쾌적 유지율"
                        value={ds.strategies.ai.comfort_pct != null ? ds.strategies.ai.comfort_pct.toFixed(1) : '–'}
                        unit="%"
                        align="right"
                        info={
                          <div className="space-y-2 text-[13.5px]">
                            <p>강의 시간 중 실내온도가 쾌적 범위 안이었던 비율입니다(오늘 하루, 지금 이후는 AI 계획 기준).</p>
                            {(['ai', 'rule', 'manual'] as StrategyKey[]).map((k) => row(k, fmtPct(ds.strategies[k].comfort_pct), k === 'ai'))}
                            <div className="border-t border-line pt-2">
                              계획·실행 정합성 <b className="tnum font-semibold text-ink">{fmtPct(ds.match_rate)}</b>, 강의 {ds.sessions}건, 계획 반영 {fmtPct(ds.plan_coverage, 0)}
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        }
                      />
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------- replay another time (behind a popover)
                
                function ReplayControl({ now, at, semester, onSet }: { now: Live['now']; at: string | null; semester: { start: string; end: string }; onSet: (v: string | null) => void }) {
                  const [val, setVal] = useState(at ?? `${now.date}T${fmtMin(now.minute)}`)
                  return (
                    <>
                      {at && (
                        <Button
                          size="sm"
                          variant="ghost"
                          onClick={() => {
                            onSet(null)
                            setVal('')
                          }}
                        >
                          <RotateCcw size={13} aria-hidden /> 실시간으로
                        </Button>
                      )}
                      <Popover
                        label="다른 시점 재현"
                        align="end"
                        width={320}
                        buttonClassName={btnCls('secondary', 'sm')}
                        button={
                          <>
                            <Clock3 size={14} aria-hidden /> 다른 시점
                          </>
                        }
                      >
                        <form
                          className="space-y-3"
                          onSubmit={(e) => {
                            e.preventDefault()
                            if (val) onSet(val)
                          }}
                        >
                          <div>
                            <label className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink" htmlFor="replay-at">
                              다른 시점 재현
                            </label>
                            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-ink-3">학기 중 어느 시각이든 그때의 건물 상태를 다시 계산해 보여 줍니다.</p>
                          </div>
                          <input
                            id="replay-at"
                            name="replay-at"
                            type="datetime-local"
                            className={cx(inputBase, 'tnum w-full')}
                            value={val}
                            min={`${semester.start}T00:00`}
                            max={`${semester.end}T23:55`}
                            step={300}
                            onChange={(e) => setVal(e.target.value)}
                          />
                          <Button type="submit" variant="primary" className="w-full">
                            이 시점 보기
                          </Button>
                        </form>
                      </Popover>
                    </>
                  )
                }
                
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------- detail: hourly energy
                
                function HourlyEnergy({ day, nowMinute }: { day: Day; nowMinute: number }) {
                  const keys: StrategyKey[] = ['fixed', 'rule', 'ai']
                  const hours = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => i + 7)
                  const option = useMemo<EChartsOption>(
                    () => ({
                      grid: { left: 40, right: 12, top: 12, bottom: 24 },
                      tooltip: {
                        ...baseTooltip,
                        trigger: 'axis',
                        formatter: (ps: unknown) => {
                          const arr = ps as { seriesName: string; value: number; color: string; axisValue: string }[]
                          let h = ttTitle(`${arr[0]?.axisValue}시대${Number(arr[0]?.axisValue) * 60 > nowMinute ? ' (계획)' : ''}`)
                          for (const p of arr) h += ttRow(p.color, p.seriesName, `${p.value.toFixed(2)} kWh`)
                          return h
                        },
                      },
                      xAxis: { type: 'category', data: hours.map(String), ...axisCommon, axisLabel: { ...axisCommon.axisLabel, formatter: (v: string) => `${v}시` } },
                      yAxis: { type: 'value', ...axisCommon, axisLine: { show: false }, splitNumber: 3 },
                      series: keys.map((k) => ({
                        name: STRATEGY[k].label,
                        type: 'line',
                        step: 'middle',
                        showSymbol: false,
                        lineStyle: { width: 2, color: STRATEGY[k].color },
                        itemStyle: { color: STRATEGY[k].color },
                        areaStyle: k === 'ai' ? { color: 'rgba(20,166,115,0.10)' } : undefined,
                        z: k === 'ai' ? 5 : 2,
                        data: hours.map((h) => day.strategies[k]?.kwh_by_hour[h] ?? 0),
                        ...(k === 'fixed'
                          ? {
                              markLine: {
                                silent: true,
                                symbol: 'none',
                                lineStyle: { color: '#142033', width: 1, type: 'solid' },
                                label: { show: false },
                                data: [{ xAxis: String(Math.min(23, Math.max(7, Math.floor(nowMinute / 60)))) }],
                              },
                            }
                          : {}),
                      })) as never,
                    }),
                    [day, nowMinute],
                  )
                  return (
                    <div className="border-t border-line pt-5">
                      <div className="mb-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                        <span className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink">시간대별 전력량 (kWh)</span>
                        <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-[13px] text-ink-2">
                          {(['ai', 'rule', 'fixed'] as StrategyKey[]).map((k) => (
                            <LegendItem key={k} color={STRATEGY[k].color} label={STRATEGY[k].label} kind="line" />
                          ))}
                          <LegendItem color="#142033" label="현재 시각" kind="line" />
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <EChart option={option} height={170} />
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------- detail: weather
                
                function skyIcon(sky: number, pty: number, size = 18) {
                  if (pty === 1 || pty === 4 || pty === 5) return <CloudRain size={size} className="text-cool" aria-hidden />
                  if (pty === 2 || pty === 3 || pty === 6 || pty === 7) return <CloudSnow size={size} className="text-cool" aria-hidden />
                  if (sky === 1) return <Sun size={size} className="text-[#d98a00]" aria-hidden />
                  if (sky === 3) return <CloudSun size={size} className="text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
                  return <Cloud size={size} className="text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
                }
                
                function skyLabel(sky: number, pty: number) {
                  if (pty === 1) return '비'
                  if (pty === 2) return '비/눈'
                  if (pty === 3) return '눈'
                  if (pty === 4) return '소나기'
                  if (sky === 1) return '맑음'
                  if (sky === 3) return '구름많음'
                  return '흐림'
                }
                
                function WeatherDetail({ live, weather, day, replay }: { live: Live; weather: WeatherNow | undefined; day: Day | undefined; replay: boolean }) {
                  const now = live.now
                  const h0 = Math.floor(now.minute / 60)
                  const key = `${now.date}T${String(h0).padStart(2, '0')}`
                  const kma = weather?.kma_hourly ?? {}
                  const kmaKeys = Object.keys(kma).sort()
                  const kmaCovers = kmaKeys.some((k) => k.startsWith(now.date))
                  // KMA short-term forecast only covers the coming days; for other reference dates use that day's simulation weather.
                  const hourly: Record<string, { t: number; rh: number; sky: number; pty: number; pop: number }> = kmaCovers
                    ? kma
                    : Object.fromEntries(
                        (day?.weather.actual.t ?? []).map((t, h) => [
                          `${now.date}T${String(h).padStart(2, '0')}`,
                          { t, rh: day!.weather.actual.rh[h], sky: (day!.weather.actual.ghi[h] ?? 0) > 250 ? 1 : 3, pty: 0, pop: 0 },
                        ]),
                      )
                  const keys = Object.keys(hourly).sort()
                  const upcoming = keys.filter((k) => k >= key).slice(0, 10)
                  const cur = hourly[keys.find((k) => k >= key) ?? '']
                  const nc = replay ? null : weather?.nowcast
                  const src = kmaCovers
                    ? `기상청 단기예보${weather?.kma_base ? ` ${weather.kma_base.slice(4, 6)}/${weather.kma_base.slice(6, 8)} ${weather.kma_base.slice(8, 10)}시 발표` : ''}`
                    : `${day?.weather.src_actual ?? 'Open-Meteo'} 시간별 기온`
                  const temps = upcoming.map((k) => hourly[k].t)
                  const tMin = Math.min(...temps)
                  const tMax = Math.max(...temps)
                  return (
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-10 gap-y-6 lg:grid-cols-[260px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          {cur ? skyIcon(cur.sky, cur.pty, 34) : <CloudSun size={34} className="text-ink-3" aria-hidden />}
                          <div className="tnum text-[40px] leading-none font-[650] tracking-[-0.03em] text-ink">
                            {live.outdoor.t.toFixed(1)}
                            <span className="ml-0.5 text-[18px] font-medium text-ink-3">℃</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-3 space-y-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <Droplets size={14} className="text-ink-3" aria-hidden /> 습도 {Math.round(live.outdoor.rh)}%
                            {cur && (
                              <span>
                                , {skyLabel(cur.sky, cur.pty)}
                                {kmaCovers ? `, 강수 ${cur.pop}%` : ''}
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-ink-3">
                            {replay ? '재현 시각' : '지금'} {fmtMin(now.minute)}, {live.outdoor.src}
                          </div>
                          {nc && (
                            <div className="tnum text-ink-3">
                              기상청 초단기실황 {nc.t.toFixed(1)}℃, 습도 {Math.round(nc.rh)}%, <WindIcon size={12} className="inline" aria-hidden /> {nc.wind}m/s ({nc.time.slice(11, 13)}시 관측)
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0">
                        <div className="mb-2 text-[13px] text-ink-3">{src}</div>
                        {upcoming.length > 0 ? (
                          <>
                            <div className="grid" style={{ gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${upcoming.length}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }}>
                              {upcoming.map((k) => {
                                const h = hourly[k]
                                return (
                                  <div key={k} className="flex flex-col items-center text-center" title={`${skyLabel(h.sky, h.pty)}, 습도 ${h.rh}%${kmaCovers ? `, 강수확률 ${h.pop}%` : ''}`}>
                                    <span className="tnum text-[13px] text-ink-3">{k.slice(11, 13)}시</span>
                                    <span className="my-1.5">{skyIcon(h.sky, h.pty, 17)}</span>
                                    <span className="tnum text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink">{Math.round(h.t)}°</span>
                                  </div>
                                )
                              })}
                            </div>
                            <svg className="mt-2 block h-[24px] w-full" viewBox={`0 0 ${upcoming.length * 10} 24`} preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden>
                              <polyline
                                fill="none"
                                stroke="#8a94a3"
                                strokeWidth="1.5"
                                strokeLinejoin="round"
                                vectorEffect="non-scaling-stroke"
                                points={upcoming.map((k, i) => `${i * 10 + 5},${21 - (tMax > tMin ? (hourly[k].t - tMin) / (tMax - tMin) : 0.5) * 18}`).join(' ')}
                              />
                            </svg>
                          </>
                        ) : weather ? (
                          <p className="text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">이 시각 이후의 시간별 예보가 없습니다.</p>
                        ) : (
                          <Skeleton className="h-[80px]" />
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                // ---------------------------------------------------------------- detail: decision feed
                
                type FeedItem = {
                  minute: number
                  kind: 'decision' | 'auto' | 'history'
                  room: string
                  title: string
                  detail: string
                  type?: string
                }
                
                function feedItems(day: Day): FeedItem[] {
                  const out: FeedItem[] = []
                  const plan = day.strategies.ai?.plan ?? {}
                  for (const d of day.decisions) {
                    out.push({ minute: decisionMinute(d, plan[d.room]), kind: 'decision', room: d.room, title: `${decisionLabel(d.type)}, ${d.title}`, detail: d.detail, type: d.type })
                  }
                  for (const v of day.validation.sessions) {
                    const info = statusInfo(v.status)
                    if (info.group !== 'auto') continue
                    out.push({ minute: hm(v.start), kind: 'auto', room: v.room, title: `${info.label}, ${v.title}`, detail: v.notes.join(' / ') })
                  }
                  for (const h of day.history) {
                    if (!h.room) continue
                    if (!/자동|감지|수동|재전송|보정/.test(h.cause)) continue
                    out.push({ minute: h.minute, kind: 'history', room: h.room, title: `${h.device} ${h.state === 'ON' ? '켬' : '끔'}`, detail: h.cause })
                  }
                  return out.sort((a, b) => a.minute - b.minute)
                }
                
                function feedCount(day: Day) {
                  return feedItems(day).length
                }
                
                function Feed({ day, nowMinute, onOpen }: { day: Day | undefined; nowMinute: number; onOpen: (r: string) => void }) {
                  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<'all' | 'decision' | 'auto'>('all')
                  const items = useMemo<FeedItem[]>(() => (day ? feedItems(day) : []), [day])
                  const shown = items.filter((i) => filter === 'all' || (filter === 'decision' ? i.kind === 'decision' : i.kind !== 'decision'))
                  const nDec = items.filter((i) => i.kind === 'decision').length
                  const nAuto = items.length - nDec
                
                  if (!day) return <Loading />
                  return (
                    <div>
                      <div className="mb-3 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <Segmented
                          size="sm"
                          label="항목 종류"
                          value={filter}
                          onChange={setFilter}
                          options={[
                            { value: 'all', label: `전체 ${items.length}` },
                            { value: 'decision', label: `AI 판단 ${nDec}` },
                            { value: 'auto', label: `자동 조치 ${nAuto}` },
                          ]}
                        />
                        <span className="text-[13px] text-ink-3">항목을 누르면 그 강의실 상세가 열립니다</span>
                      </div>
                      {shown.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-[10px] bg-well px-3.5 py-3 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
                          <Info size={15} className="text-ink-3" aria-hidden />
                          {filter === 'auto' ? '오늘은 사람이 개입하거나 시스템이 바로잡은 이상 상황이 없었습니다.' : '이 날은 강의가 없어 AI가 판단할 일이 없었습니다.'}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <ol className="thin-scroll -mx-2 max-h-[440px] overflow-y-auto px-2">
                          {shown.map((it, i) => {
                            const future = it.minute > nowMinute
                            return (
                              <li key={i} className="border-b border-line last:border-b-0">
                                <button type="button" className="flex w-full gap-3 rounded-[10px] px-2 py-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-well" onClick={() => onOpen(it.room)}>
                                  <span className={cx('tnum w-12 shrink-0 pt-0.5 text-[14px] font-semibold', future ? 'text-ink-3' : 'text-ink')}>{fmtMin(it.minute)}</span>
                                  <span
                                    className={cx(
                                      'mt-0.5 flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full',
                                      it.kind === 'decision' ? (future ? 'bg-well text-ink-2 ring-1 ring-line-strong ring-inset' : 'bg-ink text-white') : 'bg-warn-bg text-[#c98500]',
                                    )}
                                    aria-hidden
                                  >
                                    {it.kind === 'decision' ? <DecisionIcon type={it.type ?? ''} size={12} /> : it.kind === 'auto' ? <Wrench size={12} strokeWidth={2.4} /> : <History size={12} strokeWidth={2.4} />}
                                  </span>
                                  <span className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                                    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink">
                                      <span className="tnum shrink-0 text-ink-2">{it.room}</span>
                                      <span className="truncate">{it.title}</span>
                                      {future && (
                                        <Badge tone="outline" className="shrink-0">
                                          예정
                                        </Badge>
                                      )}
                                    </span>
                                    <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[13.5px] leading-snug text-ink-2">{it.detail}</span>
                                  </span>
                                </button>
                              </li>
                            )
                          })}
                        </ol>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                }

                // sequential, one hue (AI): darker = larger saving vs fixed schedule

                  { min: 75, bg: 'rgba(20,166,115,0.28)', label: '75–85%' },

                }
                
                export default function Schedule() {
                  const { meta } = useMeta()

                  const summary = useApi<Summary>('/api/summary')

                      if (v == null || v === '') p.delete(k)
                      else p.set(k, v)
                    }

                        open={!!room}
