                        day={day.data?.date === date ? day.data : undefined}
                        meta={meta}
                        room={room}
                        initial={overlay ? [primary, overlay] : primary === 'ai' ? ['ai', 'rule'] : [primary, 'ai']}
                      />
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function MonthCalendar({
                  month,
                  onMonth,
                  selected,
                  onSelect,
                  byDate,
                  today,
                  semester,
                  holidays,
                  loading,
                }: {
                  month: string
                  onMonth: (m: string) => void
                  selected: string
                  onSelect: (d: string) => void
                  byDate: Record<string, DaySummary>
                  today: string
                  semester: { start: string; end: string }
                  holidays: Record<string, string>
                  loading: boolean
                }) {
                  const [y, m] = month.split('-').map(Number)
                  const first = new Date(y, m - 1, 1)
                  const lead = (first.getDay() + 6) % 7
                  const daysIn = new Date(y, m, 0).getDate()
                  const cells: (string | null)[] = []
                  for (let i = 0; i < lead; i++) cells.push(null)
                  for (let d = 1; d <= daysIn; d++) cells.push(isoDate(new Date(y, m - 1, d)))
                  while (cells.length % 7) cells.push(null)
                
                  const minM = semester.start.slice(0, 7)
                  const maxM = semester.end.slice(0, 7)
                  const prev = isoDate(new Date(y, m - 2, 1)).slice(0, 7)
                  const next = isoDate(new Date(y, m, 1)).slice(0, 7)
                
                  return (
                    <Card>
                      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <IconButton label="이전 달" disabled={prev < minM} onClick={() => onMonth(prev)}>
                            <ChevronLeft size={18} />
                          </IconButton>
                          <h2 className="tnum w-[112px] text-center text-[17px] font-[650] text-ink">
                            {y}년 {m}월
                          </h2>
                          <IconButton label="다음 달" disabled={next > maxM} onClick={() => onMonth(next)}>
                            <ChevronRight size={18} />
                          </IconButton>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px] text-ink-3" aria-label="칸 색: 고정 스케줄 대비 AI 절감률">
                          <span>고정 대비 AI 절감</span>
                          <span className="tnum">50%</span>
                          <span className="flex gap-0.5" aria-hidden>
                            {[...SAVE_STEPS].reverse().map((s, i) => (
                              <span key={i} className="inline-block h-3 w-4 rounded-[3px] ring-1 ring-line ring-inset" style={{ background: s.bg }} title={s.label} />
                            ))}
                          </span>
                          <span className="tnum">85%</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      {loading && <Loading label="학기 요약을 계산하는 중…" />}
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5 text-center text-[13px] font-medium text-ink-3">
                        {WEEKDAY.map((w, i) => (
                          <div key={w} className={cx('pb-1.5', i === 5 && 'text-info-ink', i === 6 && 'text-crit-ink')}>
                            {w}
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1.5">
                        {cells.map((d, i) => {
                          if (!d) return <div key={i} />
                          const s = byDate[d]
                          const inSem = d >= semester.start && d <= semester.end
                          const hol = holidays[d]
                          const wd = weekdayOf(d)
                          const sv = s && s.sessions > 0 ? pctSaving(s.strategies.fixed.kwh, s.strategies.ai.kwh) : null
                          const sel = d === selected
                          const isT = d === today
                          const future = d > today
                          const { review } = s ? splitCounts(s) : { review: 0 }
                          return (
                            <button
                              key={d}
                              type="button"
                              disabled={!inSem}
                              onClick={() => onSelect(d)}
                              aria-pressed={sel}
                              aria-label={`${fmtDateK(d)}${hol ? `, ${hol}` : ''}${sv != null ? `, 고정 대비 AI 절감 ${sv.toFixed(0)}%${future ? ' 예상' : ''}` : ''}${!future && review > 0 ? `, 확인 필요 ${review}건` : ''}`}
                              className={cx(
                                'relative flex h-[60px] flex-col rounded-[10px] px-2 py-1.5 text-left transition-[box-shadow,background-color] duration-150',
                                sel ? 'shadow-[0_0_0_2px_var(--color-ink)]' : 'hover:shadow-[0_0_0_1px_var(--color-ink-4)]',
                                !inSem && 'cursor-default opacity-35',
                                wd >= 5 && 'bg-well',
                              )}
                              style={{ background: sv != null ? saveBg(sv) : undefined }}
                              title={
                                s
                                  ? `${fmtDateK(d)}${hol ? `, ${hol}` : ''}\n강의 ${s.sessions}건${s.events ? ` (이벤트 ${s.events})` : ''}\nAI ${fmtKwh(s.strategies.ai.kwh)} kWh, 고정 ${fmtKwh(s.strategies.fixed.kwh)} kWh${sv != null ? ` (−${sv.toFixed(0)}%)` : ''}\n정합성 ${fmtPct(s.match_rate)}${future ? '\n(예보·평년 기반 예상)' : ''}`
                                  : fmtDateK(d)
                              }
                            >
                              <span className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                <span
                                  className={cx(
                                    'tnum text-[13.5px] font-semibold',
                                    hol || wd === 6 ? 'text-crit-ink' : wd === 5 ? 'text-info-ink' : 'text-ink',
                                    isT && 'rounded-full bg-ink px-1.5 text-white',
                                  )}
                                >
                                  {Number(d.slice(8))}
                                </span>
                                {!future && review > 0 && <AlertTriangle size={12} color="#d03b3b" strokeWidth={2.6} aria-hidden />}
                              </span>
                              {hol ? (
                                <span className="mt-auto truncate text-[13px] font-medium text-crit-ink">{hol}</span>
                              ) : sv != null ? (
                                <span className={cx('tnum mt-auto text-[14px] font-semibold', future ? 'text-ink-3' : 'text-ink')}>−{sv.toFixed(0)}%</span>
                              ) : null}
                            </button>
                          )
                        })}
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-4 text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                        회색 숫자는 예보로 계산한 예상,{' '}
                        <AlertTriangle size={12} color="#d03b3b" strokeWidth={2.6} className="inline align-[-1px]" aria-hidden />
                        는 확인이 필요한 강의가 있던 날입니다.
                      </p>
                    </Card>
                  )
                }
                
                function DayPanel({ ds, day, date, isFuture }: { ds: DaySummary | undefined; day: Day | undefined; date: string; isFuture: boolean }) {
                  const hourOpt = useMemo(() => {
                    if (!day) return null
                    const hours = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, i) => i + 7)
                    const keys = STRATEGY_KEYS.filter((k) => day.strategies[k])
                    return {
                      grid: { left: 40, right: 12, top: 12, bottom: 24 },
                      tooltip: {
                        ...baseTooltip,
                        trigger: 'axis' as const,
                        formatter: (ps: unknown) => {
                          const arr = ps as { seriesName: string; value: number; color: string; axisValue: string }[]
                          let h = ttTitle(`${arr[0]?.axisValue}시대 전력량`)
                          for (const p of arr) h += ttRow(p.color, p.seriesName, `${p.value.toFixed(2)} kWh`)
                          return h
                        },
                      },
                      xAxis: { type: 'category' as const, data: hours.map(String), ...axisCommon, axisLabel: { ...axisCommon.axisLabel, interval: 1 } },
                      yAxis: { type: 'value' as const, ...axisCommon, axisLine: { show: false }, splitNumber: 3 },
                      series: keys.map((k) => ({
                        name: STRATEGY[k].label,
                        type: 'line' as const,
                        showSymbol: false,
                        step: 'middle' as const,
                        lineStyle: { width: 2, color: STRATEGY[k].color },
                        itemStyle: { color: STRATEGY[k].color },
                        data: hours.map((h) => day.strategies[k]!.kwh_by_hour[h]),
                        z: k === 'ai' ? 5 : 2,
                      })),
                    }
                  }, [day])
                
                  if (!ds) return <Card>{<Loading label="일자 요약을 계산하는 중…" />}</Card>
                  const base = ds.strategies.fixed.kwh
                  const ai = ds.strategies.ai
                  const sv = ds.sessions > 0 ? pctSaving(base, ai.kwh) : null
                  return (
                    <Card className="flex flex-col">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5">
                        <h2 className="text-[17px] font-[650] tracking-[-0.01em] text-ink">{fmtDateK(date)}</h2>
                        {isFuture && <Badge tone="info">예상</Badge>}
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">
                        {ds.sessions > 0 ? `강의 ${ds.sessions}건${ds.events ? `, 이벤트 ${ds.events}건` : ''}` : (ds.holiday ?? (ds.workday ? '강의 없음' : '주말'))}, 외기 {ds.t_min.toFixed(1)}~{ds.t_max.toFixed(1)}℃
                      </p>
                      <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap gap-x-10 gap-y-5">
                        <Figure label="AI 전력" value={fmtKwh(ai.kwh)} unit="kWh" accent={STRATEGY.ai.color} />
                        <Figure label="고정 스케줄 대비" value={sv != null ? `−${sv.toFixed(0)}` : '–'} unit={sv != null ? '%' : undefined} />
                        <Figure label="강의 중 쾌적" value={ai.comfort_pct != null ? ai.comfort_pct.toFixed(1) : '–'} unit={ai.comfort_pct != null ? '%' : undefined} />
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-8">
                        <div className="mb-3 text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink">운전 방식별 하루 전력</div>
                        <ul className="space-y-3" aria-label="운전 방식별 하루 전력량">
                          {(['ai', 'rule', 'manual', 'fixed'] as StrategyKey[]).map((k) => {
                            const v = ds.strategies[k].kwh
                            const max = Math.max(...(['ai', 'rule', 'manual', 'fixed'] as StrategyKey[]).map((x) => ds.strategies[x].kwh), 1)
                            return (
                              <li key={k} className="grid grid-cols-[64px_minmax(0,1fr)_84px] items-center gap-3 text-[13.5px]">
                                <span className={cx(k === 'ai' ? 'font-semibold text-ink' : 'text-ink-2')}>{STRATEGY[k].short}</span>
                                <span className="h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#eef0f3]" aria-hidden>
                                  <span className="block h-2.5 rounded-full" style={{ width: `${Math.max(1, (v / max) * 100)}%`, background: STRATEGY[k].color }} />
                                </span>
                                <span className={cx('tnum text-right', k === 'ai' ? 'font-semibold text-ink' : 'text-ink-2')}>{fmtKwh(v)} kWh</span>
                              </li>
                            )
                          })}
                        </ul>
                      </div>
                      <Disclosure variant="inline" className="mt-auto pt-6" title="요금·쾌적과 시간대별 전력 보기">
                        <table className="tnum w-full text-[14px]">
                          <thead>
                            <tr className="text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                              <th className="pb-2 text-left font-medium">운전 방식</th>
                              <th className="pb-2 text-right font-medium">전력량</th>
                              <th className="pb-2 text-right font-medium">고정 대비</th>
                              <th className="pb-2 text-right font-medium">요금</th>
                              <th className="pb-2 text-right font-medium">쾌적</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                            {(['ai', 'rule', 'manual', 'fixed'] as StrategyKey[]).map((k) => {
                              const v = ds.strategies[k]
                              const p = pctSaving(base, v.kwh)
                              return (
                                <tr key={k} className={cx('border-t border-line', k === 'ai' && 'font-semibold')}>
                                  <td className="py-2">
                                    <StrategyName k={k} />
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="py-2 text-right">{fmtKwh(v.kwh)} kWh</td>
                                  <td className={cx('py-2 text-right', k === 'fixed' ? 'text-ink-3' : '')}>{k === 'fixed' ? '기준' : p != null ? `−${p.toFixed(1)}%` : '–'}</td>
                                  <td className="py-2 text-right">{fmtWon(v.cost_krw)}</td>
                                  <td className="py-2 text-right">{fmtPct(v.comfort_pct)}</td>
                                </tr>
                              )
                            })}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                        <div className="mt-5 mb-1 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                          <span className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink">시간대별 전력량 (kWh)</span>
                          <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 text-[13px] text-ink-2">
                            {(['ai', 'rule', 'manual', 'fixed'] as StrategyKey[]).map((k) => (
                              <StrategyName key={k} k={k} short line />
                            ))}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {hourOpt ? <EChart option={hourOpt} height={160} /> : <Loading className="py-6" />}
                        {Object.keys(ds.decisions).length > 0 && (
                          <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[13px]">
                            <span className="text-ink-3">이 날 AI 판단</span>
                            {Object.entries(ds.decisions).map(([k, v]) => (
                              <Badge key={k} tone="ai">
                                {decisionLabel(k)} {v}
                              </Badge>
                            ))}
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                          {isFuture ? '미래 날짜는 기상청 단기예보·평년 기온으로 계산한 예상치입니다.' : '실측(또는 예보) 날씨로 하루를 시뮬레이션한 결과입니다.'}
                        </p>
                      </Disclosure>
                    </Card>
                  )
                }

                import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react'
                import { FlaskConical, RotateCcw, Save, Info, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react'
                import { apiSend, invalidateAll, useApi } from '../lib/api'

                type NumKey =
                  | 'pre_on_min'
                  | 'early_off_min'
                  | 'gap_merge_min'
                  | 'sp_heat'
                  | 'sp_cool'
                  | 'comfort_low'
                  | 'comfort_high'
                  | 'ai_max_lead_min'
                  | 'ai_max_early_off_min'
                
                type Sec = { key: string; title: string; desc: string; fields: { k: NumKey; label: string; step: number; min: number; max: number; unit: string; help: string }[] }
                
                // plain-language labels; the technical names (SETTING_LABEL) stay for proposals and the audit log
                const SECTIONS: Sec[] = [
                  {
                    key: 'temp',
                    title: '설정온도와 쾌적 범위',
                    desc: '실내기 설정온도와 "쾌적"으로 판정하는 실내온도 범위입니다. 모든 운전 방식에 적용됩니다.',
                    fields: [
                      { k: 'sp_heat', label: '난방 설정온도', step: 0.5, min: 16, max: 24, unit: '℃', help: '난방 설정온도' },
                      { k: 'sp_cool', label: '냉방 설정온도', step: 0.5, min: 22, max: 30, unit: '℃', help: '냉방 설정온도' },
                      { k: 'comfort_low', label: '쾌적 하한', step: 0.5, min: 15, max: 23, unit: '℃', help: '이보다 낮으면 쾌적 이탈' },
                      { k: 'comfort_high', label: '쾌적 상한', step: 0.5, min: 24, max: 30, unit: '℃', help: '이보다 높으면 쾌적 이탈' },

                    fields: [

                const AI_SECTION: Sec = {

                const EDIT_KEYS: (keyof Settings)[] = [
                  'pre_on_min',
                  'early_off_min',
                  'gap_merge_min',
                  'sp_heat',
                  'sp_cool',
                  'comfort_low',
                  'comfort_high',
                  'ai_max_lead_min',
                  'ai_max_early_off_min',
                  'baseline',
                  'anomalies',
                ]
                
                export default function SettingsPage() {
                  const { meta, reload: reloadMeta } = useMeta()
                  const cur = useApi<Settings>('/api/settings')
                  const [form, setForm] = useState<Partial<Settings>>({})
                  const [wi, setWi] = useState<WhatIf | null>(null)
                  const [wiBusy, setWiBusy] = useState(false)
                  const [wiErr, setWiErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
                  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false)
                  const [confirm, setConfirm] = useState<'save' | 'reset' | null>(null)
                  const today = meta?.now.date ?? '2026-11-20'
                  const monday = addDays(today, -weekdayOf(today))
                  const [wiStart, setWiStart] = useState(monday)
                  const [wiDays, setWiDays] = useState(5)
                
                  useEffect(() => {
                    if (cur.data) setForm(Object.fromEntries(EDIT_KEYS.map((k) => [k, cur.data![k]])) as Partial<Settings>)
                  }, [cur.data])
                
                  const changes = useMemo(() => {
                    if (!cur.data) return {}
                    const out: Record<string, unknown> = {}
                    for (const k of EDIT_KEYS) if (form[k] !== undefined && form[k] !== cur.data[k]) out[k] = form[k]
                    return out
                  }, [form, cur.data])
                  const nChanged = Object.keys(changes).length
                  // mirrors the backend rule: setpoints must sit at least 0.3 ℃ inside the comfort band
                  const MARGIN = 0.3
                  const lo = form.comfort_low ?? 0
                  const hi = form.comfort_high ?? 99
                  const problems: Partial<Record<NumKey, string>> = {}
                  if (lo >= hi) problems.comfort_low = '쾌적 하한은 상한보다 낮아야 합니다.'
                  if ((form.sp_heat ?? 0) >= (form.sp_cool ?? 99)) problems.sp_heat = '난방 설정온도는 냉방 설정온도보다 낮아야 합니다.'
                  else if (form.sp_heat != null && form.sp_heat < lo + MARGIN - 1e-9)
                    problems.sp_heat = `쾌적 하한(${lo}℃)보다 ${MARGIN}℃ 이상 높아야 합니다. ${(lo + MARGIN).toFixed(1)}℃ 이상으로 정하세요.`
                  if (form.sp_cool != null && form.sp_cool > hi - MARGIN + 1e-9)
                    problems.sp_cool = `쾌적 상한(${hi}℃)보다 ${MARGIN}℃ 이상 낮아야 합니다. ${(hi - MARGIN).toFixed(1)}℃ 이하로 정하세요.`
                  const invalid = Object.keys(problems).length > 0
                  const [saveErr, setSaveErr] = useState<string | null>(null)
                
                  useEffect(() => {
                    setWi(null)
                  }, [form])
                
                  const preview = async () => {
                    setWiBusy(true)
                    setWiErr(null)
                    try {
                      const r = await apiSend<WhatIf>('POST', '/api/whatif', { overrides: changes, start_date: wiStart, days: wiDays })
                      setWi(r)
                    } catch (e) {
                      setWiErr((e as Error).message)
                    } finally {
                      setWiBusy(false)
                    }
                  }
                
                  const save = async () => {
                    setSaving(true)
                    setSaveErr(null)
                    try {
                      await apiSend('PUT', '/api/settings', changes)
                      invalidateAll()
                      reloadMeta()
                      toast('운영 규칙을 저장했습니다. 학기 전체 운전 계획을 다시 계산합니다.')
                    } catch (e) {
                      // e.g. 400 with a Korean detail (setpoint too close to the comfort band): show it on the page
                      setSaveErr((e as Error).message)
                    } finally {
                      setSaving(false)
                      setConfirm(null)
                    }
                  }
                
                  const reset = async () => {
                    setSaving(true)
                    try {
                      await apiSend('POST', '/api/settings/reset')
                      invalidateAll()
                      reloadMeta()
                      toast('기본 운영 규칙으로 되돌렸습니다.')
                    } catch (e) {
                      toast((e as Error).message, 'crit')
                    } finally {
                      setSaving(false)
                      setConfirm(null)
                    }
                  }
                
                  if (cur.error) return <ErrorBox title="운영 규칙을 불러오지 못했습니다" error={cur.error} onRetry={cur.reload} />
                  if (!cur.data || !meta) return <PageSkeleton label="운영 규칙을 불러오는 중…" />
                  const S = cur.data
                
                  const fields = (sec: Sec) => (
                    <>
                      <div className={cx('grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-5', sec.fields.length === 4 ? 'lg:grid-cols-4' : sec.fields.length === 3 ? 'lg:grid-cols-3' : 'lg:grid-cols-2')}>
                        {sec.fields.map((f) => {
                          const changed = f.k in changes
                          return (
                            <Field
                              key={f.k}
                              label={f.label}
                              hint={
                                changed ? (
                                  <span className="tnum font-semibold text-info-ink">
                                    지금 {String(S[f.k])}
                                    {f.unit} → {String(form[f.k])}
                                    {f.unit}
                                  </span>
                                ) : undefined
                              }
                            >
                              <div className="relative" title={f.help}>
                                <input
                                  type="number"
                                  inputMode="decimal"
                                  name={f.k}
                                  autoComplete="off"
                                  step={f.step}
                                  min={f.min}
                                  max={f.max}
                                  aria-invalid={!!problems[f.k]}
                                  aria-description={f.help}
                                  className={cx(inputCls, 'tnum pr-10 text-[15px]', changed && 'border-s-rule bg-info-bg', problems[f.k] && 'border-crit bg-crit-bg')}
                                  value={(form[f.k] as number | undefined) ?? ''}
                                  onChange={(e) => setForm((x) => ({ ...x, [f.k]: e.target.value === '' ? undefined : Number(e.target.value) }))}
                                />
                                <span className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 right-3 -translate-y-1/2 text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">{f.unit}</span>
                              </div>
                            </Field>
                          )
                        })}
                      </div>
                      {sec.fields.some((f) => problems[f.k]) && (
                        <ul className="mt-4 space-y-1 text-[13.5px] text-crit-ink" role="alert">
                          {sec.fields
                            .filter((f) => problems[f.k])
                            .map((f) => (
                              <li key={f.k} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                                <AlertTriangle size={14} className="mt-[3px] shrink-0" aria-hidden />
                                <span>
                                  <b className="font-semibold">{f.label}</b>: {problems[f.k]}
                                </span>
                              </li>
                            ))}
                        </ul>
                      )}
                    </>
                  )
                  const aiChanged = AI_SECTION.fields.filter((f) => f.k in changes).length
                  const optChanged = ['baseline', 'anomalies'].filter((k) => k in changes).length
                
                  return (
                    <div>
                      <PageHeader
                        title="운영 규칙"
                        desc="값을 바꾸면 저장하기 전에 시뮬레이션으로 전력과 쾌적 변화를 먼저 확인합니다. 모든 변경은 변경 기록에 남습니다."
                        right={
                          <>
                            <Button variant="ghost" onClick={() => setConfirm('reset')}>
                              <RotateCcw size={15} aria-hidden /> 기본값으로
                            </Button>
                            <Button variant="primary" disabled={!nChanged || invalid || saving} onClick={() => setConfirm('save')}>
                              <Save size={15} aria-hidden /> {nChanged > 0 ? `변경 ${nChanged}개 저장` : '저장'}
                            </Button>
                          </>
                        }
                      />
                
                      {saveErr && (
                        <div className="mb-5">
                          <ErrorBox title="저장하지 못했습니다" error={saveErr} />
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 items-start gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.3fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
                        <div className="space-y-6">
                          {SECTIONS.map((sec) => (
                            <Card key={sec.key}>
                              <CardHeader title={sec.title} sub={sec.desc} />
                              {fields(sec)}
                            </Card>
                          ))}
                
                          <DisclosureList title="고급 설정과 참고 정보" hideTitle>
                            <Disclosure title="AI 예측 제어 한계" summary={aiChanged ? `변경 ${aiChanged}개` : `선행 최대 ${S.ai_max_lead_min}분, 조기 정지 최대 ${S.ai_max_early_off_min}분`} defaultOpen={AI_SECTION.fields.some((f) => problems[f.k])}>
                              <p className="mb-4 text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">{AI_SECTION.desc}</p>
                              {fields(AI_SECTION)}
                            </Disclosure>
                            <Disclosure title="비교 기준과 시연 옵션" summary={optChanged ? `변경 ${optChanged}개` : `${STRATEGY[(form.baseline as StrategyKey) ?? 'fixed']?.label ?? '고정 스케줄'} 기준, 현장 이상 ${form.anomalies ? '켜짐' : '꺼짐'}`}>
                              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-5 lg:grid-cols-2">
                                <Field label={SETTING_LABEL.baseline} hint="절감률(%)을 무엇과 비교할지 정합니다.">
                                  <select
                                    name="baseline"
                                    className={cx(inputCls, 'baseline' in changes && 'border-s-rule bg-info-bg')}
                                    value={String(form.baseline ?? 'fixed')}
                                    onChange={(e) => setForm((x) => ({ ...x, baseline: e.target.value }))}
                                  >
                                    {(['fixed', 'manual', 'rule'] as StrategyKey[]).map((k) => (
                                      <option key={k} value={k}>
                                        {STRATEGY[k].label}
                                      </option>
                                    ))}
                                  </select>
                                </Field>
                                <div>
                                  <span className="mb-1.5 block text-[13px] font-medium text-ink-2" id="anomalies-label">
                                    {SETTING_LABEL.anomalies}
                                  </span>
                                  <label
                                    className={cx(
                                      'flex h-10 cursor-pointer items-center justify-between rounded-[10px] border px-3 has-[:focus-visible]:outline-2 has-[:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2 has-[:focus-visible]:outline-focus',
                                      'anomalies' in changes ? 'border-s-rule bg-info-bg' : 'border-line-strong',
                                    )}
                                  >
                                    <span className="text-[14px] text-ink">{form.anomalies ? '켜짐' : '꺼짐'}</span>
                                    <input
                                      type="checkbox"
                                      name="anomalies"
                                      aria-labelledby="anomalies-label"
                                      className="peer sr-only"
                                      checked={!!form.anomalies}
                                      onChange={(e) => setForm((x) => ({ ...x, anomalies: e.target.checked }))}
                                    />
                                    <span className={cx('relative h-5 w-9 rounded-full transition-colors duration-150', form.anomalies ? 'bg-ink' : 'bg-line-strong')} aria-hidden>
                                      <span className={cx('absolute top-0.5 h-4 w-4 rounded-full bg-surface shadow-[0_1px_2px_rgb(20_32_51/0.25)] transition-transform duration-150', form.anomalies ? 'translate-x-[18px]' : 'translate-x-0.5')} />
                                    </span>
                                  </label>
                                  <span className="mt-1.5 block text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                                    무단 휴강, 명령 실패({fmtPct(S.failure_rate * 100, 0)}), 수동 가동({fmtPct(S.override_rate * 100, 0)}) 같은 상황을 넣어 자동 조치를 검증합니다.
                                  </span>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                              <div className="tnum mt-5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-4 gap-y-2 rounded-[12px] bg-well p-4 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
                                <div>
                                  고정 스케줄 <b className="text-ink">{S.fixed_on}–{S.fixed_off}</b>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  수동 운영 정지 지연 <b className="text-ink">{S.manual_off_delay_min}분</b>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  빈 강의실 자동 정지 <b className="text-ink">{S.auto_off_after_min}분</b>
                                </div>
                                <div>
                                  제습 기준 <b className="text-ink">RH {S.dehum_rh}%, {S.dehum_temp}℃</b>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </Disclosure>
                            <Disclosure title="설비 정보" summary={`강의실 ${Object.keys(meta.rooms).length}개, 실외기 ${Object.keys(meta.odus).length}대`}>
                              <Equipment />
                            </Disclosure>
                            <Disclosure title="전기요금과 탄소 배출계수" summary={`교육용(을) 고압A, ${S.co2_kg_per_kwh} kgCO₂/kWh`}>
                              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-8 xl:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1.4fr)_minmax(0,1fr)]">
                                <Tariff s={S} />
                                <div>
                                  <div className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink">탄소 배출계수</div>
                                  <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-2">
                                    <span className="tnum text-[30px] font-[650] tracking-[-0.02em] text-ink">{S.co2_kg_per_kwh}</span>
                                    <span className="text-[14px] text-ink-3">kgCO₂eq / kWh</span>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="mt-3 space-y-1.5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
                                    <div>
                                      <b className="font-semibold text-ink">출처</b> 2023년도 국가 전력배출계수 0.4173 tCO₂eq/MWh (기후에너지환경부 공표 기준)
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                      <b className="font-semibold text-ink">적용</b> 운전 방식별 전력량(kWh) × 계수 = 배출량. 절감 효과 화면의 tCO₂ 값에 쓰입니다.
                                    </div>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>
                            </Disclosure>
                          </DisclosureList>
                        </div>
                
                        <Card className="xl:sticky xl:top-[88px]">
                          <CardHeader title="시뮬레이션으로 미리보기" sub="바꾼 값으로 실제 시간표와 날씨를 다시 돌려 지금 규칙과 비교합니다. 저장 전이라 운영에는 영향이 없습니다." />
                          {nChanged > 0 ? (
                            <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                              {Object.entries(changes).map(([k, v]) => (
                                <Badge key={k} tone="info">
                                  {SETTING_LABEL[k] ?? k}: {String(S[k])} → {String(v)}
                                </Badge>
                              ))}
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="mb-4">
                              <Note icon={<Info size={15} className="text-ink-3" aria-hidden />}>왼쪽에서 값을 하나 이상 바꾸면 미리보기를 실행할 수 있습니다.</Note>
                            </div>
                          )}
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-2">
                            <Field label="시작일">
                              <input type="date" name="whatif-start" className={cx(inputBase, 'tnum w-[156px]')} value={wiStart} min={meta.semester.start} max={meta.semester.end} onChange={(e) => setWiStart(e.target.value)} />
                            </Field>
                            <Field label="기간">
                              <select name="whatif-days" className={cx(inputBase, 'w-[92px]')} value={wiDays} onChange={(e) => setWiDays(Number(e.target.value))}>
                                {[1, 3, 5, 7].map((d) => (
                                  <option key={d} value={d}>
                                    {d}일
                                  </option>
                                ))}
                              </select>
                            </Field>
                            <Button variant="primary" onClick={preview} disabled={!nChanged || invalid || wiBusy}>
                              {wiBusy ? <Spinner className="text-white" /> : <FlaskConical size={15} aria-hidden />}
                              미리보기 실행
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                          <div className="tnum mt-2 text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                            {fmtDateK(wiStart)} ~ {fmtDateK(addDays(wiStart, wiDays - 1))}
                          </div>
                          {wiErr && (
                            <div className="mt-4">
                              <ErrorBox error={wiErr} />
                            </div>
                          )}
                          {wi && <WhatIfTable wi={wi} />}
                          <CopilotHint />
                        </Card>
                      </div>
                
                      <Modal
                        open={!!confirm}
                        onClose={() => setConfirm(null)}
                        title={confirm === 'reset' ? '기본 운영 규칙으로 되돌리기' : '운영 규칙 저장'}
                        footer={
                          <>
                            <Button onClick={() => setConfirm(null)}>취소</Button>
                            <Button variant="primary" onClick={confirm === 'reset' ? reset : save} disabled={saving}>
                              {saving ? <Spinner className="text-white" /> : <CheckCircle2 size={15} aria-hidden />}
                              {confirm === 'reset' ? '되돌리기' : '저장'}
                            </Button>
                          </>
                        }
                      >
                        {confirm === 'save' ? (
                          <div className="space-y-2.5 text-[14px] text-ink-2">
                            <p>다음 변경을 저장하면 오늘 이후 운전 계획과 학기 비교 결과가 다시 계산됩니다.</p>
                            <ul className="space-y-1">
                              {Object.entries(changes).map(([k, v]) => (
                                <li key={k} className="flex justify-between rounded-[10px] bg-well px-3 py-2">
                                  <span>{SETTING_LABEL[k] ?? k}</span>
                                  <span className="tnum font-medium text-ink">
                                    {String(S[k])} → {String(v)}
                                  </span>
                                </li>
                              ))}
                            </ul>
                            {!wi && <p className="text-[13.5px] text-warn-ink">아직 미리보기를 실행하지 않았습니다. 오른쪽 패널에서 효과를 먼저 확인할 수 있습니다.</p>}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <p className="text-[14px] text-ink-2">모든 운영 규칙을 초기값(선행 가동 10분, 조기 정지 5분, 공백 유지 15분, 난방 20℃, 냉방 26℃ 등)으로 되돌리고 운전 계획을 다시 계산합니다.</p>
                        )}
                      </Modal>
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                export function WhatIfTable({ wi, compact = false }: { wi: WhatIf; compact?: boolean }) {
                  const keys: StrategyKey[] = ['ai', 'rule', 'manual', 'fixed']
                  const cell = (b: string, n: string, d: number, good: boolean, fmt: (x: number) => string) => (
                    <td className="py-1.5 text-right align-top">
                      <div className="whitespace-nowrap">
                        <span className="text-ink-3">{b} →</span> {n}
                      </div>
                      <Change v={d} good={good} fmt={fmt} />
                    </td>
                  )
                  return (
                    <div className={cx('fade-in', compact ? 'mt-2' : 'mt-5 border-t border-line pt-4')}>
                      {!compact && <div className="mb-2 text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">{wi.dates.length}일 합계, 지금 규칙 → 바꾼 규칙</div>}
                      <table className={cx('tnum w-full', compact ? 'text-[13px]' : 'text-[13.5px]')}>
                        <thead className="text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                          <tr>
                            <th className="py-1.5 text-left font-medium">운전 방식</th>
                            <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-medium">전력량 kWh</th>
                            <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-medium">쾌적 %</th>
                            <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-medium whitespace-nowrap" title={COLD_START.desc}>
                              {COLD_START.short}(회)
                            </th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          {keys
                            .filter((k) => wi.base[k] && wi.new[k])
                            .map((k) => {
                              const b = wi.base[k]
                              const n = wi.new[k]
                              const dk = n.kwh - b.kwh
                              const dc = (n.comfort_pct ?? 0) - (b.comfort_pct ?? 0)
                              const hasCold = b.cold_starts != null && n.cold_starts != null
                              const dcs = (n.cold_starts ?? 0) - (b.cold_starts ?? 0)
                              return (
                                <tr key={k} className={cx('border-t border-line', k === 'ai' && 'font-medium')}>
                                  <td className="py-1.5 align-top">
                                    <StrategyName k={k} short={compact} />
                                  </td>
                                  {cell(fmtKwh(b.kwh), fmtKwh(n.kwh), dk, dk < 0, (x) => fmtKwh(x))}
                                  {cell(fmtPct(b.comfort_pct), fmtPct(n.comfort_pct), dc, dc > 0, (x) => x.toFixed(1))}
                                  {hasCold ? cell(String(b.cold_starts), String(n.cold_starts), dcs, dcs < 0, (x) => String(Math.round(x))) : <td className="py-1.5 text-right align-top">–</td>}
                                </tr>
                              )
                            })}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                      {!compact && (
                        <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-3">
                          규칙 값은 주로 &lsquo;규칙 기반&rsquo;에, 설정온도와 쾌적 범위는 모든 방식에 영향을 줍니다. 시작 이탈은 강의가 시작될 때 실내가 쾌적 범위 밖(너무 춥거나 더움)이었던 횟수입니다.
                        </p>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function Change({ v, good, fmt }: { v: number; good: boolean; fmt: (x: number) => string }) {
                  if (Math.abs(v) < 0.05) return <div className="text-[13px] text-ink-3">변화 없음</div>
                  return (
                    <div className={cx('text-[13px] font-semibold', good ? 'text-good-ink' : 'text-crit-ink')}>
                      {v > 0 ? '+' : '−'}
                      {fmt(Math.abs(v))}
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                
                function CopilotHint() {
                  const { ask } = useCopilot()
                  return (
                    <div className="mt-6 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-t border-line pt-4">
                      <span className="text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">어떤 값이 좋을지 모르겠다면</span>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => ask('쾌적도를 지키면서 이번 주 전력을 더 줄일 규칙을 제안해줘')}>
                        <Sparkles size={14} aria-hidden /> 코파일럿에게 추천받기
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function Equipment() {
                  const { meta } = useMeta()
                  if (!meta) return null
                  const rooms = ROOM_ORDER.map((r) => meta.rooms[r]).filter(Boolean)
                  // when every row is an assumption, say it once in the header instead of on every row
                  const allAssumed = rooms.every((r) => r.assumption)
                  return (
                    <div>
                      <div className="mb-4 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                        <p className="text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">강의실, 실내기(IDU), 실외기(ODU) 구성입니다.</p>
                        <Badge tone="warn" title="설비 대장 확인 전 추정치">
                          {allAssumed ? '모든 값이 가정값: 설비 대장과 대조 필요' : '가정값: 설비 대장과 대조 필요'}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6">
                        <div className={tbl.frame}>
                          <table className={tbl.table}>
                            <thead className={tbl.thead}>
                              <tr>
                                <th className={tbl.th}>강의실</th>
                                <th className={tbl.th}>유형</th>
                                <th className={tbl.thR}>면적</th>
                                <th className={tbl.thR}>정원</th>
                                <th className={tbl.thR}>PC</th>
                                <th className={tbl.th}>실내기 (냉방/난방 kW)</th>
                                <th className={tbl.th}>실외기</th>
                              </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                              {rooms.map((r) => (
                                <tr key={r.id} className={tbl.tr}>
                                  <td className="px-3.5 py-2 font-semibold">
                                    {r.id}
                                    {r.assumption && !allAssumed && (
                                      <Badge tone="warn" className="ml-1.5">
                                        가정값
                                      </Badge>
                                    )}
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-ink-2">{r.type_label}</td>
                                  <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-right">{r.area}㎡</td>
                                  <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-right">{r.capacity}명</td>
                                  <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-right">{r.pcs || '–'}</td>
                                  <td className="px-3.5 py-2 text-ink-2">
                                    {r.idus.map((i) => (
                                      <div key={i.id}>
                                        {i.id} <span className="text-ink-3">({i.cool_kw}/{i.heat_kw})</span>
                                      </div>
                                    ))}
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="px-3.5 py-2">{r.odu}</td>
                                </tr>
                              ))}
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <ul className="grid grid-cols-1 divide-y divide-line overflow-hidden rounded-[12px] border border-line md:grid-cols-3 md:divide-x md:divide-y-0">
                          {Object.values(meta.odus).map((o) => {
                            const rs = rooms.filter((r) => r.odu === o.id)
                            const idu = rs.reduce((a, r) => a + r.idus.reduce((b, i) => b + i.cool_kw, 0), 0)
                            return (
                              <li key={o.id} className="px-4 py-3.5">
                                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                                  <span className="font-semibold text-ink">{o.id}</span>
                                  {!allAssumed && <Badge tone="warn">가정값</Badge>}
                                </div>
                                <div className="tnum mt-0.5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
                                  {o.label}, 용량 {o.cap_kw} kW
                                </div>
                                <div className="tnum mt-1 text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                                  {rs.map((r) => r.id).join(', ')}호 연결, 실내기 {rs.reduce((a, r) => a + r.idus.length, 0)}대 (냉방 합계 {idu.toFixed(1)} kW)
                                </div>
                              </li>
                            )
                          })}
                          </ul>
                          <p className="mt-3 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-3">
                            실외기는 연결된 실내기가 하나라도 켜져 있으면 가동하고, 모두 꺼지면 정지합니다. 같은 실외기에 묶인 강의실끼리 강의를 모으면 실외기 가동 시간이 줄어듭니다(절감 효과의 강의실 재배치 권고).
                          </p>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function Tariff({ s }: { s: Settings }) {
                  const seasons: { k: 'summer' | 'spring_fall' | 'winter'; label: string; months: string }[] = [
                    { k: 'summer', label: '여름철', months: '6~8월' },
                    { k: 'spring_fall', label: '봄·가을철', months: '3~5월, 9~10월' },
                    { k: 'winter', label: '겨울철', months: '11~2월' },
                  ]
                  return (
                    <div>
                      <div className="text-[14px] font-semibold text-ink">시간대별 전기요금</div>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 mb-3 text-[13px] text-ink-3">전력량요금(원/kWh)이며 기본요금은 제외했습니다.</p>
                      <table className="tnum w-full text-[14px]">
                        <thead className="text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                          <tr>
                            <th className="py-1.5 text-left font-medium">계절</th>
                            <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-medium">경부하</th>
                            <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-medium">중간부하</th>
                            <th className="py-1.5 text-right font-medium">최대부하</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          {seasons.map((x) => (
                            <tr key={x.k} className="border-t border-line">
                              <td className="py-1.5">
                                <span className="font-medium text-ink">{x.label}</span> <span className="text-[13px] text-ink-3">{x.months}</span>
                              </td>
                              <td className="py-1.5 text-right">{s.tariff[x.k].light}</td>
                              <td className="py-1.5 text-right">{s.tariff[x.k].mid}</td>
                              <td className="py-1.5 text-right font-medium">{s.tariff[x.k].peak}</td>
                            </tr>
                          ))}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                      <div className="mt-3 space-y-1 text-[13.5px] text-ink-2">
                        <div>
                          <b className="font-semibold text-ink">출처</b> 한국전력공사 전기요금표 교육용전력(을) 고압A 선택I, 2023-05-16 게시본
                        </div>
                        <div>경부하는 23~09시입니다. 최대부하는 겨울 10~12시, 17~20시, 22~23시, 그 외 계절 10~12시, 13~17시이고 나머지는 중간부하입니다.</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )
                }

                --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
                import { useMemo, useState } from 'react'
                import { useSearchParams, Link } from 'react-router-dom'
                import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Info, BarChart3 } from 'lucide-react'
                import { useApi } from '../lib/api'
                import { useMeta } from '../lib/context'
                import type { Day, Summary } from '../lib/types'
                import { CHART, GROUP_META, ROOM_ORDER, STATUS_COLOR, splitCounts, statusInfo } from '../lib/constants'
                import { cx, fmtDateK, fmtDateShort, fmtNum, fmtPct } from '../lib/format'
                import EChart, { axisCommon, baseTooltip, ttRow, ttTitle, type EChartsOption } from '../components/EChart'
                import { Badge, Card, ChartCard, Disclosure, DisclosureList, Empty, ErrorBox, IconButton, LegendItem, Loading, PageHeader, PageSkeleton, Popover, StatusBadge, btnCls, inputBase, tbl } from '../components/ui'
                import type { ValidationSession } from '../lib/types'
                import RoomDrawer from '../components/RoomDrawer'
                
                
                export default function Validation() {
                  const { meta } = useMeta()
                  const summary = useApi<Summary>('/api/summary')
                  const [params, setParams] = useSearchParams()
                  const [roomF, setRoomF] = useState<string>('all')
                  const [drawer, setDrawer] = useState<string | null>(null)
                
                  const today = summary.data?.today ?? meta?.now.date ?? '2026-11-20'
                  const past = useMemo(() => (summary.data?.days ?? []).filter((d) => d.date <= today && d.sessions > 0), [summary.data, today])
                  // default: the most recent lecture day that had something to look at (else today)
                  const latestIssue = useMemo(() => [...past].reverse().find((d) => d.anomalies > 0 || (d.match_rate ?? 100) < 100)?.date, [past])
                  const date = params.get('date') ?? (summary.data ? latestIssue ?? today : null)
                  const day = useApi<Day>(date ? `/api/day/${date}` : null)
                
                  const kpi = useMemo(() => {
                    let sessions = 0
                    let match = 0
                    let cov = 0
                    let review = 0
                    let auto = 0
                    for (const d of past) {
                      sessions += d.sessions
                      match += (d.match_rate ?? 100) * d.sessions
                      cov += (d.plan_coverage ?? 100) * d.sessions
                      const c = splitCounts(d)
                      review += c.review
                      auto += c.auto
                    }
                    return { sessions, match: sessions ? match / sessions : null, cov: sessions ? cov / sessions : null, review, auto, days: past.length }
                  }, [past])
                
                  const option = useMemo<EChartsOption>(() => {
                    const cats = past.map((d) => d.date)
                    return {
                      grid: { left: 36, right: 12, top: 16, bottom: 28 },
                      tooltip: {
                        ...baseTooltip,
                        trigger: 'axis',
                        axisPointer: { type: 'shadow', shadowStyle: { color: 'rgba(20,32,51,0.05)' } },
                        formatter: (ps: unknown) => {
                          const arr = ps as { dataIndex: number }[]
                          const d = past[arr[0].dataIndex]
                          const c = splitCounts(d)
                          return (
                            ttTitle(fmtDateK(d.date)) +
                            ttRow(CHART.ink, '정합성', fmtPct(d.match_rate), 'rect') +
                            ttRow(STATUS_COLOR.crit, '확인 필요', `${c.review}건`, 'rect') +
                            ttRow(STATUS_COLOR.warn, '자동 조치', `${c.auto}건`, 'rect') +
                            ttRow(CHART.axis, '검증 강의', `${d.sessions}건`, 'rect') +
                            '<div style="color:#667183;margin-top:5px">눌러서 그날 강의별 결과 보기</div>'
                          )
                        },
                      },
                      xAxis: {
                        type: 'category',
                        data: cats,
                        ...axisCommon,
                        axisLabel: { ...axisCommon.axisLabel, formatter: (v: string) => fmtDateShort(v) },
                      },
                      yAxis: { type: 'value', minInterval: 1, name: '건', ...axisCommon, nameTextStyle: { color: CHART.muted, fontSize: 12 }, axisLine: { show: false } },
                      series: [
                        {
                          name: '확인 필요',
                          type: 'bar',
                          stack: 'n',
                          barMaxWidth: 14,
                          itemStyle: { color: STATUS_COLOR.crit, borderColor: '#ffffff', borderWidth: 1 },
                          emphasis: { itemStyle: { color: '#b52e2e' } },
                          data: past.map((d) => ({
                            value: splitCounts(d).review,
                            itemStyle: { opacity: d.date === date ? 1 : 0.85 },
                          })),
                        },
                        {
                          name: '자동 조치',
                          type: 'bar',
                          stack: 'n',
                          barMaxWidth: 14,
                          itemStyle: { color: STATUS_COLOR.warn, borderRadius: [4, 4, 0, 0], borderColor: '#ffffff', borderWidth: 1 },
                          emphasis: { itemStyle: { color: '#e09a00' } },
                          data: past.map((d) => splitCounts(d).auto),
                          markLine:
                            date && cats.includes(date)
                              ? {
                                  silent: true,
                                  symbol: 'none',
                                  lineStyle: { color: CHART.ink, width: 1, type: 'solid' },
                                  label: { formatter: '선택', color: CHART.ink2, fontSize: 12, position: 'end' },
                                  data: [{ xAxis: date }],
                                }
                              : undefined,
                        },
                      ] as never,
                    }
                  }, [past, date])
                
                  if (summary.error) return <ErrorBox error={summary.error} onRetry={summary.reload} />
                  if (!summary.data || !meta || !date) return <PageSkeleton label="학기 검증 결과를 불러오는 중…" />
                
                  const setDate = (d: string) => {
                    const p = new URLSearchParams(params)
                    p.set('date', d)
                    setParams(p, { replace: true })
                  }
                  const idx = past.findIndex((d) => d.date === date)
                  const issueDays = [...past].filter((d) => d.anomalies > 0 || (d.match_rate ?? 100) < 100).reverse()
                
                  const V = day.data?.date === date ? day.data.validation : undefined
                  const order = { review: 0, auto: 1, normal: 2 }
                  const inRoom = (V?.sessions ?? []).filter((v) => roomF === 'all' || v.room === roomF)
                  const sorted = [...inRoom].sort(
                    (a, b) => order[statusInfo(a.status).group] - order[statusInfo(b.status).group] || a.start.localeCompare(b.start) || a.room.localeCompare(b.room),
                  )
                  const issues = sorted.filter((v) => statusInfo(v.status).group !== 'normal')
                  const normal = sorted.filter((v) => statusInfo(v.status).group === 'normal')
                  const lo = meta.settings.comfort_low
                  const hi = meta.settings.comfort_high
                
                  return (
                    <div>
                      <PageHeader
                        title="정합성 검증"
                        desc={
                          <>
                            학기 시작부터 강의 <b className="tnum font-semibold text-ink">{fmtNum(kpi.sessions)}건</b>을 확인했고 정합성은{' '}
                            <b className="tnum font-semibold text-ink">{kpi.match != null ? kpi.match.toFixed(2) : '–'}%</b>입니다. 시스템이{' '}
                            <b className="tnum font-semibold text-ink">{fmtNum(kpi.auto)}건</b>을 바로잡았고, 사람이 확인할 건은{' '}
                            <b className="tnum font-semibold text-crit-ink">{fmtNum(kpi.review)}건</b>입니다.
                          </>
                        }
                        right={
                          <Popover
                            label="검증 방법"
                            align="end"
                            width={420}
                            buttonClassName={btnCls('ghost', 'sm')}
                            button={
                              <>
                                <Info size={14} aria-hidden /> 검증 방법
                              </>
                            }
                          >
                            <ol className="space-y-3 text-[13.5px]">
                              {[
                                ['계획 검증', '모든 강의가 운전 계획에 들어 있는지 봅니다.', `계획 반영률 ${kpi.cov != null ? kpi.cov.toFixed(1) : '–'}%`],
                                ['실행 검증', `강의 중 실내기가 실제로 가동했고, 시작 시점에 쾌적 범위(${lo}–${hi}℃)였는지 봅니다.`, '실행률, 시작 온도'],
                                ['이상 처리', '무단 휴강, 명령 실패, 수동 가동, 예보 오차는 시스템이 바로잡고 기록합니다. 사람이 봐야 할 것만 확인 필요로 올립니다.', '자동 조치, 확인 필요'],
                              ].map(([t, d, m], i) => (
                                <li key={t} className="flex gap-3">
                                  <span className="tnum flex h-6 w-6 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-ink text-[12.5px] font-semibold text-white" aria-hidden>
                                    {i + 1}
                                  </span>
                                  <span className="min-w-0">
                                    <span className="block font-semibold text-ink">{t}</span>
                                    <span className="block">{d}</span>
                                    <span className="block text-[13px] text-ink-3">지표: {m}</span>
                                  </span>
                                </li>
                              ))}
                            </ol>
                          </Popover>
                        }
                      />
                
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 xl:grid-cols-[300px_minmax(0,1fr)]">
                        <Card pad={false} className="self-start">
                          <div className="px-5 pt-5 pb-3">
                            <h2 className="text-[17px] font-[650] text-ink">이상이 있었던 날</h2>
                            <p className="mt-0.5 text-[13px] text-ink-3">{issueDays.length}일, 최근 날짜부터</p>
                          </div>
                          <ul className="thin-scroll max-h-[452px] overflow-y-auto px-3 pb-3">
                            {issueDays.map((d) => {
                              const c = splitCounts(d)
                              const on = d.date === date
                              return (
                                <li key={d.date}>
                                  <button
                                    type="button"
                                    onClick={() => setDate(d.date)}
                                    aria-pressed={on}
                                    className={cx(
                                      'flex h-11 w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-[10px] px-3 text-left text-[14px] transition-colors duration-150',
                                      on ? 'bg-ink text-white' : 'text-ink hover:bg-hover',
                                    )}
                                  >
                                    <span className="font-medium">{fmtDateK(d.date)}</span>
                                    <span className={cx('tnum flex items-center gap-2 text-[13px]', on ? 'text-white/85' : 'text-ink-3')}>
                                      {c.review > 0 && (
                                        <span className={cx('inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold', on ? 'text-white' : 'text-crit-ink')}>
                                          <span className="inline-block h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-crit" aria-hidden />
                                          확인 {c.review}
                                        </span>
                                      )}
                                      {c.auto > 0 && <span>조치 {c.auto}</span>}
                                    </span>
                                  </button>
                                </li>
                              )
                            })}
                          </ul>
                        </Card>
                
                        <Card pad={false} className="self-start">
                          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-6 gap-y-3 px-7 pt-6">
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <h2 className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 text-[17px] font-[650] text-ink">
                                {fmtDateK(date)}
                                {date > today && <Badge tone="info">예상</Badge>}
                              </h2>
                              <p className="tnum mt-0.5 text-[13.5px] text-ink-3">
                                {V ? `강의 ${V.total}건, 정합성 ${fmtPct(V.match_rate)}, 자동 조치 ${V.auto_actions}건` : '불러오는 중…'}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                              <IconButton label="이전 강의일" disabled={idx <= 0} onClick={() => idx > 0 && setDate(past[idx - 1].date)}>
                                <ChevronLeft size={17} />
                              </IconButton>
                              <input
                                type="date"
                                name="validation-date"
                                aria-label="검증 날짜"
                                className={cx(inputBase, 'tnum h-9 w-[152px] text-[13.5px]')}
                                value={date}
                                min={meta.semester.start}
                                max={meta.semester.end}
                                onChange={(e) => e.target.value && setDate(e.target.value)}
                              />
                              <IconButton
                                label="다음 강의일"
                                disabled={idx < 0 || idx >= past.length - 1}
                                onClick={() => idx >= 0 && idx < past.length - 1 && setDate(past[idx + 1].date)}
                              >
                                <ChevronRight size={17} />
                              </IconButton>
                              <select className={cx(inputBase, 'ml-1 h-9 w-[124px] text-[13.5px]')} name="room-filter" value={roomF} onChange={(e) => setRoomF(e.target.value)} aria-label="강의실 필터">
                                <option value="all">전체 강의실</option>
                                {ROOM_ORDER.map((r) => (
                                  <option key={r} value={r}>
                                    {r}호
                                  </option>
                                ))}
                              </select>
                              <Link to={`/schedule?date=${date}`} className={btnCls('ghost', 'sm', 'ml-1')}>
                                타임라인 보기
                              </Link>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <div className="px-7 pt-5 pb-7">
                            {day.error ? (
                              <ErrorBox error={day.error} onRetry={day.reload} />
                            ) : !V ? (
                              <Loading />
                            ) : inRoom.length === 0 ? (
                              <Empty
                                title={V.sessions.length ? '이 강의실에는 그날 강의가 없습니다' : '이 날은 강의가 없습니다'}
                                desc={V.sessions.length ? '강의실 필터를 전체로 바꿔 보세요.' : '왼쪽 목록이나 화살표로 강의가 있는 날을 고르세요.'}
                              />
                            ) : (
                              <div className={cx('transition-opacity duration-200', day.loading && 'opacity-60')}>
                                {issues.length === 0 ? (
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-[12px] bg-good-bg px-4 py-3 text-[14px] font-medium text-good-ink">
                                    <StatusBadge group="normal" label="모두 정상" /> 이 날 강의 {inRoom.length}건이 모두 계획대로 운전됐습니다.
                                  </div>
                                ) : (
                                  <SessionTable rows={issues} lo={lo} hi={hi} onOpen={setDrawer} />
                                )}
                                {issues.length > 0 && normal.length > 0 && (
                                  <Disclosure variant="inline" className="mt-4" title={`정상 강의 ${normal.length}건 보기`}>
                                    <SessionTable rows={normal} lo={lo} hi={hi} onOpen={setDrawer} />
                                  </Disclosure>
                                )}
                                {issues.length === 0 && normal.length > 0 && (
                                  <Disclosure variant="inline" className="mt-4" title={`강의 ${normal.length}건 목록 보기`}>
                                    <SessionTable rows={normal} lo={lo} hi={hi} onOpen={setDrawer} />
                                  </Disclosure>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        </Card>
                      </div>
                
                      <DisclosureList className="mt-6" title="자세히 보기" hideTitle>
                        <Disclosure icon={<BarChart3 size={16} aria-hidden />} title="일별 자동 조치와 확인 필요 건수" summary={`강의일 ${past.length}일`}>
                          <ChartCard
                            bare
                            sub="학기 시작부터 오늘까지의 강의일입니다. 막대를 누르면 그날의 강의별 결과가 위에 나옵니다."
                            legend={
                              <>
                                <LegendItem color={STATUS_COLOR.crit} label="확인 필요" />
                                <LegendItem color={STATUS_COLOR.warn} label="자동 조치" />
                              </>
                            }
                            table={{
                              columns: ['날짜', '강의', '정합성 %', '자동 조치', '확인 필요'],
                              rows: past.map((d) => {
                                const c = splitCounts(d)
                                return [d.date, d.sessions, d.match_rate, c.auto, c.review]
                              }),
                            }}
                          >
                            <EChart
                              option={option}
                              height={260}
                              onEvents={{
                                click: (p: unknown) => {
                                  const q = p as { dataIndex: number }
                                  if (past[q.dataIndex]) setDate(past[q.dataIndex].date)
                                },
                              }}
                            />
                          </ChartCard>
                        </Disclosure>
                      </DisclosureList>
                
                      <RoomDrawer open={!!drawer} onClose={() => setDrawer(null)} day={day.data?.date === date ? day.data : undefined} meta={meta} room={drawer} />
                    </div>
                  )
                }
                
                function SessionTable({ rows, lo, hi, onOpen }: { rows: ValidationSession[]; lo: number; hi: number; onOpen: (room: string) => void }) {
                  return (
                    <div className={tbl.frame}>
                      <table className={tbl.table}>
                        <thead className={tbl.thead}>
                          <tr>
                            <th className={tbl.th}>강의실</th>
                            <th className={tbl.th}>강의</th>
                            <th className={tbl.th}>검증 결과</th>
                            <th className={tbl.thR}>시작 온도</th>
                            <th className={tbl.thR}>쾌적</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          {rows.map((v) => {
                            const info = statusInfo(v.status)
                            const out = v.ta_start != null && (v.ta_start < lo || v.ta_start > hi)
                            return (
                              <tr
                                key={v.session}
                                className={cx(tbl.tr, 'cursor-pointer align-top transition-colors hover:bg-well')}
                                onClick={() => onOpen(v.room)}
                                tabIndex={0}
                                aria-label={`${v.room}호 ${v.title} ${info.label}, 상세 보기`}
                                onKeyDown={(e) => (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && (e.preventDefault(), onOpen(v.room))}
                                style={{ boxShadow: info.group !== 'normal' ? `inset 3px 0 0 ${GROUP_META[info.group].color}` : undefined }}
                              >
                                <td className="px-3.5 py-3 font-semibold text-ink">{v.room}</td>
                                <td className="px-3.5 py-3">
                                  <div className="font-medium text-ink">{v.title}</div>
                                  <div className="tnum text-[13px] text-ink-3">
                                    {v.start}–{v.end}
                                  </div>
                                </td>
                                <td className="px-3.5 py-3">
                                  <StatusBadge group={info.group} label={info.label} />
                                  {v.notes.map((n, i) => (
                                    <div key={i} className="mt-1 max-w-[420px] text-[13px] text-ink-2">
                                      {n}
                                    </div>
                                  ))}
                                </td>
                                <td className={cx('px-3.5 py-3 text-right', out ? 'font-semibold text-crit-ink' : 'text-ink-2')}>{v.ta_start != null ? `${v.ta_start.toFixed(1)}℃` : '–'}</td>
                                <td className="px-3.5 py-3 text-right text-ink-2">{v.comfort_pct != null ? `${v.comfort_pct.toFixed(0)}%` : '재실 없음'}</td>
                              </tr>
                            )
                          })}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>
                  )
                }
