📁 infra/
    📄 admin-setup.sh
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        #!/usr/bin/env bash
        # One-time setup for an AWS account admin (run in AWS CloudShell, region ap-northeast-2).
        # Creates the two execution roles ThermoPlan needs and lets the deployer user attach them
        # to Lambda / EventBridge Scheduler. Nothing else in the account is touched.
        #
        #   curl -sO <raw url of this file>  (or paste it)  &&  bash admin-setup.sh
        set -euo pipefail
        
        ACC="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)"
        REGION="ap-northeast-2"
        DEPLOYER="${DEPLOYER:-hvac-dev-donghun}"
        
        cat > /tmp/lambda-trust.json <<'EOF'
        {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"lambda.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}
        EOF
        cat > /tmp/scheduler-trust.json <<'EOF'
        {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"scheduler.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}
        EOF
        cat > /tmp/api-policy.json <<EOF
        {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[
         {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:CreateLogGroup","logs:CreateLogStream","logs:PutLogEvents"],"Resource":"arn:aws:logs:${REGION}:${ACC}:*"},
         {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::hvac-ai-data-${ACC}/*"},
         {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"s3:ListBucket","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::hvac-ai-data-${ACC}"},
         {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["dynamodb:GetItem","dynamodb:PutItem","dynamodb:DeleteItem","dynamodb:UpdateItem","dynamodb:Query","dynamodb:BatchWriteItem"],"Resource":"arn:aws:dynamodb:${REGION}:${ACC}:table/hvac-ai-data"},
         {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"ssm:GetParameter","Resource":"arn:aws:ssm:${REGION}:${ACC}:parameter/hvac-ai/kma-key"},
         {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["bedrock:InvokeModel","bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream"],"Resource":["arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/anthropic.*","arn:aws:bedrock:*:${ACC}:inference-profile/*"]},
         {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"lambda:InvokeFunction","Resource":"arn:aws:lambda:${REGION}:${ACC}:function:hvac-ai-api"}
        ]}
        EOF
        cat > /tmp/scheduler-policy.json <<EOF
        {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"lambda:InvokeFunction","Resource":"arn:aws:lambda:${REGION}:${ACC}:function:hvac-ai-api"}]}
        EOF
        cat > /tmp/passrole.json <<EOF
        {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"iam:PassRole","Resource":[
         "arn:aws:iam::${ACC}:role/hvac-ai-api-role","arn:aws:iam::${ACC}:role/hvac-ai-scheduler-role"]}]}
        EOF
        
        aws iam create-role --role-name hvac-ai-api-role --assume-role-policy-document file:///tmp/lambda-trust.json \
          --tags Key=project,Value=hvac-ai >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "hvac-ai-api-role already exists - updating policy"
        aws iam put-role-policy --role-name hvac-ai-api-role --policy-name hvac-ai-api --policy-document file:///tmp/api-policy.json
        
        aws iam create-role --role-name hvac-ai-scheduler-role --assume-role-policy-document file:///tmp/scheduler-trust.json \
          --tags Key=project,Value=hvac-ai >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "hvac-ai-scheduler-role already exists - updating policy"
        aws iam put-role-policy --role-name hvac-ai-scheduler-role --policy-name invoke --policy-document file:///tmp/scheduler-policy.json
        
        aws iam put-user-policy --user-name "$DEPLOYER" --policy-name hvac-ai-passrole --policy-document file:///tmp/passrole.json
        
        echo "done:"
        echo "  arn:aws:iam::${ACC}:role/hvac-ai-api-role"
        echo "  arn:aws:iam::${ACC}:role/hvac-ai-scheduler-role"
        echo "  ${DEPLOYER} may now pass these two roles (iam:PassRole only)."
        --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

    📄 deploy.sh
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        #!/usr/bin/env bash
        # Build and deploy ThermoPlan (HVAC Schedule AI) to AWS.
        #
        #   AWS_PROFILE=hvac ./infra/deploy.sh lambda                 # full serverless (needs infra/admin-setup.sh done once)
        #   AWS_PROFILE=hvac ./infra/deploy.sh external <api-host>    # web + data on AWS, /api/* -> external host (e.g. tunnel)
        #   AWS_PROFILE=hvac ./infra/deploy.sh frontend               # rebuild and upload the web app only
        # First run needs the KMA service key: KMA_KEY=... ./infra/deploy.sh ...
        set -euo pipefail
        
        ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
        REGION="${AWS_REGION:-ap-northeast-2}"
        export AWS_REGION="$REGION"
        STACK="hvac-ai"
        MODE="${1:-lambda}"
        ACCOUNT="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)"
        ART_BUCKET="hvac-ai-artifacts-${ACCOUNT}"
        BUILD="$ROOT/infra/.build"
        
        log() { printf '\n\033[1;36m==> %s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
        
        ensure_artifacts_bucket() {
          if ! aws s3api head-bucket --bucket "$ART_BUCKET" 2>/dev/null; then
            log "creating artifact bucket $ART_BUCKET"
            aws s3api create-bucket --bucket "$ART_BUCKET" --create-bucket-configuration LocationConstraint="$REGION" >/dev/null
            aws s3api put-public-access-block --bucket "$ART_BUCKET" --public-access-block-configuration \
              BlockPublicAcls=true,IgnorePublicAcls=true,BlockPublicPolicy=true,RestrictPublicBuckets=true
          fi
        }
        
        ensure_params() {
          if ! aws ssm get-parameter --name /hvac-ai/kma-key >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            if [ -z "${KMA_KEY:-}" ]; then echo "KMA_KEY env var required on first deploy" >&2; exit 1; fi
            aws ssm put-parameter --name /hvac-ai/kma-key --type SecureString --value "$KMA_KEY" \
              --tags Key=project,Value=hvac-ai >/dev/null
          fi
          if ! aws ssm get-parameter --name /hvac-ai/origin-secret --with-decryption >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            aws ssm put-parameter --name /hvac-ai/origin-secret --type SecureString --value "$(openssl rand -hex 24)" \
              --tags Key=project,Value=hvac-ai >/dev/null
          fi
          ORIGIN_SECRET="$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /hvac-ai/origin-secret --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)"
        }
        
        build_backend() {
          log "building backend package (python3.13 arm64)"
          rm -rf "$BUILD" && mkdir -p "$BUILD/pkg"
          uv pip install --quiet --target "$BUILD/pkg" \
            --python-platform aarch64-manylinux2014 --python-version 3.13 --only-binary :all: \
            fastapi mangum "anthropic>=2.10" openpyxl python-multipart
          rm -rf "$BUILD/pkg"/boto3* "$BUILD/pkg"/botocore* "$BUILD/pkg"/s3transfer* 2>/dev/null || true
          cp -R "$ROOT/backend/app" "$ROOT/backend/hvac" "$ROOT/backend/seed" "$BUILD/pkg/"
          find "$BUILD/pkg" -name '__pycache__' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
          (cd "$BUILD/pkg" && zip -qr9 "$BUILD/backend.zip" .)
          CODE_KEY="backend/backend-$(shasum -a 256 "$BUILD/backend.zip" | cut -c1-16).zip"
          aws s3 cp --quiet "$BUILD/backend.zip" "s3://${ART_BUCKET}/${CODE_KEY}"
          echo "uploaded s3://${ART_BUCKET}/${CODE_KEY} ($(du -h "$BUILD/backend.zip" | cut -f1))"
        }
        
        deploy_stack() {
          log "deploying CloudFormation stack $STACK ($MODE)"
          aws cloudformation deploy --stack-name "$STACK" --template-file "$ROOT/infra/template.yaml" \
            --parameter-overrides "$@" OriginSecret="$ORIGIN_SECRET" --tags project=hvac-ai --no-fail-on-empty-changeset
        }
        
        output() {
          aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name "$STACK" \
            --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='$1'].OutputValue" --output text
        }
        
        deploy_frontend() {
          log "building and uploading frontend"
          (cd "$ROOT/frontend" && npm ci --silent && npm run build --silent)
          WEB_BUCKET="$(output WebBucketName)"
          aws s3 sync "$ROOT/frontend/dist/assets" "s3://${WEB_BUCKET}/assets" \
            --cache-control "public,max-age=31536000,immutable" --quiet
          aws s3 sync "$ROOT/frontend/dist" "s3://${WEB_BUCKET}" --delete --exclude "assets/*" \
            --cache-control "no-cache" --quiet
          aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id "$(output DistributionId)" --paths "/*" \
            --query Invalidation.Id --output text
        }
        
        ensure_params
        case "$MODE" in
          lambda)
            ensure_artifacts_bucket
            build_backend
            deploy_stack ApiMode=lambda CodeBucket="$ART_BUCKET" CodeKey="$CODE_KEY" \
              FunctionRoleArn="arn:aws:iam::${ACCOUNT}:role/hvac-ai-api-role" \
              SchedulerRoleArn="arn:aws:iam::${ACCOUNT}:role/hvac-ai-scheduler-role"
            aws lambda invoke --function-name hvac-ai-api --invocation-type Event \
              --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out --payload '{"task":"hourly"}' /dev/null >/dev/null
            deploy_frontend
            ;;
          external)
            API_HOST="${2:?usage: deploy.sh external <api-host>}"
            deploy_stack ApiMode=external ExternalApiDomain="$API_HOST"
            deploy_frontend
            ;;
          frontend)
            deploy_frontend
            ;;
          *) echo "unknown mode $MODE" >&2; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        log "site: $(output SiteUrl)"
        --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

    📄 ec2-deploy.sh
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        #!/usr/bin/env bash
        # Deploy the ThermoPlan API to the EC2 host (used while Lambda execution roles are unavailable).
        #
        #   AWS_PROFILE=hvac ./infra/ec2-deploy.sh deploy       # code + deps + services + caddy
        #   AWS_PROFILE=hvac ./infra/ec2-deploy.sh sync-login   # after `aws login --profile hvac` on this Mac
        #   ./infra/ec2-deploy.sh status
        #   ./infra/ec2-deploy.sh demo-reset                    # remove all events, restore default rules
        #
        # The EC2 host has no IAM role (the deployer cannot create roles), so it uses the operator's
        # `aws login` session (max 12 h). When the session expires the API keeps serving from its local
        # mirror (ResilientStore); Bedrock features need a fresh session (sync-login).
        set -euo pipefail
        
        ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
        RUN="$ROOT/infra/.run"
        export AWS_REGION="${AWS_REGION:-ap-northeast-2}"
        IP="$(awk '{print $2}' "$RUN/eip")"
        DOMAIN="$(echo "$IP" | tr . -).sslip.io"
        KEY="$HOME/.ssh/hvac-ai-ec2.pem"  # path without spaces (rsync -e splits on spaces)
        [ -f "$KEY" ] || install -m 600 "$RUN/hvac-ai-ec2.pem" "$KEY"
        SSH=(ssh -i "$KEY" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o ConnectTimeout=15 "ec2-user@$IP")
        
        sync_login() {
          # hvac profile + login cache only (no other profiles or credentials leave this machine)
          local prof
          prof="$(sed -n '/^\[profile hvac\]/,/^\[/p' ~/.aws/config | sed '$ { /^\[/d; }')"
          "${SSH[@]}" "mkdir -p ~/.aws/login/cache && chmod 700 ~/.aws ~/.aws/login ~/.aws/login/cache && rm -f ~/.aws/login/cache/*.json"
          printf '%s\n' "$prof" | "${SSH[@]}" "cat > ~/.aws/config && chmod 600 ~/.aws/config"
          scp -q -i "$KEY" ~/.aws/login/cache/*.json "ec2-user@$IP:.aws/login/cache/"
          "${SSH[@]}" "chmod 600 ~/.aws/login/cache/*.json && /opt/hvac/.venv/bin/python -c \"import boto3; print(boto3.Session(profile_name='hvac').client('sts').get_caller_identity()['Arn'])\" && sudo systemctl restart hvac-api"
        }
        
        deploy() {
          local secret kma acc
          acc="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)"
          secret="$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /hvac-ai/origin-secret --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)"
          kma="$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /hvac-ai/kma-key --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)"
          aws ssm get-parameter --name /hvac-ai/operator-key >/dev/null 2>&1 || aws ssm put-parameter --name /hvac-ai/operator-key \
            --type SecureString --value "$(openssl rand -hex 16)" --tags Key=project,Value=hvac-ai >/dev/null
          local opkey
          opkey="$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /hvac-ai/operator-key --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)"
        
          rsync -az --delete -e "ssh -i $KEY -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new" \
            --exclude '__pycache__' --exclude '.venv' --exclude 'tests' \
            "$ROOT/backend/" "ec2-user@$IP:/opt/hvac/backend/"
        
          "${SSH[@]}" "cd /opt/hvac && ( [ -d .venv ] || uv venv -q --python 3.13 .venv ) && \
            uv pip install -q --python .venv/bin/python fastapi mangum 'anthropic[bedrock]>=2.10' 'botocore[crt]' boto3 openpyxl python-multipart uvicorn"
        
          "${SSH[@]}" "umask 077 && cat > /opt/hvac/env" <<EOF
        DATA_BUCKET=hvac-ai-data-${acc}
        TABLE_NAME=hvac-ai-data
        LOCAL_MIRROR=/var/lib/hvac/mirror
        ORIGIN_SECRET=${secret}
        KMA_KEY=${kma}
        OPERATOR_KEY=${opkey}
        AWS_PROFILE=hvac
        AWS_REGION=${AWS_REGION}
        BEDROCK_REGION=${AWS_REGION}
        EOF
        
          "${SSH[@]}" "sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/hvac-api.service >/dev/null" <<'EOF'
        [Unit]
        Description=ThermoPlan API (FastAPI)
        After=network-online.target
        [Service]
        User=ec2-user
        WorkingDirectory=/opt/hvac/backend
        EnvironmentFile=/opt/hvac/env
        ExecStart=/opt/hvac/.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --workers 1 --timeout-keep-alive 30
        Restart=always
        RestartSec=3
        [Install]
        WantedBy=multi-user.target
        EOF
          "${SSH[@]}" "sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/hvac-refresh.service >/dev/null" <<'EOF'
        [Unit]
        Description=ThermoPlan hourly weather refresh + recompute
        [Service]
        Type=oneshot
        EnvironmentFile=/opt/hvac/env
        ExecStart=/bin/bash -c 'curl -s -m 30 -X POST -H "x-origin-secret: $ORIGIN_SECRET" http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/weather/refresh'
        EOF
          "${SSH[@]}" "sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/hvac-refresh.timer >/dev/null" <<'EOF'
        [Unit]
        Description=Run ThermoPlan refresh every hour at :20
        [Timer]
        OnCalendar=*-*-* *:20:00
        Persistent=true
        [Install]
        WantedBy=timers.target
        EOF
          "${SSH[@]}" "sudo tee /etc/caddy/Caddyfile >/dev/null" <<EOF
        ${DOMAIN} {
          encode gzip
          reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8000 {
            transport http {
              read_timeout 120s
            }
          }
        }
        EOF
          "${SSH[@]}" "sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/caddy.service >/dev/null" <<'EOF'
        [Unit]
        Description=Caddy (HTTPS reverse proxy)
        After=network-online.target
        [Service]
        ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/caddy run --config /etc/caddy/Caddyfile --adapter caddyfile
        Restart=always
        Environment=HOME=/var/lib/caddy XDG_DATA_HOME=/var/lib/caddy
        [Install]
        WantedBy=multi-user.target
        EOF
          "${SSH[@]}" "sudo mkdir -p /var/lib/caddy /var/lib/hvac/mirror && sudo chown ec2-user /var/lib/hvac/mirror && \
            sudo systemctl daemon-reload && sudo systemctl enable --now hvac-api caddy hvac-refresh.timer && \
            sudo systemctl restart hvac-api caddy"
          echo "api host: $DOMAIN"
        }
        
        demo_reset() {
          "${SSH[@]}" 'set -a; . /opt/hvac/env; set +a; curl -s -X POST -H "x-origin-secret: $ORIGIN_SECRET" -H "x-operator-key: $OPERATOR_KEY" http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/admin/reset; echo'
        }
        
        status() {
          "${SSH[@]}" "systemctl is-active hvac-api caddy hvac-refresh.timer; curl -s -m 5 http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health; echo; tail -n 5 /var/log/messages 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-160 || true"
        }
        
        case "${1:-deploy}" in
          deploy) deploy ;;
          sync-login) sync_login ;;
          status) status ;;
          demo-reset) demo_reset ;;
          *) echo "usage: $0 deploy|sync-login|status|demo-reset" >&2; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

    📄 run-local-api.sh
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        #!/usr/bin/env bash
        # Run the ThermoPlan API on this machine against the AWS data store (S3 + DynamoDB + Bedrock)
        # and expose it through a Cloudflare quick tunnel so CloudFront can use it as the /api origin.
        # Used while Lambda execution roles are unavailable (see infra/admin-setup.sh).
        #
        #   AWS_PROFILE=hvac ./infra/run-local-api.sh start   # prints the tunnel host
        #   ./infra/run-local-api.sh stop
        set -euo pipefail
        
        ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
        RUN="$ROOT/infra/.run"
        PORT="${PORT:-8001}"
        export AWS_REGION="${AWS_REGION:-ap-northeast-2}"
        mkdir -p "$RUN"
        
        stop() {
          for f in api tunnel refresh caffeinate; do
            [ -f "$RUN/$f.pid" ] && kill "$(cat "$RUN/$f.pid")" 2>/dev/null || true
            rm -f "$RUN/$f.pid"
          done
        }
        
        start() {
          stop
          ACC="$(aws sts get-caller-identity --query Account --output text)"
          export DATA_BUCKET="hvac-ai-data-${ACC}" TABLE_NAME="hvac-ai-data"
          export ORIGIN_SECRET="$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /hvac-ai/origin-secret --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)"
          export KMA_KEY="$(aws ssm get-parameter --name /hvac-ai/kma-key --with-decryption --query Parameter.Value --output text)"
          unset NOW_OVERRIDE LOCAL_STORE
        
          (cd "$ROOT/backend" && nohup .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port "$PORT" \
              < /dev/null > "$RUN/api.log" 2>&1 & echo $! > "$RUN/api.pid")
          nohup cloudflared tunnel --no-autoupdate --url "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}" < /dev/null > "$RUN/tunnel.log" 2>&1 &
          echo $! > "$RUN/tunnel.pid"
          # hourly weather refresh + recompute (what EventBridge Scheduler does in Lambda mode)
          nohup bash -c "while true; do sleep 3600; curl -s -X POST -H 'x-origin-secret: ${ORIGIN_SECRET}' http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/api/weather/refresh >/dev/null; done" \
            < /dev/null > /dev/null 2>&1 &
          echo $! > "$RUN/refresh.pid"
          nohup caffeinate -dims -w "$(cat "$RUN/api.pid")" < /dev/null > /dev/null 2>&1 &
          echo $! > "$RUN/caffeinate.pid"
        
          HOST=""
          for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
            HOST="$(grep -o 'https://[a-z0-9-]*\.trycloudflare\.com' "$RUN/tunnel.log" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's#https://##' || true)"
            [ -n "$HOST" ] && break
            sleep 1
          done
          echo "${HOST:?tunnel did not start; see $RUN/tunnel.log}" > "$RUN/tunnel.host"
          echo "$HOST"
        }
        
        case "${1:-start}" in
          start) start ;;
          stop) stop ;;
          *) echo "usage: $0 start|stop" >&2; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

    📄 template.yaml
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
        Description: >-
          HVAC Schedule AI (ThermoPlan) - CloudFront + S3 web, DynamoDB + S3 data.
          ApiMode=lambda runs the FastAPI backend on Lambda (execution roles are created by an
          account admin with infra/admin-setup.sh); ApiMode=external routes /api/* to an external origin.
        
        Parameters:
          ApiMode:
            Type: String
            AllowedValues: [external, lambda]
            Default: external
          ExternalApiDomain:
            Type: String
            Default: example.com
            Description: Host name of the external API origin (ApiMode=external)
          FunctionRoleArn:
            Type: String
            Default: ""
          SchedulerRoleArn:
            Type: String
            Default: ""
          CodeBucket:
            Type: String
            Default: ""
          CodeKey:
            Type: String
            Default: ""
          OriginSecret:
            Type: String
            NoEcho: true
          KmaKeyParam:
            Type: String
            Default: /hvac-ai/kma-key
          FunctionName:
            Type: String
            Default: hvac-ai-api
        
        Conditions:

📁 scripts/
    📄 gen_numbers.py
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        """Regenerate every number quoted in the docs from the running API (single source of truth).
        
            python3 scripts/gen_numbers.py [--api https://d32ggz3cj7s7bx.cloudfront.net]
        
        Writes docs/numbers.md and replaces the blocks between
        <!-- numbers:NAME:start --> and <!-- numbers:NAME:end --> in README.md and docs/evaluation.md.
        """
        from __future__ import annotations
        
        import argparse
        import json
        import re
        import urllib.request
        from pathlib import Path
        
        ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
        NAMES = {"fixed": "고정 스케줄", "manual": "수동 운영", "rule": "규칙 기반", "ai": "AI 예측 제어"}
        
        
        def get(api: str, path: str):
            with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(api + path, headers={"User-Agent": "gen-numbers"}), timeout=120) as r:
                return json.loads(r.read())
        
        
        def pct(a: float, b: float) -> str:
            return f"{100 * (1 - a / b):.1f}%"
        
        
        def strategy_table(t: dict) -> str:
            rows = ["| 전략 | 전력량 | 전기요금 | 쾌적 시간 | 불쾌 지표(K·분) | 최대 피크 |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
            for k in ("fixed", "manual", "rule", "ai"):
                v = t[k]
                name = f"**{NAMES[k]}**" if k == "ai" else NAMES[k]
                rows.append(f"| {name} | {v['kwh']:,.0f} kWh | {v['cost_krw']:,.0f}원 | {v['comfort_pct']:.2f}% | "
                            f"{v['discomfort_dm']:,.0f} | {v['peak_kw']:.1f} kW |")
            return "\n".join(rows)
        
        
        def render(api: str) -> dict[str, str]:
            sm = get(api, "/api/summary")
            at = get(api, "/api/attribution")
            cons = get(api, "/api/consolidation")
            meta = get(api, "/api/meta")
            al, td = sm["totals"]["all"], sm["totals"]["to_date"]
            va, wf = at["all"]["variants"], at["all"]["waterfall"]
            ai, rule, fixed, manual, rule30 = al["ai"], al["rule"], al["fixed"], al["manual"], va["rule30"]
        
            headline = (
                f"- 학기 전체(9/1~12/18): AI 예측 제어는 고정 스케줄 대비 **{pct(ai['kwh'], fixed['kwh'])} 절감**, "
                f"수동 운영 대비 {pct(ai['kwh'], manual['kwh'])}, 규칙 기반 대비 {pct(ai['kwh'], rule['kwh'])} 절감합니다. "
                f"전기요금은 {fixed['cost_krw']:,.0f}원 → {ai['cost_krw']:,.0f}원, CO₂는 {fixed['co2_kg'] - ai['co2_kg']:,.0f} kg 줄어듭니다.\n"
                f"- 오늘({sm['today']})까지: 고정 대비 {pct(td['ai']['kwh'], td['fixed']['kwh'])}, "
                f"규칙 기반 대비 {pct(td['ai']['kwh'], td['rule']['kwh'])} 절감.\n"
                f"- **같은 쾌적도 기준**: 규칙 기반이 AI의 쾌적도에 다가가려면 30분 전에 켜야 하고 {rule30['kwh']:,.0f} kWh를 씁니다"
                f"(수업 시작 시 저온 {rule30['cold_starts']}회). AI는 {va['ai']['kwh']:,.0f} kWh로 **{pct(va['ai']['kwh'], rule30['kwh'])} 적게** 쓰고 "
                f"저온 시작은 {va['ai']['cold_starts']}회입니다. 10분 전 규칙은 저온 시작이 {va['rule']['cold_starts']}회입니다."
            )
            water = ["| 단계 | 전력량 | 변화 | 수업 시작 시 저온 | 쾌적 시간 |", "|---|---|---|---|---|"]
            for w in wf:
                d = "" if w["delta_kwh"] is None else f"{w['delta_kwh']:+,.1f}"
                water.append(f"| {w['label']} | {w['kwh']:,.0f} kWh | {d} | {w['cold_starts']}회 | {w['comfort_pct']:.2f}% |")
            water.append(f"| (참고) 규칙 기반 30분 전 | {rule30['kwh']:,.0f} kWh | | {rule30['cold_starts']}회 | {rule30['comfort_pct']:.2f}% |")
            water.append(f"| (참고) 규칙 기반 + 재실 감지 | {va['rule_vacancy']['kwh']:,.0f} kWh | | "
                         f"{va['rule_vacancy']['cold_starts']}회 | {va['rule_vacancy']['comfort_pct']:.2f}% |")
            cons_lines = [f"- 강의실 재배치 권고(학사 부서 검토용): 학기 전체 {cons['semester_kwh_saving']:,.1f} kWh 절감 예상"]
            for w in cons["weekdays"]:
                if w["moves"]:
                    cons_lines.append(f"  - {w['weekday_label']}요일 {len(w['moves'])}건 이동: {w['kwh_saving']:,.1f} kWh "
                                      f"({w['saving_pct']}%), 실외기 가동 {w['odu_minutes_before'] / 60:.1f}h → {w['odu_minutes_after'] / 60:.1f}h")
            decisions = ", ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in sm["decisions"].items())
            stamp = f"_{meta['now']['real']} 기준 배포 API에서 자동 생성 (엔진 {get(api, '/api/health')['engine']})._"
            readme = "\n".join([stamp, "", strategy_table(al), "", headline])
            evaluation = "\n".join([stamp, "", "### 전략 비교 (학기 전체)", "", strategy_table(al), "", headline, "",
                                    "### 절감 요인 분해와 같은 쾌적도 비교", "", "\n".join(water), "",
                                    at.get("note", ""), "", "### 기타", "", "\n".join(cons_lines),
                                    f"- AI 판단 횟수(학기): {decisions}"])
            return {"README": readme, "EVAL": evaluation}
        
        
        def replace_block(path: Path, name: str, body: str) -> None:
            s = path.read_text()
            start, end = f"<!-- numbers:{name}:start -->", f"<!-- numbers:{name}:end -->"
            if start not in s:
                raise SystemExit(f"{path}: missing {start}")
            s = re.sub(re.escape(start) + r".*?" + re.escape(end), start + "\n" + body + "\n" + end, s, flags=re.S)
            path.write_text(s)
        
        
        if __name__ == "__main__":
            ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
            ap.add_argument("--api", default="https://d32ggz3cj7s7bx.cloudfront.net")
            a = ap.parse_args()
            blocks = render(a.api.rstrip("/"))
            (ROOT / "docs" / "numbers.md").write_text("# 발표·문서용 수치\n\n" + blocks["EVAL"] + "\n")
            replace_block(ROOT / "README.md", "README", blocks["README"])
            replace_block(ROOT / "docs" / "evaluation.md", "EVAL", blocks["EVAL"])
            print("updated README.md, docs/evaluation.md, docs/numbers.md")
        --- 파일 내용 끝 ---

    📄 warm_demo.sh
        --- 파일 내용 시작 ---
        #!/usr/bin/env bash
        # Run the demo script's AI prompts once on presentation day so that, if Bedrock becomes
        # unavailable during the demo, the same questions are answered from the same-day cache.
        #   ./scripts/warm_demo.sh [https://d32ggz3cj7s7bx.cloudfront.net]
        set -euo pipefail
        API="${1:-https://d32ggz3cj7s7bx.cloudfront.net}"
        
        parse() {
          printf '  parse: %s ... ' "$1"
          curl -s -m 60 -X POST "$API/api/events/parse" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
            -d "{\"text\": \"$1\"}" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('type'), d.get('date'), d.get('room'), 'check ok' if (d.get('check') or {}).get('ok') else 'check: issues')"
        }
        
        chat() {
          printf '  chat: %s\n' "$1"
          job=$(curl -s -m 30 -X POST "$API/api/chat" -H 'content-type: application/json' \
            -d "{\"messages\": [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"$1\"}]}" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['job'])")
          for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
            st=$(curl -s "$API/api/jobs/$job" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['status'])")
            [ "$st" = done ] || [ "$st" = error ] && break
            sleep 3
          done
          echo "    -> $st"
        }
        
        echo "AI warm-up against $API"
        parse "다음 주 수요일 405호 18~21시 캡스톤 특강 50명"
        parse "11월 27일 금요일 307호 지능형IoT플랫폼 휴강"
        chat "선행 가동을 10분에서 5분으로 줄이면 이번 주 에너지와 쾌적도가 어떻게 바뀌는지 시뮬레이션해줘"
        chat "이번 주 에너지 낭비가 가장 큰 강의실과 이유는?"
        chat "금요일 강의실 재배치로 얼마나 절감돼?"
        curl -s "$API/api/meta" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('AI status:', d.get('ai'), '| storage:', d.get('storage', {}).get('mode'))"
